fdroid:com.awagam.android.name: AWAGAM TLD and Domain Blocker
fdroid:com.awagam.android.summary: Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level using your own blocklists
fdroid:com.awagam.android.description:
AWAGAM blocks access to top-level domains and domains at the DNS level, using blocklists you configure yourself.
It runs a local VPN that intercepts DNS queries. Blocked lookups resolve to 0.0.0.0; everything else is forwarded to the DNS-over-HTTPS resolver of your choice, or to a local resolver like InviZible Pro’s DNSCrypt. Your ordinary Internet traffic is never routed through the VPN.
The app ships with no blocking rules of its own. What gets blocked is entirely up to you.
Features:
* Block TLDs and domains at the DNS level
* DNS-over-HTTPS upstream (DNS4EU, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard), or a local resolver on the device
* Add, edit, and manage as many blocklist URLs as you like
* Compatible with the AWAGAM browser extension blocklist format, including bundles
* Temporarily disable protection (5 minutes, 15 minutes, 1 hour) with automatic restart
* DNS query statistics: queries, blocked requests, cache performance
* Export your configuration to Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, or hosts format
* Background blocklist updates every 6 hours
* Watchdog that restarts filtering if the system stops it
* Auto-start on boot
Privacy:
AWAGAM collects no personal data. All processing happens on your device. There is no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, and no DNS query logging. The only network connections are DNS queries to the upstream resolver you select and blocklist fetches from URLs you configure.
The app opts out of Android backup and device-to-device transfer, so your blocklist subscriptions are never copied into your Google account. Use the export function to move your configuration yourself.
Limitations:
* DNS sees domain names, not full URLs, so URL-level blocking is not possible. Use the browser extension for that.
* Android permits one VPN at a time, so AWAGAM cannot run alongside another VPN app.
* Apps that use their own DNS-over-HTTPS resolver bypass system DNS filtering.

version you need as a file.

recording or an instrument, and anyone learning a piece by ear.
Change the pitch
- Slide up or down on the screen and hear the change as the song plays.
- Step by 1, 10, or 100 cents, type an exact value, or snap to semitones.
- The interval is spelled out as you go, for example "up a minor third".
Find the key
- The tuner names the note at the playhead or at a bookmark, with its exact cents.
- Choose the note you want and apply the interval in one tap.
Practice
- Loops for the passages you work on, repeated one at a time or in sequence.
- Named bookmarks shown on the waveform.
- Play speed from half to double, without changing the pitch.
- Zoom the waveform, and let it follow the playhead.
Keep and save
- Keep the pitches you like on a shelf and switch between them with a tap.
- Kept pitches are prepared in the background, so saving is quick.
- Save or share as WAV, MP3, M4A, or Opus, the whole song or only your loops, at
 normal speed or at your practice speed.
- Files sound exactly like the preview, because both use the same engine.
Private by design
- No network permission. Nothing leaves your phone.
- No account, no ads, no tracking.
- Import audio or video files, or share one in from another app.
A short guided tour shows every control the first time you open a song.
pitcher is free and open source software (GPL-3.0).

fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.name: AirGuard - AirTag protection
fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.summary: AirGuard detects trackers that are used for stalking and warns you.
fdroid:de.seemoo.at_tracking_detection.description:
With AirGuard, you get the anti-stalking protection you deserve!
The app scans your surroundings in the background to detect trackers like AirTags, Samsung SmartTags, or Google Find My Device trackers. If a tracker is following you, you will receive an instant notification.
These trackers are often no larger than a coin and are unfortunately misused to secretly track people. Since each tracker works differently, you would typically need multiple apps to detect unwanted tracking.
AirGuard combines the detection of various trackers into a single app – keeping you protected with ease.
Once a tracker is detected, you can make it play a sound (for supported models) or perform a manual scan to locate it. If you find a tracker, we recommend disabling it to prevent further tracking of your location.
The app stores location data exclusively on your device, allowing you to review where a tracker has followed you. Your personal data is never shared.
If no trackers are found, the app runs silently in the background and won’t bother you.
 How does the app work? 
AirGuard uses Bluetooth to detect AirTags, Samsung SmartTags, and other trackers. All data is processed and stored locally on your device.
If a tracker is detected in at least three different locations, you will receive a warning. You can adjust the security level in the settings to receive even faster alerts.
 Who are we? 
We are part of the Technical University of Darmstadt. This project is part of the scientific research conducted by the Secure Mobile Networking Lab.
Our goal is to protect people’s privacy and investigate how widespread the issue of tracker-based stalking is.
You can voluntarily participate in an anonymous study to help us gain more insights into the usage and spread of these trackers.
This app will never be monetized – there are no ads and no paid features. You will never be charged for using it.
Our privacy policy can be found here:
https://tpe.seemoo.tu-darmstadt.de/privacy-policy.html
 Legal Notice 
AirTag, Find My, and iOS are registered trademarks of Apple Inc.
This project is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

Operation:
 * The user selects the ESUP-NFC-TAG server from his institution.
 * It authenticates itself.
 * According to its rights and the setting of ESUP-NFC-TAG, a number of 'rooms' of badging are presented.
 * The user selects a 'room'.
 * It can then badger multi-service cards.
This application is only useful in the framework of use predefined by the establishment.
In other words, if you find this application by chance on the Google Play Store, it is that it is not intended for you and it will be of no use to you.
This application is open-source (free) as the entire project esup-sgc / esup-nfc-tag.
The official page of ESUP-NFC-TAG-DROID is here:
https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/display/ESUPNFC/ESUP-NFC-TAG-DROID
If you are responsible for an esup-nfc-tag server from an ESR facility that you want your esup-nfc-tag server to appear in the list of available servers, you can request it through a Pull Request proposing the modification of the list of available urls:
https://github.com/EsupPortail/esup-nfc-tag-droid/blob/master/src/main/assets/urls

 Weather at a glance: 
• Main card: current condition, temperature (°C to one decimal place), today's low and high, rain or snow when it is coming, air quality when it is not good, and 4 tiles for the next 12 hours
• Free-scroll layout: below the main card, all other cards are always open

• Chart view: up to 10 days hour by hour, in stacked charts that scroll together: temperature, rain, wind, pressure, humidity, UV and air quality
• Minutely nowcast when rain or snow is coming
• Current Conditions and Sun & Air tiles: feels like, wind compass and gusts, pressure, humidity and dew point, UV index, air quality (US and EU AQI), visibility, sunrise and sunset
• Activities: running, drying laundry, sun protection, skin comfort (dry air), car washing and driving
• Meteocons weather icons, with day and night versions
 Units: 
• Every value in metric and imperial units side by side
• Tap a value to swap which unit comes first
 Weather data and alerts: 
• Weather from Open-Meteo (default, no API key needed) or Pirate Weather (with your own API key)
• Weather alerts from 7 sources: NWS, NHC, MeteoAlarm, JMA, ECCC, BOM and GDACS. You can turn off each source
• Pull down to refresh. The app also refreshes automatically when the data is old
 Places: 
• Search by city, postal code, coordinates or Plus Code
• Save favorites and swipe between them
• Location details card with the coordinates and the Plus Code
 Languages and display: 
• 8 languages: Malagasy, Arabic, English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Nepali and Chinese. Tap the flag to change the language
• Local digits for Arabic, Hindi and Nepali
• Right-to-left layout for Arabic
• 23 font pairs to choose from
• Share any card as an image
• Help and About pages
 Widgets: 
• Two home-screen widgets: compact (4x1) and detailed (4x2)
 Android TV: 
• The same app on your TV, made for the remote
• Current weather, hourly and 10-day forecasts, hourly and daily charts, alerts and air quality
 Privacy: 
• Your location is used only to get the weather
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• No personal data collected
• Free software (GNU AGPL v3 or later)

apple-macos:6808984060.name: Isai: Hi-Res Music Player
apple-macos:6808984060.description:
Isai is a music player for people who own their music.
Maybe it lives on MEGA. Maybe on Dropbox, a Nextcloud server, a Synology in the cupboard, or a folder on your phone. Connect it once and Isai reads the tags, builds a proper library with albums, artists and artwork, and streams straight from where the files are. Nothing goes through a server in between, and nothing is transcoded on the way.
WHAT PLAYS
FLAC, ALAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, Ogg Vorbis and Opus. DSF and DFF, including DST. Embedded lyrics and .lrc files scroll along with the song.
DSD goes through Isai's own engine. It goes out as DoP to a DAC that takes it, and is carefully converted to PCM for everything else. Playback is gapless, and you can turn on crossfade. Isai skips it wherever it would change the sound.
THE SIGNAL PATH
Tap the quality badge to see what happened between the file and the output: the source, the decoder, any processing, the device it went to, and a verdict. On the Mac, BIT PERFECT means exactly that. Isai can take exclusive access to your DAC and set its sample rate and word length to match the file. Then it reads those settings back from the hardware to make sure they stuck. If the equalizer is on, the verdict says so. If the audio was resampled, it says that too.
On iPhone and iPad, Isai asks an external DAC for the file's own rate and tells you what the system actually gave it, even when that isn't the answer you wanted.
PURE MUSIC ON IPHONE DUO
On an iPhone Duo, Isai can stop looking like an app and turn into a machine.
Choose a pocket cassette player, a portable CD player or a turntable, each modelled on the classics of the eighties, and the machine fills the screen. No tabs, no status bar. Fold the phone shut and the cover screen is the player in your hand, with the tape turning behind its little window or the disc spinning under the lid. Open it and your records sit on one page with the open machine on the other.
Underneath, it's the same library and the same signal path.
ONE LIBRARY, EVERY DEVICE
Add a source on your iPhone and it shows up on your Mac, your iPad and your Apple TV, already signed in. Favourites, playlists, play history and where you stopped in a track all sync through iCloud. So does the library itself: scan a source once and your other devices get the albums without reading the files again. Downloads keep the original files, run in the background, and wait for Wi-Fi if you ask them to.
PLAY ON
Two copies of Isai on the same Wi-Fi can control each other. Sit on the sofa with your phone and play through the Mac that's wired to the good DAC. The queue, the position and the Signal Path follow whichever device is making the sound. Nothing leaves your network and there's no account to create. Your own devices recognise each other through your Apple Account. Anything else has to be let in by hand, with a code shown on both screens.
ALSO
A ten-band equalizer with presets you can copy and rename. An A/B loop for the sixteen bars you're learning, or the cymbal decay you're judging a cable on, with saved loops that play one after another. Album editions, so the FLAC, the MP3 rip and the Apple Music copy of one record show up as a single album with the format shown once. Animated covers when a label ships them. And if you subscribe to Apple Music, it sits on the same shelf as the files you own.
ISAI PRO
Free for the music on your device and for Apple Music. Pro adds cloud sources (MEGA, Dropbox, WebDAV), Play On, Pure Music on iPhone Duo and the widgets. Monthly or Yearly, each with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or Lifetime: one payment that never renews. Bought Pro before? It's Lifetime and stays unlocked for good.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

flathub:app.drey.Haystack.name: Haystack
flathub:app.drey.Haystack.description:
Haystack is a small GNOME application for editing OpenQA needles. A
 needle is a screenshot on which areas have been marked that must match
 with the output of a system under test in OpenQA.
 The application works on a local needles repository. You open the
 repository folder, select a needle to edit, and start drawing. You can
 also change the screenshot, either from a local file, or copy-pasting one
 from elsewhere (for example a failed test in OpenQA).
 For any feedback, questions or general issues, please file an issue on
 the GitLab page.

flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.name: Time Cop
flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.summary: A time tracking app that respects your privacy and gets the job done without getting too fancy
flathub:ca.hamaluik.Timecop.description:
A time tracking app that respects your privacy and gets the job done without getting too fancy.
 Features:
 Offline-only, mobile-centric design
 Runs on Linux, iOS, and Android
 Fully private—there is no tracking / spying / advertising / etc
 Keep track of tasks with multiple parallel timers that can be started with the tap of a button
 Associate timers with projects to group your work (or don't)
 Start, stop, edit, and delete timers whenever with no fuss
 Export data as a .csv file, filtered by timespans and projects
 Export the app's database for full access to all of its data
 Automatic light mode / dark mode based on your device settings
 Localized in several languages (thanks to Google Translate): English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
 Open source (licensed under Apache-2.0)—fork away (https://github.com/hamaluik/timecop)

flathub:com.plexamp.Plexamp.name: Plexamp
flathub:com.plexamp.Plexamp.description:
Plexamp is the answer to the question "what would happen if you gave a handful of Plex music
 and pixel nerds a few cocktails and free rein to create the app of their dreams?"
 Plexamp is a beautiful, dedicated Plex music player with tons of goodies for audiophile purists,
 music curators, and music fans of all ages looking for their next aural fix.
 SUPER AUDIO PLAYER: Loudness leveling, true gapless playback, Sweet Fades™, soft transitions,
 a configurable preamp, a 10-band EQ, and more. Perfection for golden ears, buttery smooth touches
 for the rest of us. Custom pre-caching so your music keeps playing, because sometimes life brings
 you through tunnels.
 MUSIC TO YOUR EYES: Experience your music collection like you've never seen it before, with
 our UltraBlur backgrounds, over a dozen hypnotic visualizers, and four visual themes to satisfy
 every taste.
 FIND YOUR FIX: Radios built from your library and your cooler friends' collections. Travel through
 time, pick a style or mood, or listen album-by-album like the purist you are. Use the Mix Builder
 to explore and craft your perfect blend. Explore your personal charts and see what you were into
 last Fall or your top albums from the 60s.
 OFFLINE BLISS: Grab a few hours of your favorite playlist or stations with just a few taps.
 Download a custom mix or artist radio for the plane. Simple but powerful offline support for when
 you're in the woods or run out of cellular data.
 IT'S THE LITTLE THINGS: Powerful search. Playback activity history. Swipe-up play queue peeking.
 Fun artist explorations. As many settings and tweaks as our resident UXpert let us add.
 ENTERPRISE CLASS CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT: Just kidding. It's a music player.

flathub:io.github.insilmaril.vym.name: VYM
flathub:io.github.insilmaril.vym.summary: Tool for generating and manipulating mind maps
flathub:io.github.insilmaril.vym.description:
VYM (View Your Mind) allows you to organize your ideas easily and intuitively. It is a powerful
 personal task manager that lets you create mind maps and export them to multiple formats.

flathub:net.ankiweb.Anki.name: Anki
flathub:net.ankiweb.Anki.description:
Anki is a program which makes remembering things easy. Because it's a lot more efficient than
 traditional study methods, you can either greatly decrease your time spent studying, or greatly
 increase the amount you learn.
 Anyone who needs to remember things in their daily life can benefit from Anki. Since it is content-agnostic
 and supports images, audio, videos and scientific markup (via LaTeX), the possibilities are endless.
 Optional LaTeX support is provided by the TeX Live Flatpak extension org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.texlive.

flathub:net.codelogistics.letters.name: Letters
flathub:net.codelogistics.letters.description:
Letters is a modern, minimalist word processor for the GNOME desktop, with support
 for reading and writing DOCX, ODT, MD and HTML files.
 It can also export your documents as a PDF file.

flathub:org.gnome.Epiphany.name: Web
flathub:org.gnome.Epiphany.description:
The web browser for GNOME, featuring tight integration with the desktop and a simple and intuitive
 user interface that allows you to focus on your web pages. If you’re looking for a simple, clean,
 beautiful view of the web, this is the browser for you.
 Web is often referred to by its code name, Epiphany.

flathub:org.gnome.gedit.name: gedit
flathub:org.gnome.gedit.description:
gedit is an easy-to-use and general-purpose text editor. Its development started in 1998, at
 the beginnings of the GNOME project, with a good integration with that desktop environment.
 You can use it to write simple notes and documents, or you can enable more advanced features
 that are useful for software development.

flathub:org.kde.ksirk.name: KsirK
flathub:org.kde.ksirk.description:
KsirK is a computerized version of the well known strategic board game Risk. The goal of the
 game is simply to conquer the world by attacking your neighbors with your armies.
 Features:
 Support for 1-6 human or computer (AI) players
 Multi-player gaming over a network
 You can easily create new skins with SVG graphics and the skin editor
 Hot New Stuff support. You can easily download and install new skins

flathub:org.kde.ktouch.name: KTouch
flathub:org.kde.ktouch.description:
KTouch is a typewriter trainer for learning to touch type. It provides you with text to train
 on and adjusts to different levels depending on how good you are. It displays your keyboard and
 indicates which key to press next and which is the correct finger to use. You learn typing with
 all fingers, step by step, without having to look down at the keyboard to find your keys. It is
 convenient for all ages and the perfect typing tutor for schools, universities, and personal use.
 KTouch ships with dozens of different courses in many languages and a comfortable course editor.
 Different keyboard layouts are supported and new user-defined layouts can be created. During training,
 KTouch collects comprehensive statistical information to help you or your teacher to analyze your
 progress.

flathub:org.kde.lskat.name: LSkat
flathub:org.kde.lskat.summary: German card game Skat for two players
flathub:org.kde.lskat.description:
Lieutenant Skat (from German "Offiziersskat") is a fun and engaging card game for two players,
 where the second player is either live opponent, or a built in artificial intelligence.

flathub:org.qownnotes.QOwnNotes.name: QOwnNotes
flathub:org.qownnotes.QOwnNotes.description:
QOwnNotes is the open source (GPL) plain-text file notepad with Markdown support and todo list
 manager for GNU/Linux, Mac OS X and Windows by Patrizio Bekerle, that (optionally) works together

flathub:pl.nieto.fityk.name: Fityk
flathub:pl.nieto.fityk.description:
Fityk [fi:tik] is a program for data processing and nonlinear curve fitting.
 Primarily used:
 by scientists who analyse data from powder diffraction, chromatography, photoluminescence and photoelectron spectroscopy, infrared and Raman spectroscopy, and other experimental techniques,
 to fit peaks – bell-shaped functions (Gaussian, Lorentzian, Voigt, Pearson VII, bifurcated Gaussian, EMG, Doniach-Sunjic, etc.),
 but it is suitable for fitting any curve to 2D (x,y) data.

flathub:to.bnt.sendworm.name: Sendworm
flathub:to.bnt.sendworm.description:
Send files securely using Magic Wormhole.
 This is a cross-platform desktop app for sending files quickly and securely using the
 magic-wormhole protocol, which makes it compatible with other tools that use magic-wormhole.

flathub:xyz.aguno.CubeTimer.name: CubeTimer

flathub:xyz.aguno.CubeTimer.description:

 It does have generated scramble notation and record your

fedora-packages:festival/festvox-awb-arc.name: festvox-awb-arctic-hts
fedora-packages:festival/festvox-awb-arc.summary: Scottish-accent US English male speaker "AWB" for Festival
fedora-packages:festival/festvox-awb-arc.description: US English male speaker ("AWB") for Festival. AWB is a native Scottish English speaker, but the voice uses the US English front end. This is a HMM-based Speech Synthesis System (HTS) voice from the Nagoya Institute of Technology, trained using the CMU ARCTIC database. This voice is based on 1138 utterances spoken by a Scottish English male speaker. The speaker is very experienced in building synthetic voices and matched prompted US English, though his vowels are very different from US English vowels. Scottish English speakers will probably find synthesizers based on this voice strange. Unlike the other CMU_ARCTIC databases this was recorded in 16 bit 16KHz mono without EGG, on a Dell Laptop in a quiet office. The database was automatically labelled using CMU Sphinx using the FestVox labelling scripts. No hand correction has been made.

It provides HTML5, CSS3, JS, JSON, SVG and XML minifiers and an interface to implement any other minifier. Minification is the process of removing bytes from a file (such as whitespace) without changing its output and therefore shrinking its size and speeding up transmission over the internet and possibly parsing. It also gathers various system attributes such as cache and memory information. It primarily aims at helping applications with gathering information about modern computing hardware so as to exploit it accordingly and efficiently. hwloc may display the topology in multiple convenient formats. It also offers a powerful programming interface (C API) to gather information about the hardware, bind processes, and much more.

fedora-packages:lato-fonts/lato-fonts.name: lato-fonts
fedora-packages:lato-fonts/lato-fonts.description: Lato is a sanserif typeface family designed in the Summer 2010 by Warsaw-based designer Łukasz Dziedzic ("Lato" means "Summer" in Polish). In December 2010 the Lato family was published under the open-source Open Font License by his foundry tyPoland, with support from Google. When working on Lato, Łukasz tried to carefully balance some potentially conflicting priorities. He wanted to create a typeface that would seem quite "transparent" when used in body text but would display some original treats when used in larger sizes. He used classical proportions (particularly visible in the uppercase) to give the letterforms familiar harmony and elegance. At the same time, he created a sleek sanserif look, which makes evident the fact that Lato was designed in 2010 - even though it does not follow any current trend. The semi-rounded details of the letters give Lato a feeling of warmth, while the strong structure provides stability and seriousness. "Male and female, serious but friendly. With the feeling of the Summer," says Łukasz. Lato consists of nine weights (plus corresponding italics), including a beautiful hairline style. It covers 2300+ glyphs per style and supports 100+ Latin-based languages, 50+ Cyrillic-based languages as well as Greek and IPA phonetics.

The following sections of the specification impose library requirements: * 6.1: Supported Data Types * 6.2.3: Explicit Conversions * 6.2.4.2: Reinterpreting Types Using as_type() and as_typen() * 6.9: Preprocessor Directives and Macros * 6.11: Built-in Functionsj * 9.3: Double Precision Floating-Point * 9.4: 64-bit Atomics * 9.5: Writing to 3D image memory objects * 9.6: Half Precision Floating-Point libclc is intended to be used with the Clang compiler's OpenCL frontend. libclc is designed to be portable and extensible. To this end, it provides generic implementations of most library requirements, allowing the target to override the generic implementation at the granularity of individual functions. libclc currently only supports the PTX target, but support for more targets is welcome.

firefox-addons:3052170.name: Adblocker Zero
firefox-addons:3052170.summary: Fast, lightweight ad and tracker blocker. Blocks ads, banners and trackers using EasyList & EasyPrivacy.
firefox-addons:3052170.description:
Adblocker Zero removes ads and trackers from the web. No account, no setup, nothing to configure - install it and pages immediately load cleaner, faster and more private.
WHAT IT BLOCKS
• Banner ads, pop-ups, sticky overlays and sponsored clutter
• Ad and tracker requests — stopped before they ever leave your browser
• Trackers that follow you from site to site
• Includes defenses against anti-adblock scripts
WHY ADBLOCKER ZERO
• Truly lightweight: blocking runs on your browser's built-in engine, so there is no heavy background process slowing you down
• Private by design: no account, no telemetry, no data collection - your browsing history never leaves your device
• Free and open source (MIT license)
• Available in 52 languages
EVERYDAY CONTROLS
• One switch to pause blocking everywhere
• A per-site switch to trust sites you want to support
• A live counter of blocked requests
• Filter lists refresh automatically every day
FOR POWER USERS
• "My filters": add your own rules in EasyList-compatible syntax
• Manage your trusted-sites list
• Built on proven, community-maintained filter lists: EasyList,
 EasyPrivacy, Peter Lowe's list and more
PERMISSIONS, EXPLAINED
Adblocker Zero asks to read and change data on the websites you visit. That permission is used for exactly one thing: blocking ad and tracker requests and hiding ad elements on the page. The extension collects nothing and sends nothing; the only network requests it makes are the daily downloads of the public filter lists.

firefox-addons:2773533.description:
📣 The top-rated AI translation extension across the web! Immersive Translate (沉浸式翻译) supports web pages, PDFs, EPUBs, video subtitles, images, and manga translation. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

 🚀 Highlight to Translate: In the AI era, highlighting text is more than just a dictionary lookup. Get context-aware explanations that perfectly fit the current scenario.
 🚀 Input Box Translation: Type in your native language in any text box, hit Space three times, and it instantly translates to your target language. Unlock real-time bilingual conversations in ChatGPT, cross-lingual Google searches, and more.

🎞 Bilingual Video Subtitle Translation

firefox-addons:2920948.name: HoverTranslate - YouTube Subtitle Translator
firefox-addons:2920948.summary: Learn languages on YouTube: hover over a subtitle word to see its translation, save it to your word list. Free, no account needed.
firefox-addons:2920948.description:
HoverTranslate – a YouTube subtitle translator for learning languages from videos
Watching a video with Spanish or Japanese subtitles and hit a word you don't know? Just hover over it, and the translation appears right above the subtitles. The video pauses while you read and plays on as soon as you move the pointer away. No copying words into a translator, no losing the thread – you keep watching and understand more.
What HoverTranslate does:
• Translates single words and whole phrases. Found an idiom or a set expression? Hold Shift and sweep the pointer across the words. If you'd rather not hold Shift, you can switch that on in the settings.
• Builds your personal word list. Click a word, and it's saved together with its translation. Export the list as CSV or JSON to review your new words later.
• Works with auto-generated subtitles too – the ones YouTube creates itself – so videos without subtitles from the creator work as well.
• Not just on YouTube itself: when a video is embedded in a blog post, an online course or a news article, just hover over a word the same way.
• Handles Chinese, Japanese and Thai: even though they're written without spaces between words, you get the translation of one word, not the whole line.
• Translates into more than 240 languages and detects the subtitle language on its own.
• Blends in: the translation looks just like your YouTube subtitles. Want something different? Pick your own font, color and size.
• Fits the way you watch: auto-pause can be turned off, and a click can copy the word or its translation instead of saving it.
Translation that understands context
Choose Google, Bing or DeepL. With DeepL (you'll need your own free API key), each word is translated in the context of its whole subtitle line, so a word with several meanings gets the one it has there: "bank" in "we sat on the bank of the river" is a riverbank, not a bank. Your key is stored only on your device.
Free, with no sign-up
HoverTranslate is completely free: no accounts, no subscriptions, no ads. It's open source – the code is on GitHub.
Questions and suggestions: hovertranslate@gmail.com 
Source code: https://github.com/kozii-d/hover-translate 
Changelog: https://github.com/kozii-d/hover-translate/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md 
Install HoverTranslate, open any video with subtitles and hover over the first word you don't know. Enjoy watching!

bluejetty:00119657:ios.name: Teamup Calendar
bluejetty:00119657:ios.summary: Teamup is a shared calendar for groups. It helps share information and get jobs done efficiently. Use Teamup to organize people, schedule work, manage availability, and share events with your team or anyone in the world easily and securely.
bluejetty:00119657:ios.description:
Teamup is a shared calendar for groups. It helps share information and get jobs done efficiently. Use Teamup to organize people, schedule work, manage availability, and share events with your team or anyone in the world easily and securely.
Teamup can be accessed from mobile apps and web browsers from any device. A basic version is free and works well for small companies, teams, families, clubs, or for evaluation. Advanced features are available for groups with more complex use cases and large organizations.
Important: The Teamup app is a companion app of the browser-based version. The full administration interface is available only on the web browser. If you don't have a Teamup calendar already, go to https://www.teamup.com and create one. Configure it and invite users in Settings using the browser version. All users who have been granted access may use the calendar in a browser or using the app. 
Check out the tutorial and learn more at https://www.teamup.com/apps.
Key features
• View and update multiple sub-calendars for people and resources on one page.
• Centrally manage the calendar in the browser-based administration interface
• 9 levels of access permissions controlled by the calendar administrator (in the browser), allowing granular access for individual users or user groups. 
• Add custom fields with multiple field types (text, numbers, choice fields)
• Attach images and documents to calendar events
• Enable your users to sign up for events
• Assign one event to multiple sub-calendars
• Have discussions around calendar events using comments
• Powerful timezone support makes collaboration with users in different timezones painless
• Manage multiple calendars from a central dashboard
• Prevent double-bookings
• Integrate with maps
• Widget for home screen
• Offline read access
• Dark mode
• Teamup is available in more than 20 languages
Enterprise features
• Single-sign on
More information: https://www.teamup.com/apps

bluejetty:00090351:ios.description:
Discover the Amplified Bible (AMP), a unique English Bible translation that expands the meaning of Scripture through rich word explanations.
Looking for a Bible that helps you understand the deeper meaning behind God's Word? The Amplified Bible provides additional insights within the text, making it ideal for Bible study, personal devotion, church groups, and spiritual growth.
Unlike standard translations, the Amplified Bible includes expanded meanings of key words and phrases to help readers better understand the original biblical message. It is widely appreciated by students, teachers, and believers seeking a richer study experience.
With the Amplified Bible, explore God's Word with greater depth, clarity, and understanding.
Features:
- Daily Verse : Set reminders to receive daily notifications to read Bible verses.
- MY LIBRARY : Your personal space containing highlights, notes, and bookmarked favorite verses.
- Old & New Testaments : The app includes both the Old and New Testaments.
- Verse Editor : Pair Bible verses with beautiful backgrounds, create posts, and share on social media.
- Nearby Churches : Get information about nearby churches based on your location.
- Books : Access a wide collection of Christian eBooks.
- Wallpapers : Explore a variety of beautiful wallpapers.
- Videos : Watch videos on topics like Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
- Festive Calendar : View all Christian festivals and feast days.
- Popular Verse : Bible verses organized by topics like love, fear, peace, and more, including church etiquette and respectful conduct guidance.
- Customise Your Bible : Change font style and text color for a comfortable reading experience.
- 1000 Praises : A devotional recitation honoring God through a thousand titles and attributes.
- Bible Quotes : Shareable Bible quotes available in image and text formats.
- Bible Quiz : Test your Bible knowledge through quizzes.
- Bible Stories : Read timeless stories filled with wisdom and inspiration for all ages.
- Bible FAQ : Quick answers to common questions about the Bible and Christian living.
- Verses Comment : Share reflections and engage in discussions with the community.
- Help Desk : Raise support issues with photo attachments for faster assistance.
- Dictionary : Bible-based dictionary with cleaner layout and faster search for Biblical terms.
- Dreams Meanings : Understand dreams through Christian teachings and Biblical perspectives.
- Word Highlights : Highlight specific words or letters for deeper study and meditation.
- App Activity : Track streaks, reading time, refresh count, and overall usage.
- Products : Browse Bible-related products directly inside the app.
- VerseBot : AI-powered verse explanation bot for meanings, copying, and sharing.
- Common Notification History : View all past notifications in one place.
- Did You Know? : Daily bite-sized facts about the Bible and Christian faith.
- Bible Verse Clips : Continuous feed of short Bible-based inspirational clips shared by the community.
- Prayer Request : Submit prayer requests and receive community support through prayers and interactions.
- Nearby Events : Discover Christian gatherings, services, and celebrations near you.
- Chapter-Wise Video Learning : Watch scripture videos linked to each Bible chapter for deeper learning.
- Interactive Bible Games : Play scripture-based games like SlideScript and VerseHunt.
- Bible Clips : Watch short, inspiring biblical clips from the faith community.
- Bible Streaks : Keep your daily Bible reading streak going strong every day.
- Background Music : Enjoy peaceful background music while reading the Bible.
- Alarm : Set reminders and get alerts for activities scheduled within the app.
- Mark as Read Quiz : Explore quizzes designed around the verses you have finished reading.
- Audio Bible Speed Control : Adjust the audio pace to listen at your preferred speed.

bluejetty:00144745:ios.description:
מה זה אומר לחנות חכם? 
איך זה בא לידי ביטוי? 
כאשר אנחנו ממהרים, אנו רוצים לחנות קרוב ככל האפשר למקום היעד ולדעת שעוד יש מקומות פנויים כשאיננו בלחץ של זמן - אנחנו מוכנים לחפש חַניון במחיר אטרקטיבי יותר וללכת כמה עשרות מטרים. 
אפליקציית סנטרל פארק החדשה באה לסדר לנו חנייה. 
מהיום כבר לא צריך לנחש איפה נמצא חניון פנוי, וכמה זה יעלה. 
האפליקציה החכמה מאפשרת לנו להכניס את היעד שאליו נרצה להגיע ולראות בצורה מסודרת 
את החניונים הפנויים באזור, לפי מרחק ומחיר.
כאשר כל האפשרויות לפנינו נוכל לבחור את החַניון המושלם לנו, בין אם זה חניון צמוד ליעד במקרה שאנחנו ממהרים, או חניון זול יותר באזור במקרה שנרצה ללכת מעט ולחסוך עד עשרות שקלים בכל חנייה. 
משתמשי האפליקציה נהנים מתשלום מהיר באמצעות הטלפון, ללא התעסקות ובלי צורך לצאת מהרכב, מריכוז חשבוניות קל ויעיל וממבצעים והטבות לאורך כל השנה. 
האפליקציה חינמית, פשוטה להורדה וקלה לתפעול. 
ריכוז חשבוניות >> בכל פעם שאתם נכנסים לחנייה, אנחנו שומרים עבורכם חשבונית מסודרת עם כתובת החניון ושעות החנייה המדויקות כדי שתוכלו לקבל תמונה מלאה של היסטוריית החנייה שלכם.
מבצעים והטבות >> לאורך השנה סנטרל פארק תייצר לכם הטבות מיוחדות על חנייה ברחבי המרכז, בחגים, באירועים מיוחדים, ולפעמים סתם כי בא לנו לפרגן לכם בחזרה. 
תשלום מהיר >> לזכור לא לאבד את הכרטיס, לחפש את מכונת התשלום, לאבד את הכרטיס, למצוא אותו ברגע האחרון, לשלם במכונה, לרוץ חזרה לרכב... מהיום שמים לזה סוף - פשוט פותחים את האפליקציה, מגיעים אל השער, מאשרים את התשלום ויוצאים…
סנטרל פארק היא חברת החַניונים המתקדמת בישראל, עם יותר מ-60 חניונים ברחבי הארץ ו-35 חַניונים בתל אביב. 
החַניונים של סנטרל פארק מתוחזקים ברמה הגבוהה ביותר, ונמצאים באזורים המרכזיים ביותר. 
אנו עושים הכול כדי שחוויית החנייה שלכם תהיה קלה ונעימה ככל האפשר, ומשקיעים מאמצים רבים בשירות לקוחות מהיר ואיכותי לקהל לקוחותינו.

bluejetty:00187225:ios.summary: Shyft empowers employees to swap their shifts, message team members, and manage schedules, all from their mobile device. Every day, users rely on Shyft to help make real time adjustments to their work schedule and stay connected with their
bluejetty:00187225:ios.description:
Shyft empowers employees to swap their shifts, message team members, and manage schedules, all from their mobile device. Every day, users rely on Shyft to help make real time adjustments to their work schedule and stay connected with their team.
Whether you need one important shift covered, or you are looking to broadcast thousands of shifts, Shyft is here to help.
VIEW YOUR WORK SCHEDULE
Access and manage your work schedule on your mobile device. View shifts you are working, all shift details, and get push notification reminders before each shift.
FIND COVERAGE FOR YOUR SHIFT
Can’t make it to work? No problem! Post your shift on the Shift Marketplace and find coverage from another team member. Once a manager approves, you are off the hook!
PICK UP EXTRA WORK SHIFTS
Looking to earn extra income? Pick up shifts by browsing available work opportunities on the Shift Marketplace. Tap on a shift to apply. Once you are approved, head in to work!
COMMUNICATE WITH YOU TEAM
Stay connected without trading phone numbers with your coworkers. Access the Community tab to send direct messages or post multimedia on team channels.
REQUEST TIME OFF
Make time off requests for days you need off in your calendar. View accrual balances, and submit the request for managers to approve.
TAKE VOLUNTARY TIME OFF
When VTO opportunities are made available, tap to apply and offer to take the day off. Once approved, enjoy your day off!
ADMIN FEATURES:
POST OPEN SHIFTS
Broadcast 1 or 100s of open shifts with the tap of a button. If you need team members to work, post a shift, add a description, and select the group. Then manage applications as they come in.
APPROVE AND DENY SHIFTS
Review and approve or deny shift swap applications between team members, and for manager posted shifts. Manage multiple applications all on one shift card.
VIEW TEAM ROSTERS
Manage the daily roster and see which employees are working when. View job positions and shift start/end times. Add Open Shifts and VTOs directly from the roster card.
POST ANNOUNCEMENTS
Post announcements with read receipts. Send announcements to your location on a team channel, and see who has marked the announcement as read.
SHARE PHOTO SCHEDULES

bluejetty:00145420:ios.name: TOM Medication & Pill Reminder
bluejetty:00145420:ios.summary: TOM is your cost-free, ad-free and anonymous, daily medication reminder with an integrated medicine list and log, that makes it easy for you to manage your medicine and allows you to enter measurements and record activities. The TOM medical
bluejetty:00145420:ios.description:
TOM is your cost-free, ad-free and anonymous, daily medication reminder with an integrated medicine list and log, that makes it easy for you to manage your medicine and allows you to enter measurements and record activities. The TOM medical alert app is a fully integrated medical assistant with a daily pill reminder.
With our medical alert app, you can add a new medicine to your virtual medication list in just seconds. Your medical assistant TOM does the rest for you. With our pill reminder app, you will forget about any registration, charge, and advertising!
User-friendly and completely anonymous: the integrated medicine reminder will notify you whenever it’s time to take your pills, tablets, and other meds, making your daily activities much simpler. Now for measurements and activities as well, including graphs and statistics showing everything at a glance.
Developed by patients, for patients
The TOM medication reminder with the integrated medicine list and medication log is so practical and user-friendly because its developers know from personal experience which requirements a digital medication tracker and scheduler need to meet. The pill reminder is the ideal solution for simply and efficiently managing treatment regimens for a wide range of conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, Crohn’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, cardiovascular diseases, multiple sclerosis, and more.
Key features of the medical alert app at a glance
• Easy to use thanks to dialogue-based design: TOM asks and you reply – without filling in forms or having to tediously search through menus
• Add new meds, measurements, or activities quickly and easily
• Send or print PDFs of monthly health reports
• Medication log and medicine list with high-quality graphs and statistics for all pills taken, health measurements, and activities
• Feature for uploading your own pictures of med packaging
• Digital cabinet provides a complete medication list that can be printed out as a PDF file
• Pill reminder with alarm to refill prescriptions before they run out or expire
• Fully integrated treatment management that combines a record of meds you have taken with your health measurements (blood pressure and weight, for example) and activities (running, yoga, etc.)
• Keep your medication log up to date: pills are taken daily, medicine intervals of several days or hours, single doses or taken sporadically
• Suitable for managing the treatment of a wide range of conditions and diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, multiple sclerosis, stroke, asthma, etc.)
• Modern solution for managing medicine in order to ensure they are taken at the right time and to monitor the progress of your treatment
• Medication reminder if you forget to take your pills
• Maximum data security thanks to the anonymous use of the TOM pill reminder and two-way encryption
Privacy and data protection are top priority
Using the TOM medication tracker and scheduler is completely anonymous: no registration with personal details is required. The information you enter is linked only to a randomly generated ID number. Even TOM does not have access to this number, as it is also cryptographically protected. In addition, all communication with the TOM app is encrypted in both directions.
Download the TOM medication reminder on your smartphone and let the simple medication tracker and scheduler add some extra freedom to your daily life. Never forget to take your tablets, pills, or medicine again thanks to the pill reminder and medicine tracker. Suitable for a wide range of conditions, including high blood pressure, asthma, stroke, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, etc.
SUBMIT YOUR FEEDBACK TO HELP IMPROVE TOM
Thank you for using the TOM medical alert app. Your feedback helps us to further develop the TOM medication reminder and offer you maximum benefit. We always encourage you to send your suggestions and ideas to support@tommedications.com.

bluejetty:00156560:ios.description:
YOUR FASHION SUPERPOWER IN YOUR POCKET!
Our app puts your whole wardrobe at your fingertips. Upload everything. What you love. What’s a bit ‘meh’. What goes with what. What needs a little love. We’ll connect you with a whole clothes care network to help make the most of what you own. 
We’re not just a digital wardrobe app! We can help you access a range of on-demand local aftercare services, including alterations, repairs, eco-cleaning, customisation and upcycling of clothes, thereby extending the life of garments. Our app also uses artificial intelligence to allow garments to be easily scanned, identified and stored in users’ virtual wardrobes, which ultimately helps reduce unnecessary repeat purchases.
Save Your Wardrobe is driving a systemic change with a pioneering yet practical solution that brings together global brands, local businesses and consumers everywhere.
With our app, you can: 
Effortlessly upload your wardrobe! Take pictures of your garments, remove the background and personalise your digital wardrobe with our selection of background colours.
Get creative with our outfit collage feature! You can easily curate and showcase your fashion sense, and experiment with endless outfit combinations in just a few taps!
Organise your wardrobe! Label your items and place them in relevant folders. 
Build outfits for every occasion and schedule them into your calendar! It’s time to say goodbye to hectic outfit planning. 
Access a curated eco-system of aftercare services to make the most of your wardrobe! Choose from a selection of cleaning, repairs, alterations, upcycling and customisation services. 
Decode your wardrobe and gain insights into your most worn brands, colours, items as well as understanding the impact these pieces have via their Good on You rating.
Gain deeper insight into your shopping habits and unlock a more circular mindset.
Get inspired by our blog that features interviews with changemakers, sustainable wardrobe tips, and so much more!

bluejetty:00098223:ios.description:
Otium Mahjong: A Zen-Inspired Wafū Tile-Matching Journey
Step into a world where puzzle games for adults meet meditative beauty. In Otium Mahjong, traditional Wafū aesthetics blend seamlessly with the timeless logic of mahjong solitaire, offering a uniquely peaceful tile game experience. Each tile is a masterpiece of Eastern artistry, and every level invites you to unwind, strategize, and connect with the serene spirit of Wafū. Whether you're a fan of matching games, strategy games, or just seeking a mindful retreat, this is your moment of stillness. 
Who Is It For?
- Mahjong Enthusiasts: Whether you're a seasoned player or discovering mahjong free games for the first time, Wafū Mahjong offers a fresh perspective through its culturally rich, immersive gameplay. It's especially great for those who enjoy immersive gameplay during their leisure time, be it on a coffee break or a long commute.
- Stress-Free Gamers: Escape daily chaos with no timers, no ads, and a soothing soundtrack designed to calm the mind. With each tile matched, you'll find a little more calm.
- Puzzle & Strategy Masters: Inspired by the best of board games and memory games, test your skills with hundreds of handcrafted levels, escalating in complexity to keep your brain engaged.
- Matching Game Lovers: Fans of zen match, dominos game, and other tile-based logic games will appreciate the balance of focus and flow.
- Culture Explorers: Discover Kyoto’s tranquil gardens, ukiyo-e motifs, and seasonal wonders through stunning visuals that evolve like a living scroll.
How to Play
- Match & Relax: Tap pairs of identical Wafū-themed tiles to clear the board.
- Strategic Freedom: Only unblocked tiles can be matched—plan moves wisely to unlock bonus combos!
- Difficulty Changes: As you progress through the levels, the puzzles become more challenging, testing your observation and strategic thinking skills. 
Why You’ll Love It
- Authentic Wafū Atmosphere. The matching process is not only a mental exercise but also a visual treat.
- 100+ intricately designed tiles inspired by ink paintings, samurai symbols, and nature.
- Dynamic seasonal backgrounds: Sakura petals fall in spring, autumn leaves rustle, and snow blankets tranquil temples in winter.
- Soothing soundtrack featuring traditional shamisen, shakuhachi, and koto melodies.
Mindful Modes for Every Mood
- Zen Mode: Unwind with endless, timer-free matching—perfect for meditation.
- Daily Challenge: Sharpen your mind with new puzzles and collect bouquets to feel the artistic conception and connotation of Japanese Ikebana!
- More Games: Daily login bonuses and seasonal events keep the experience fresh and exciting.
Designed for Comfort & Accessibility
- Extra-large tiles and a clean, elegant layout make it easy to enjoy—ideal for long sessions, seniors, or anyone who prefers a stress-free experience. Beautifully optimized and completely free for iPad or iPhone, whether you're playing on a large screen at home or on your phone during travel.
- Fully offline—play anywhere, anytime, no Wi-Fi needed.
- Hint, Shuffle & Undo Tools: Stuck? Use smart aids to breeze through tough levels.
Download Otium Wafū Mahjong Today! If you love the quiet focus of tile-matching games, the strategic depth of board games, or the peaceful rhythm of zen match experiences, Otium Mahjong is your perfect companion! 
Let the elegance of Wafū guide your fingertips and bring clarity to your day. Begin your mindful puzzle mahjong journey now.
Got some trouble with our games, questions or ideas?
For support or feedback: otiumgamestudio@outlook.com

bluejetty:00185221:ios.description:
The life of every party.
The easiest way to run a professional photo booth at your next wedding, birthday, or event. Just download, set up in minutes, and let your guests have the time of their lives. LumaBooth runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Windows, perfect whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned pro.
LUMABOOTH DASHBOARD
Configure your entire event from any browser before you even arrive. Templates, overlays, backgrounds, settings, all ready and waiting on every device. No IT skills. No on-site setup. Just arrive. iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Windows with dslrBooth. No other photo booth platform brings iOS and Windows together like this.
AI PORTRAITS
Turn your guests into superheroes, vintage oil paintings, 3D characters, and more. Over 170 styles, no green screen, no complicated setup. One tap and every guest leaves with something they've never seen before.
PHOTO BOOTH
• Hundreds of pre-made photo layouts and templates, no design skills needed, just pick and go
• Customize with stickers, filters, and LUTs right from the booth
• GIF, boomerang, and slow-motion built in, no extra setup
• Print wirelessly with AirPrint or connect DNP, Citizen, and HiTi printers directly over USB
• Remove any background with AI or green screen, any venue becomes the perfect venue
360 AND VIDEO BOOTH
• High-quality video and slow-motion capture
• Animated and static overlays, pre-roll and post-roll videos
• 240fps on recent iPads and iPhones
• Video stabilization
• Motion-triggered sessions, no attendant needed
KEY FEATURES
• Works with cameras you already own, Canon, Sony, and Nikon supported
• Video and audio prompts guide guests through every step so your booth runs itself
• Fully customizable start screen, no coding, no design tools required
• Guests relive the event through a branded online gallery, automatically created for every event photography session
• Surveys and disclaimers built in for lead capture and compliance
• Wireless remote trigger, stay with your clients, not behind the booth
SHARING
• Guests share instantly via email, SMS, AirDrop, QR code, WhatsApp, and Instagram, online or offline
• LumaShare for iPad and tablets turns any tablet into a dedicated sharing station with live slideshow
SUBSCRIPTION
LumaBooth requires a subscription for unlimited events with no watermark.
• Monthly subscription: $19.99 USD
• Charged to your Apple ID at confirmation
• Auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage in Apple ID Account Settings

Are you ready? Let's go on over to Baby Panda's Car World!
CAR CUSTOMIZATION
In the car world, there are almost 30 models of cars. Choose your favorite model and customize it to your liking! After assembling all the parts, you can drive the car around and experience the freedom never before.
ENDLESS CONSTRUCTION
Drive farm vehicles to harvest crops. Build bakeries or dessert factories. Turn the small-town farm into a grand manor with everything you need. Operate construction vehicles to reclaim land, build your dream city!
MAGICAL EXPERIENCE
Wear a police uniform, chase after thieves, watch for crime, and keep residents safe. Startup the bus and take the kids where they need to go, Roleplay as different jobs, and make your own story.
Drive a car that you love and experience unlimited joy in Baby Panda's Car World

bluejetty:00026394:ios.description:
«Fill the fridge» — is a casual organization game. You can take all your groceries from the supermarket, restock them, and sorting them up the way you like in the fridge! Start to organizing and fill up using different objects, groceries, beverages and many more items in refrigerator shelves and try to fit them all. Playing, you will have a great time arranging and stocking your products in the mini freezer.
FILL UP ALL 
Do you want to master your sorting skills? The organize game about replenishing the freezer will appeal to those who like to put things in order at home. Organize your freezer shelf space by put in dozens of mouth-watering foods in the right order for you. 
HOW TO PLAY
Try starting fill up fridge organizing! Unpack food boxes, find the perfect spots, and fill up your refrigerator with fresh groceries. A good restock strategy can allow you to put more groceries in the limited space of the refrigerator!
START THE FRIDGE ORGANIZATION
Restocking into the freezer has never been so fun and fast: sort a variety of products on the same level will take a few minutes. 
- Pass the game levels and unlock new 3d products: vegetables, fruits, various types of soda, and delicious cakes are waiting for you inside. 
- You can sort foods and prepared meals in boxes by colors, type, and size. 
- After successfully passing the level, each subsequent one becomes more difficult. 
- In just 10 minutes a day, a casual puzzle game will greatly train your brain and logic. 
- Can be played offline. You don't need the internet to play.
- Play with only one finger control.
«Fill the fridge» — one of the organization games that will make it possible for you to put things in order in your tidy life. Play and relax on the way to work or escape from everyday problems after a hard day. Receive the positive effects of the puzzle game and gain useful skills to use it in real life. Start organizing the refrigerator like a master! Play now: restock, organize and sorting food in «Fill the fridge» game!

bluejetty:00092456:ios.name: Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide
bluejetty:00092456:ios.summary:
Embark on a unique journey of discovery with your Rolls-Royce. Whatever your destination might be, the Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide will enhance your knowledge of your Rolls-Royce* and make every journey an effortless pleasure.
With just one
bluejetty:00092456:ios.description:
Embark on a unique journey of discovery with your Rolls-Royce. Whatever your destination might be, the Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide will enhance your knowledge of your Rolls-Royce* and make every journey an effortless pleasure.
With just one click, you will see how to operate the vehicle and its equipment. Explanatory animations, image searches, answers to frequently asked questions and much more complete the app.
By entering the vehicle identification number (VIN), the appropriate model-specific vehicle information is downloaded and is also available offline. You can manage multiple vehicles within the Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide. 
If you don’t have a vehicle identification number (VIN) then simply explore the Rolls-Royce demo vehicle.
The Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide at a glance:
• Complete, model-specific Owner’s Handbook, including navigation, communication and entertainment
• Explanatory animations
• Explanation on indicator and warning lights
• Brief information
• 360° View: Explore interactively the interior and exterior of your Rolls-Royce model
• Search by topics
• Search by vehicle pictures to find functions
• Answers to frequently asked questions (FAQ)
• Once downloaded, the Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide can also be used offline
* The Rolls-Royce Vehicle Guide was developed exclusively for the following models: 
• G H O S T as of model year 2013 
• W R A I T H as of model year 2013
• D A W N as of model year 2016
• P H A N T O M as of model year 2017
• C U L L I N A N as of model year 2018
• S P E C T R E as of model year 2023
Supplementary information can be found in other brochures in the on-board documentation. 
The more familiar you are with the vehicle, the more confident you are on the road.
Rolls-Royce wishes you a pleasant and safe driving.

bluejetty:00083385:ios.description:
"Phase Rummy Classic Card Party" is a captivating mobile adaptation of the beloved card game, Phase 10. Tailored for fans of strategic card games, this offline version allows you to enjoy the classic rummy-style challenges at your own pace, anywhere, anytime.
**Key Features:**
1. **Engaging Offline Gameplay:** Experience the fun of Phase 10 without the need for an internet connection. Play against sophisticated AI opponents, offering a challenge for both seasoned players and beginners.
2. **Variety of Phases:** Progress through 10 distinct phases, each with unique requirements. Master the art of collecting sets, runs, and combinations to advance.
3. **Customizable Experience:** Personalize your gameplay with a range of avatars and themes. Make your game uniquely yours.
4. **Easy to Learn:** Whether you're new to Phase 10 or a long-time fan, the game's intuitive tutorials and simple interface make it easy to pick up and play.
5. **Family-Friendly Entertainment:** Suitable for all ages, this game is perfect for a family game night or solo play. Its simple rules and engaging gameplay make it a hit for all.
"Phase Rummy Classic Card Party" brings the classic fun of Phase 10 into a convenient, mobile format. It's the perfect game for card game enthusiasts looking to enjoy a rummy-style challenge without the need for an internet connection. Download now and immerse yourself in the world of Phase Rummy!

bluejetty:00027368:ios.description:
Zone 2 app tracks how much of your weekly workout time is performed in the zone 2 heart rate range, typically between 60-70% of your maximum heart rate. 
Aiming for 150 minutes or more of weekly exercise in zone 2 is recommended, as it optimizes endurance, enhances fat-burning efficiency, and fosters sustainable fitness gains by maintaining a balance between intensity and recovery. The optimal number of minutes to spend in zone 2 per week can vary based on individual fitness levels.
_____________________
If you do not have an Apple Watch, you can connect common Bluetooth heart rate monitors, such as the Polar H10, Garmin chest strap, and new Garmin watches, to view your heart rate zone progress live during a workout.
If you have an Apple Watch, use the Apple Watch app to see zones live on your wrist with haptic feedback, Siri announcements, and health metrics.
If you already have a different app you like for tracking workouts, no worries; Zone 2 uses all workouts saved to your device with heart rate data to calculate your weekly zone minutes.
*** Features Include ***
• Weekly, monthly, & daily zone tracking based on your weekly goal with multiple chart viewing options
• Strava connectivity to upload Zone 2 created distance workouts to your Strava profile
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for weekly Zone 2 goal progress
• Compatibility with common Bluetooth heart rate monitors for live zone reporting during workouts with optional audio feedback
• Apple Watch app with live zone total calculations, multiple workout screens, and optional haptic feedback and alerts
• Apple Watch to iPhone mirroring during live workouts to see heart rate on the larger iPhone screen
• Zone goal or open goal modes for tracking workouts
• Heart rate zone calculator
• Live activities on the Dynamic Island or Lock Screen
_____________________
What is zone 2 heart rate training?
Zone 2 training refers to exercise performed at a moderate intensity that keeps your heart rate in a specific heart rate zone, typically between 60-70% of your maximum heart rate. This is the heart rate zone where your body is able to utilize oxygen most efficiently, which can lead to a range of benefits for your fitness and health.
Zone 2 training is important for a number of reasons, including:
• Improved aerobic capacity: By training in the zone 2 heart rate range, your body becomes more efficient at using oxygen to produce energy, which can improve your overall aerobic capacity.
• Increased fat burning: During moderate-intensity exercise, your body relies more on fat as a source of fuel, which can help to improve your body composition and reduce body fat.
• Improved cardiovascular health: Regular exercise in the zone 2 heart rate range can help to strengthen your heart and improve blood flow, which can reduce the risk of heart disease.
• Increased endurance: Training at a moderate intensity can help to improve your endurance and stamina, which can be particularly helpful for endurance athletes such as long-distance runners or cyclists.

bluejetty:00186920:ios.name: AnkiMobile Flashcards
bluejetty:00186920:ios.summary: AnkiMobile is a mobile companion to Anki®, a powerful, intelligent flashcard program that is free, multi-platform, and open-source. Sales of this app support the development of both the computer and mobile version, which is why the app is p
bluejetty:00186920:ios.description:
AnkiMobile is a mobile companion to Anki®, a powerful, intelligent flashcard program that is free, multi-platform, and open-source. Sales of this app support the development of both the computer and mobile version, which is why the app is priced as a computer application.
AnkiMobile was written by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, and it has been around since 2010. Beware other apps using "Anki" in their name that have sprung up recently - they are not compatible with the rest of the Anki ecosystem, and they offer far fewer features, despite charging expensive subscriptions.
Some of AnkiMobile's features include:
- A free cloud synchronization service that lets you keep your card content synchronized across multiple mobile and computer devices. This makes it easy to add content on a computer and then study it on your mobile, easily keep your study progress current between an iPhone and iPad, and so on.
- The same SM2 and FSRS scheduling algorithms that the computer version of Anki uses, which remind you of material as you're about to forget it.
- A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study. You can set up AnkiMobile to perform different actions when you tap or swipe on various parts of the screen, and control which actions appear on the tool buttons.
- Comprehensive graphs and statistics about your studies.
- Support for large card decks - even 100,000+ cards.
- If your cards use images or audio clips, the media is stored on your device, so you can study without an internet connection.
- A powerful search facility that allows you to find cards that match criteria such as 'tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days and not containing the following words', and automatically place them into a deck to study.
- Support for displaying mathematical equations with MathJax, and rendering LaTeX created with the computer version.
- Support for adding images drawn with the Apple Pencil to your cards.
Please note that AnkiMobile is currently intended as a companion to the computer version of Anki, rather than a complete replacement for it. While AnkiMobile is able to display and schedule your cards in the same way the computer version does, certain changes like modifying note types need to be done with the computer software. Add-ons are not supported, so while you can study image occlusion cards created with the computer version, they can not be created within AnkiMobile. For this reason, please start with the computer version of Anki before you think about buying this app.
The cloud synchronization service is optional, and data can also be imported/exported from the app via a USB cable or AirDrop.

listings.name: AnkiMobile Flashcards
listings.description:
AnkiMobile is a mobile companion to Anki®, a powerful, intelligent flashcard program that is free, multi-platform, and open-source. Sales of this app support the development of both the computer and mobile version, which is why the app is priced as a computer application.

AnkiMobile was written by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, and it has been around since 2010. Beware other apps using "Anki" in their name that have sprung up recently - they are not compatible with the rest of the Anki ecosystem, and they offer far fewer features, despite charging expensive subscriptions.

Some of AnkiMobile's features include:

- A free cloud synchronization service that lets you keep your card content synchronized across multiple mobile and computer devices. This makes it easy to add content on a computer and then study it on your mobile, easily keep your study progress current between an iPhone and iPad, and so on.
- The same SM2 and FSRS scheduling algorithms that the computer version of Anki uses, which remind you of material as you're about to forget it.
- A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study. You can set up AnkiMobile to perform different actions when you tap or swipe on various parts of the screen, and control which actions appear on the tool buttons.
- Comprehensive graphs and statistics about your studies.
- Support for large card decks - even 100,000+ cards.
- If your cards use images or audio clips, the media is stored on your device, so you can study without an internet connection.
- A powerful search facility that allows you to find cards that match criteria such as 'tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days and not containing the following words', and automatically place them into a deck to study.
- Support for displaying mathematical equations with MathJax, and rendering LaTeX created with the computer version.
- Support for adding images drawn with the Apple Pencil to your cards.

Please note that AnkiMobile is currently intended as a companion to the computer version of Anki, rather than a complete replacement for it. While AnkiMobile is able to display and schedule your cards in the same way the computer version does, certain changes like modifying note types need to be done with the computer software. Add-ons are not supported, so while you can study image occlusion cards created with the computer version, they can not be created within AnkiMobile. For this reason, please start with the computer version of Anki before you think about buying this app.

The cloud synchronization service is optional, and data can also be imported/exported from the app via a USB cable or AirDrop.

Like all apps, AnkiMobile can be purchased once and then used on multiple devices in a household using the same Apple ID. Family sharing is also supported (apart from in India). For information on bulk discounts for educational institutions, please see Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

For more information on AnkiMobile, including a link to the online manual, please have a look at the support page: https://docs.ankimobile.net/support.html. If you have any questions or want to report an issue, please let us know on our support site and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

bluejetty:00014769:ios.description:
Turn your portfolio into a dividend paycheck. Stocks Live projects your income for the year ahead — with confidence scores and a month-by-month payment calendar — so you always know what's coming.
Fourteen years in the market, no ads, and the deepest toolset on the App Store. Track what you own, discover what's next, and manage unlimited portfolios across every major market — securely synced to all your devices.
DIVIDEND INCOME, PROJECTED
• See your projected annual dividend income, with Low / Medium / High confidence based on each stock's payment history.
• A payment calendar by month or by holding — declared and estimated payouts, a year ahead.
• Automatic suspended-dividend detection, so a cut never surprises you.
• Full dividend history per holding, plus an ex-dividend and earnings calendar.
PORTFOLIOS WITHOUT THE HASSLE
Skip the transaction logging. Enter your current positions, update them when they change — that's it.
• Unlimited multi-currency portfolios and watch lists, aggregated to your home currency.
• Stocks, ETFs, funds, options, RSUs, DRIP, shorts and 10,000+ cryptocurrencies.
• Bulk-paste holdings, adjust splits across every portfolio, benchmark against any ticker.
• Allocation by sector, industry, region or any metric; tag portfolios for family or groups.
• What-if scenarios, threshold alerts, and short- vs long-term performance with annualized returns.
PRICE ALERTS THAT LIVE ON YOUR DEVICE
• Set above / below alerts on any ticker — checked privately on device, no account required.
• Local notifications the moment they fire.
• Peek at Community Alerts: anonymous levels other investors are watching, for crowd-sourced support and resistance.
RESEARCH & DISCOVERY
• 1,000+ market scanners, scans and filters for stocks, ETFs and crypto — find your next idea.
• Real-time quotes* with extended hours, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds.
• Global coverage rivaling Yahoo! Finance — US, China, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong and more.
• IPO center, earnings estimates, curated gurus, and 140+ trusted news feeds.
• A company card for every ticker: quote, charts, events, notes, social and news in one place.
CHARTS WORTH FRAMING
• Full-screen charts from intraday to inception — line, bar or candle, log or linear.
• Moving averages, Bollinger Bands, Parabolic SAR, volume and split overlays.
• Compare any group side by side across 70+ data points.
• A signature heat map with dancing tiles, in dark or light.
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for day performance, value and top holdings.
• An Apple Watch app for your portfolios at a glance.
• Built-in StockTwits — read the feed, post with charts, follow the sentiment.
• Rich notes per company: text, charts, photos or voice memos.
PRIVATE & SYNCED
• iCloud keeps portfolios, watch lists, alerts and notes in sync across all your devices.
• Passcode and Face ID / Touch ID protection. No ads, ever.
“The Best Stock Market App for iPhone and iPad.” — TheBalance.com

Stocks Live is free to download, with unlimited portfolios, quotes, charts and scanners. A subscription unlocks dividend forecasting, price alerts, StockTwits, company notes, widgets and the Apple Watch app.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://stocksliveapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.stocksliveapp.com/termsofuse.html
* Real-time quotes cover Nasdaq, NYSE and select UK, German, French and Netherland listings; subscription required for some markets.

bluejetty:00040579:ios.description:
Ready to elevate your word power? The key to successfully expanding your vocabulary is learning new words in a way that stimulates your attention. Studies show that the most effective way to learn new words is with an app specifically designed for that purpose.
With our C1 - Learn Advanced Vocabulary app, you can:
Learn new words with minimal time investment: Simply scroll through your phone.
Choose your own level of difficulty: Based on your current language mastery.
Select vocabulary categories: That best suit your needs and interests.
Speak and write more concisely and confidently: With the right word at your fingertips.
Meet your linguistic goals at your own pace: Customize the app’s features to make it work for you.
The C1 - Learn Advanced Vocabulary app will turn learning and retaining new words into a fun activity that will allow you to impress your friends and co-workers.
Stop being addlepated with unknown words! Don’t know what ‘addlepated’ means? Get a step ahead. While others are looking up definitions, you already know the answer.
Embark on an exciting journey into the lexical world with C1 - Learn Advanced Vocabulary.
To get started, take a quick vocab test to see how many words you already know. Now you are all set to begin learning new academic, obscure, and challenging vocabulary today, and every day.
Whether you are a native English speaker preparing for the SAT or GRE test, an ESL learner studying for IELTS or TOEFL, or someone who loves to geek out on words, C1 - Learn Advanced Vocabulary has got you covered.
App Features:
Learn Advanced Vocabulary Faster: With C1 level flashcards in English, Turkish, German, Italian, French, and Spanish.
Daily Notifications: Set up the best time to receive daily word notifications.
Customizable Widgets: Learn and revise recently discovered words.
Store Your Favorite Words: Create your own word collection.
Improve Your Language Skills: Ace your tests, improve writing and public speaking, read scientific articles effortlessly, and sound more articulate.
Designed by a team of corpus linguists, the app’s state-of-the-art word recommendation system will suggest words tailored to your vocabulary level, interests, and learning needs.
The dictionary content (pronunciation, definitions, and example sentences) is powered by Oxford Languages.
An in-house editorial team is here to delight you with cool new word features every single day. That’s 365 beautifully narrated and illustrated word stories a year.
Too busy? Pick the best time to receive daily word notifications. Set up the widget to learn and revise recently discovered words.
Love the word? Store it in your own word collection.
Turn word learning into a powerful self-improvement habit with C1 - Learn Advanced Vocabulary.

bluejetty:00174447:ios.summary: iCollect Music is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your music and album collection or inventory, whether at home, work, or school. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well
bluejetty:00174447:ios.description:
iCollect Music is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your music and album collection or inventory, whether at home, work, or school. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms. Scan in or search for any music item you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features!
• Manage and inventory CDs, vinyl records, cassette tapes, 8-track, reel-to-reel, digital files, and so much more.
• Loaded with millions of music items and albums from around the world in our database.
• Full barcode scanning and database search.
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad, iPhone, Mac, and more.
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency.
• Filters, sorting, and importing.
• Three different custom layouts.
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Share your music collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter.
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed.
• Extra features like colored Themes, Dark Mode support, and more.
• Every field is editable.
• Store up to four pictures per item or album, including front, back, and inside images of music items.
• Personal details per music item or album including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Last Watched, Storage Location, Opened, Notes, Estimated Value, and more.
• Index bars and search for quick access in large music collections.
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 18, the latest devices like iPhone 16, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, SE 2, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your music collection from nearly anywhere: CLZ Music, Delicious Library, MusicBuddy, Discogs, and much more. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
Data provided by Discogs, Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
-------
PRIVACY INFO
-------
All of these are OPTIONAL when using our app.
Email Address: We only collect this if you enable Cloud Sync as a login user ID.
Contacts: We only use your contacts if you want us to for "Loaned To" fields.
Photos or Videos: We only use photos that you choose for your item details.
Camera: We only use this for barcode scanning.
None of your data is sold. See our Privacy Policy URL for details.
We do use Google Firebase and Facebook SDK's for analytics and crash data. See their policies for additional details on what they may track about your device.
-------
TERMS OF USE: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/
