bluejetty:00178071:ios.summary:
AAMA CMA Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you pass the Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) Exam administered by the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA) with a high score on your first attempt.
AA
bluejetty:00178071:ios.description:
AAMA CMA Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you pass the Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) Exam administered by the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA) with a high score on your first attempt.
AAMA CMA Exam Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to CMA exam preparation, but also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
## Passing the exam on the first attempt
In AAMA CMA Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass the cosmetology exam. Specifically, these subjects include
- General (28%)
- Administrative (25%)
- Clinical (47%)
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have broken down the above subjects in more detail according to the exam syllabus published by AAMA. You will need to practice a total of 11 subjects that will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 800 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the CMA exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice in AAMA CMA Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the CMA exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://cma.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://cma.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00098660:ios.description:
ListenMe – Text to Speech
Listen to written content with ListenMe. Turn text into spoken audio and adjust the playback speed to match your listening preference. Whether you are reviewing notes, listening to study materials, or exploring an article, ListenMe offers an alternative way to access written content.
TEXT TO SPEECH
Type or paste text and listen to it read aloud. Bring content from your notes, emails, articles, and study materials into your listening routine.
LISTEN TO DOCUMENTS
Import supported documents and listen to their text within the app. Use ListenMe to review written materials in audio form.
ADJUST YOUR LISTENING SPEED
Slow down or speed up playback to suit your preference. Choose a pace that works for the content you are listening to.
FOR STUDY, WORK, AND EVERYDAY READING
• Listen to your study notes and written course materials.
• Review text from work documents.
• Hear text copied from articles and emails.
• Switch from reading to listening when you prefer audio.
HOW IT WORKS
Type or paste your text, or import a supported document.
Convert the text into speech.
Listen and adjust the playback speed.
LISTENME PRO
Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://listenme.co/privacy
Terms of Service: https://listenme.co/terms

Contact us at support@listenme.co

bluejetty:00014894:ios.description:
WorldRemit makes sending money abroad simple, fast and secure. Transfer funds to family and friends worldwide with trusted digital money transfer and wire service tools designed for convenience and flexibility. With low fees, competitive exchange rates, and multiple payout options, WorldRemit gives you a reliable way to move money internationally - anytime, anywhere.
Send money across borders using methods that fit your receiver’s needs. Choose between bank transfers, mobile wallet, cash pickup, and airtime topup. Whether you’re supporting loved ones, paying bills abroad, or sending emergency funds, WorldRemit delivers your international remittance quickly and safely.
Reliable global money transfer services
WorldRemit provides a seamless way to send money to countries around the world using secure banking and digital payment technology. Your transfer is protected with advanced fraud monitoring, encrypted transactions, and verification tools that keep your financial information safe.
FAST AND SECURE BANK TRANSFERS
Send money directly to bank accounts across thousands of global financial institutions. Perfect for everyday banking needs, bill payments and direct deposits.
FLEXIBLE MOBILE MONEY MANAGEMENT
Transfer funds straight to mobile wallets, giving recipients immediate access to money for payments, savings or cash withdrawals.
CASH PICKUP
Send money for pick up at trusted partner locations. Your recipient can collect cash instantly with a valid ID for quick, convenient access to funds.
AIRTIME TOPUP
Recharge mobile phones abroad in seconds. Keep family connected by sending airtime credit instantly.
FAST, AFFORDABLE AND TRANSPARENT
WorldRemit offers competitive exchange rates and low transfer fees, giving you more value with every transaction. Review fees and rates upfront so you always know exactly how much your receiver will receive. No hidden charges. No surprises.
BUILT FOR CONVENIENCE
• Quick setup and easy repeat transfers
• Save receivers for faster future payments
• Real-time transfer tracking and status alerts
• 24/7 ability to send money internationally
• Accessible customer support when you need help
Transfer and wire money worldwide
Kenya: Send cash for pick up at Co-op Bank, Diamond Trust Bank, Equity Bank, Upesi and others. Transfer to mobile money with Airtel, Equity Bank, and M-Pesa, or send bank transfers to Co-op Bank, Diamond Trust Bank, and National Bank of Kenya.
Philippines: Cash pickup at BDO Unibank, Cebuana, PS Bank, and M Lhuillier. Mobile money transfers to CoinsPH, GCash, and PayMaya. Bank transfers to LandBank, BDO Unibank, BPI, Metrobank, and Philippine National Bank.
Nigeria: Cash pickup from Fidelity Bank, Union Bank, and Virtual Correspondent. Bank transfers to Access Bank, Fidelity Bank, FirstBank, GTBank, and UBA.
Ghana: Cash pickup at Unity Link, Zenith, and FBN Bank. Mobile money transfers to MTN, Airtel Tigo, and Vodafone. Bank transfers to EcoBank and Fidelity Bank.
You can also send money to Uganda, South Africa, Colombia, Rwanda, Bangladesh and more.
Download WorldRemit to experience fast, flexible and secure international money transfers today.
*Payment options for your WorldRemit transfer vary by country and may include debit, credit, or prepaid cards, Poli, Interac, iDEAL, Klarna (Sofort), Apple Pay, Trustly, or mobile money.
Contact Us
Address: 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF, UK

bluejetty:00131443:ios.name: Airalo: eSIM for travel & data
bluejetty:00131443:ios.summary:
With an eSIM from Airalo, get connected the moment you arrive at your destination, without worrying about roaming fees, SIM card hunting, or untrustworthy airport wifi.
Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM marketplace. Browse eSIMs
bluejetty:00131443:ios.description:
With an eSIM from Airalo, get connected the moment you arrive at your destination, without worrying about roaming fees, SIM card hunting, or untrustworthy airport wifi.
Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM marketplace. Browse eSIMs in 200+ destinations — including Unlimited data packages in over 120+ destinations.
What’s an eSIM? 
An eSIM is a digital SIM built right into your phone. No physical card, no fuss. Browse data packages, buy, install, and get online — all directly from the app.
Choose from any one of Airalo’s eSIM plans and packages:
 - Local eSIMs for single-country trips, starting from just $4 USD
 - Regional eSIMs for multi-country adventures across Europe, Asia, Latin America, and more 
 - Global eSIMs covering 160+ countries in one install — with data, calls, and texts
 - Unlimited eSIMs for when you want peace of mind without having to worry about your data usage
How it works (it's really this easy)
1. Install the Airalo app
2. Choose your eSIM plan based on your travel needs (location, fixed GB or unlimited data, number of days)
3. Buy your eSIM
4. Install the eSIM directly on the Airalo app
5. Turn on your eSIM and get data as soon as you arrive in your new destination
Track your usage in real time, manage multiple eSIMs in one place, and top up on the fly — because plans change, and we help you adapt to them.
PS: If your device supports keeping two lines active at the same time, your original SIM can stay active, so you never miss a call or a 2FA code from home. Just make sure Mobile Data and Roaming are strictly assigned to your Airalo eSIM to prevent unexpected charges from your domestic carrier. 
Why choose Airalo for your eSIM?
 - Our core values are: Empathy, Ownership, Innovation, Trust, Growth, and Customer First. We embody these values in everything we do: from our work culture to how we treat our customers. We give back, whether it’s donating to disaster relief funds or to other causes that matter, worldwide.
 - We are fully transparent about our product, including the fair usage policy and data cap for our Unlimited data packages.
 - Over 30 million travelers trust us to keep them connected across 200+ destinations.
Why travelers love Airalo: 
 - Quick and efficient multi-lingual customer support
 - A wide range of flexible and affordable eSIM plans across destinations, timeframes, and data packages
 - Unlimited eSIM data packages with no hotspot limit
 - No hidden fees or surprise charges
 - eSIM options for calls, text, and phone numbers
 - Easy top-up
FAQs
Can I use my SIM card at the same time as an eSIM?
 - Yes, most devices allow you to use multiple SIMs and/or eSIMs simultaneously. You can keep your primary line active to receive text messages, calls, and 2FA authentication (just remember that these will be subject to roaming fees).
Do Airalo eSIMs come with phone numbers?
 - Yes, we offer both options. Some of our eSIMs come with a phone number that includes data, calls, and texts, while others are data-only packages designed purely for internet connectivity. You can easily check which features are included in the plan's details before purchasing.
Can I make phone calls and send text messages with an Airalo eSIM?
 - Yes, if you choose an eSIM that specifically includes data, calls, and texts. For data-only eSIMs, you won’t be able to make traditional phone calls or send SMS, but you can still use internet-based apps like WhatsApp to stay in touch seamlessly.
Privacy Policy airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy 
Terms and Conditions airalo.com/more-info/terms-conditions 
Need help? We're at support@airalo.com, or find your topic at airalo.com/help 
Learn more about Airalo: airalo.com and join our community @airalocom on TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, Facebook, LinkedIn, and @airalo on Instagram.

Experience the wonders of crossy words and fill ins, while you stroll along the zen path of a daily themed crossword. Unravel your mind in the quick crosswords quest, where every crossword brings you a step closer to evolving into a linguistic expert and expanding your vocabulary. Dive into the thrill of guess work, perfect your performance with every puzzle, as we take you on a journey to become a word hike expert.

Time yourself and aim to smash your personal record with each play. With Crossword Daily - Word Puzzle, every day is a crossword day!

- LEARN WHILE HAVING FUN: Discover and learn new words while in your very own zen antistress haven. Every level is a new opportunity to improve!
- THOUSANDS OF LEVELS: Navigate through 4000+ free levels and solve each puzzle page with nothing but uncomplicated yet challenging quick crosswords and more.
- HINTS GALORE: Got stuck on a tricky one clue? Use our Reveal Letter hint to solve even the toughest knotwords.

- TRAIN YOUR BRAIN: Boost your lexicon, improve your memory and knowledge, all while enjoying your very own word quest.
- NO WIFI NEEDED: Play oflline whenever and wherever you want!
- ADVANCED ONLINE FEATURES: Play online to enjoy advanced options and features and have the best gaming experience possible!
Start your crossword solver journey today with Crossword Daily - Word Puzzle, the perfect game for those who enjoy easy crossword puzzles yet challenging, antistress fill ins, and free play word games.

Be part of the ultimate quick crossword universe, focus on becoming the best solver, and beat your personal best. Crossword Daily - Word Puzzle is an entertaining way to train your brain and expand your vocabulary. Keep every word in check and let each level bring you one step closer to becoming the ultimate crossword maestro you always desired to be. Experience the simplicity and elegance of word puzzles combined with the challenge of knotwords.
No stress, no time limit, just easy crossword puzzles to put your language skills to test. Remember, there's always a way to solve every cross word puzzle, and at Crossword Daily - Word Puzzle, every solver is a winner.
Ready to take on the ultimate crossword challenge? Diving in is as simple as selecting "download". Enter the engaging world of Crossword Daily - Word Puzzle now, and let the word hunt begin!

Overview:
CalcaApp is an innovative, customizable tool that allows you to transfer any image from your device or captured with your ca
bluejetty:00070441:ios.description:
CalcaApp: Your Customizable Tool for Transferring Images to Paper
Welcome to the latest CalcaApp update!
Overview:
CalcaApp is an innovative, customizable tool that allows you to transfer any image from your device or captured with your camera to paper, acting as a camera lucida or projector. With a wide selection of features and tools, CalcaApp is designed to inspire you and facilitate your artistic creations.
You can draw on a table on a paper yes, but you can also make a small mural on the wall if you hold your phone upright and looking through it at the image you have chosen on the wall.
3D effect: You can use a basic stand to support the device with a 45 degree tilt or those you choose, and you can make a 3D effect on the drawing. examples with videos and images at CalcaApp.com.
Free for Everyone:
I'm excited to announce that CalcaApp is now completely free for all its users - enjoy all the features at no cost!
Earn Points, Remove Ads:
Coming soon, you'll have options that will require more than ten points. With an active subscription, you'll have access to everything unlocked at the same special price.
Annual Subscription:
If you've noticed that CalcaApp is continually developing and implementing new features, you'll now have access to everything unlocked at the same price.
Multicultural Languages:
We've added new languages, including Italian, plus Russian, French, Indonesian, German, Arabic, English, Spanish and Portuguese, so you can enjoy CalcaApp in your preferred language.
Customize with 1550+ Fonts:
Choose from a wide selection of over 1550 fonts to give a unique touch to your texts and designs. In addition, CalcaApp is customizable in various colors for easy inspiration when using the app.
Improved Web Capture:
Now, capturing web pages is easier than ever. Turn your favorite websites into images with just one tap.
Learn with Our Tutorials:
Explore our tutorials on CalcaApp.Com to get the most out of all the features and tools available.
Follow me on the Networks:
Ask us for new features from our social networks and get to know them on ApliArte.Com.
Recommended supports:
Use supports recommended by CalcaApp or, failing that, something suitable, such as a glass, a jar or a box, to hold the device horizontally or vertically depending on where you want to make the drawing, but it is important that the device is fixed.
Tips and Recommendations:
Consider using a stand recommended by CalcaApp for a better experience.
Consider choosing a color of your liking for a better user experience.
Consider using relaxing music and make sure you have enough lighting to enjoy the experience.
Remember that CalcaApp is not magic and requires practice. You can find demonstration videos on our website for best results.
IMPORTANT: 
-You must give permission to the camera of your device, to be able to see through it, the image chosen or captured in the area where you are about to draw.
-This app is not magic (It needs practice, there are demonstration videos to see results).
-Your device MUST FOCUS ON THE DRAWING AREA, whether it is paper, wall, floor, etc... FOR ITS CORRECT FUNCTIONING.
-You can search with the app from the web for any drawing to color and thus start practicing.
-You can remove advertising with a point system and at no cost. 
-It does not project the image (For this you need a projector). 
-To avoid autofocus you have to prevent the hand from passing under the camera (It is explained with images in CalcaApp.com). 
-You do not need to register in the app.
-This app is under continuous development, we appreciate and value your comments and suggestions at erbolamm.com or apliarte.com. 
Is there anything else I can help you with?

bluejetty:00022435:ios.description:
Monitor your iPhone battery level from your wrist.
Juice Watch is a simple app designed to do two things well:
• Show the battery level of the paired iPhone in a complication on Apple Watch
• Deliver a notification on your iPhone when your Apple Watch is charging and gets above 90% (or whatever level you choose, from 50% to 100%)
Just glance at your wrist to monitor the charge of your iPhone throughout the day. Or, keep tabs on the battery level of your iPhone while it is plugged in and charging in another room.
You can see both your iPhone and Apple Watch battery levels on the same complication.
You can also get a notification on your Apple Watch when the paired iPhone is charging and reaches at least 80% (or whatever level you choose, from 50% to 100%).
You can set up low battery notifications, to get notifications when your Apple Watch or iPhone battery is low.
Juice Watch is available for a wide variety of complications, so you can use it on your favorite watch faces.
You can also use this app to check your Apple Watch battery level from your paired iPhone. This can be useful while your Apple Watch is charging somewhere else.
Keep in mind that the iPhone battery level shown on Apple Watch is not real-time. It is refreshed periodically, about every 5–60 minutes. The Apple Watch battery level shown on the paired iPhone refreshes at approximately the same rate.
Note: The Juice Watch complication must be installed on your active watch face for the app to work as expected.
Since iOS 17 and watchOS 10, Apple shares battery levels with apps rounded to the nearest 5%, so some readings in Juice Watch are rounded.
Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your device’s Settings under your Apple Account.
Privacy Policy: https://ganotis.com/juice-watch-privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00041541:ios.summary:
Naming the letters is the easy part. Reading the word is the job — and that is what Luvinci is built for, starting from the very first letter sound if that is where your child is.
Ages 4-9. A child still learning letter sounds and a child
bluejetty:00041541:ios.description:
Naming the letters is the easy part. Reading the word is the job — and that is what Luvinci is built for, starting from the very first letter sound if that is where your child is.
Ages 4-9. A child still learning letter sounds and a child already reading sentences can each be set to their own level, so one app covers a kindergartener and a 2nd grader without buying twice.
HEARING THE SOUNDS IS THE POINT
Tap a letter and your child hears it sounded out. In the read-aloud stories, every word lights up as it is spoken, so the letters on the page and the sounds in the air arrive together. A paper workbook cannot do that. The stories are written in rhyme, so the sound patterns your child is learning to hear keep coming back around.
IN KINDERGARTEN
- Letter sounds: what each letter says, not just what it is called
- CVC words: cat, sun, big — the first words a child decodes alone
- First sight words: common words read by sight instead of sounded out
- Counting and number building on Montessori math boards
IN 1ST GRADE
- Blends: hear how two consonants run together inside one word
- Short and long vowels: the difference that decides how a word is read
- Spelling: build a word letter by letter and hear each sound go into place
- Addition and subtraction shown on the math boards, not just drilled
MOVING INTO 2ND GRADE
- Vowel teams: the letter pairs that make one sound together
- Longer words, and comprehension and vocabulary questions on the stories
- Multiplication and times tables on the same math boards
- Logic and memory puzzles that get harder as your child works through them
WHY YOUR CHILD KEEPS GOING BACK
Ten minutes here ends with your child having read something, not watched something.
- Interactive stories that play like games, with puzzles hidden inside them
- A character they design, down to the clothes and hairstyles
- A coloring section for the quieter part of the day
THEY CAN RUN IT THEMSELVES
The menus are pictures, so a child who cannot yet read the words can still choose where to go. Set your child's level and Luvinci puts together a daily set of activities to match, so practice at home has an order to it instead of being whatever game gets tapped first. It works well as a short daily habit: after school, or as part of a homeschool morning, alongside your own curriculum rather than in place of it.
WHY PARENTS PICK IT
- No ads, no pop-ups, and nothing to click through to — nobody can reach your child here
- Works fully offline: a whole flight with no wifi, and no help needed
- Self-paced, with activities your child can replay as often as they want
- Change the level as your child moves up, or for a younger or older sibling
WHAT IT COSTS
Download it and look around. Unlocking every section is an in-app purchase or a subscription — and there are no ads either way, paid or not.
Open Learn to Read and listen to your child work out a word on their own — the first one, or the first hard one. That moment is the whole point.
Terms: https://www.luvinci.app/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.luvinci.app/privacy-policy

Tap a letter and your child hears it sounded out. In the read-aloud stories, every word lights up as it is spoken, so the letters on the page and the sounds in the air arrive together. A paper workbook cannot do that. The stories are written in rhyme, so the sound patterns your child is learning to hear keep coming back around.

IN KINDERGARTEN
- Letter sounds: what each letter says, not just what it is called
- CVC words: cat, sun, big — the first words a child decodes alone
- First sight words: common words read by sight instead of sounded out
- Counting and number building on Montessori math boards

IN 1ST GRADE
- Blends: hear how two consonants run together inside one word
- Short and long vowels: the difference that decides how a word is read
- Spelling: build a word letter by letter and hear each sound go into place
- Addition and subtraction shown on the math boards, not just drilled

MOVING INTO 2ND GRADE
- Vowel teams: the letter pairs that make one sound together
- Longer words, and comprehension and vocabulary questions on the stories
- Multiplication and times tables on the same math boards
- Logic and memory puzzles that get harder as your child works through them

WHY YOUR CHILD KEEPS GOING BACK
Ten minutes here ends with your child having read something, not watched something.
- Interactive stories that play like games, with puzzles hidden inside them
- A character they design, down to the clothes and hairstyles
- A coloring section for the quieter part of the day

THEY CAN RUN IT THEMSELVES
The menus are pictures, so a child who cannot yet read the words can still choose where to go. Set your child's level and Luvinci puts together a daily set of activities to match, so practice at home has an order to it instead of being whatever game gets tapped first. It works well as a short daily habit: after school, or as part of a homeschool morning, alongside your own curriculum rather than in place of it.

WHY PARENTS PICK IT
- No ads, no pop-ups, and nothing to click through to — nobody can reach your child here
- Works fully offline: a whole flight with no wifi, and no help needed
- Self-paced, with activities your child can replay as often as they want
- Change the level as your child moves up, or for a younger or older sibling

WHAT IT COSTS
Download it and look around. Unlocking every section is an in-app purchase or a subscription — and there are no ads either way, paid or not.

Open Learn to Read and listen to your child work out a word on their own — the first one, or the first hard one. That moment is the whole point.

bluejetty:00184516:ios.description:
WebLink — Tech that moves you™
WebLink upgrades your in-vehicle screen into a modern, connected infotainment system allowing you to safely and easily enjoy your favorite smartphone apps on the go.
WebLink is the only in-car infotainment system that allows you to:
･ Use almost any app on your vehicle screen using Cast*
･ Access most of your smartphone's media and content
･ Watch your favorite YouTube videos (available on many vehicle screens)*
･ And discover much more!
A compatible WebLink vehicle screen is required. To find out if your vehicle screen is compatible with WebLink, look for a WebLink logo on your product packaging or in the vehicle screen manual.
*Vehicle screen manufacturers may restrict the use of certain apps. Regional differences apply.
—————
Flexible and Personalized
No matter where you are in the world, WebLink provides you with a connected in-vehicle experience that is tailored to you.
Reliable and Safe
WebLink is tested and continuously updated to improve your in-vehicle experience — all so you can keep your eyes on the road with confidence.
Easy to Use and Relevant
Enjoy a beautifully designed in-vehicle interface and interact with the apps you already love.
—————
WebLink allows you to change the way you interact with your apps, music and videos inside your vehicle. WebLink provides you with a modern infotainment system that fits your lifestyle. Download the WebLink Host app for your smartphone and connect to your vehicle. WebLink uses the power of your smartphone to improve what's available on your vehicle screen. 
Over five million people already use WebLink globally to safely access what is relevant to them — right from their vehicle screen.
—————
Setup Instructions:
1. Download the WebLink Host app to your smartphone
2. Open the WebLink Host app on your smartphone, accept the Terms & Conditions, and accept all of the permission prompts.
3. Connect your smartphone to a compatible WebLink vehicle screen. Be sure to use a certified USB cable that supports both data communication and charging capabilities for connecting with your in-vehicle screen.
4. Pair your smartphone to the in-vehicle screen using Bluetooth to enjoy full audio playback for the in-vehicle speakers. Consult your in-vehicle screen's owner's manual for the connection details.
—————
The WebLink Support Team is here to help and answer any question you might have.
Visit us at HelloWebLink.com

bluejetty:00184500:ios.description:
Play the most colorful, relaxing marble game now! Join Woka, the friendly turtle, on the mission to save his beautiful island. Shoot & match marbles to stop the moving row from reaching the hole, and participate in exciting puzzle challenges and quests. Explore the vibrant world of the game now! Enjoy never-ending marble shooting levels and become the Woka Master. Are you ready for Woka Woka challenge?
How to play:
- Shoot to match 3 or more colored marbles and blast them. Challenge your matching skills!
- Win a level by clearing all or surviving the timer. 
- Touch the shooter turtle to swap the color. 
- Combos create amazing powers-up! Check out simple tutorials on our YouTube channel. 
- Powerful boosters can help you pass levels. Enjoy the blasting adventure with more power!
- Win thousands of levels, with new chapters added every two weeks!
Key features: 
- Dynamic marble shooter gameplay. You will never get bored with Woka Woka levels!
- Special marbles. Gummy, frozen, stone, and coconut marbles are just some of the fun obstacles you will discover as you progress through the levels.
- Special events. Explore exciting side maps or show off your skill in special competitions - every week!
- Play with friends. Connect with Facebook to invite friends. Send and receive extra lives for more fun in Woka Woka!
- Offline support. Blast marbles even without an Internet connection. Events and special features are available only in online mode.
Woka Woka is completely free to play, but in-app purchases are available. For news, tips, and special rewards, follow us on Facebook and Instagram (@wokawokagame). If you need help in your adventure or just want to say hi, please write us from the game or visit our support portal - https://support.twodesperados.com/hc/en/5-woka-woka/contact-us/

bluejetty:00086072:ios.description:
eオリコアプリは、オリコのクレジットカード、カードローン、ショッピングクレジット、オートローンなどをご利用のお客さま向けの公式アプリです。
お支払金額やご利用明細、ポイント残高の確認はもちろん、各種お手続きもスマートフォンから簡単に行えます。
日々の家計管理やお支払管理をサポートし、オリコのサービスをより便利にご利用いただけます。
1）ご利用状況をかんたん確認
お支払金額やお支払日、ご利用可能額などをトップ画面からすぐに確認できます。
ご利用明細（確定分）は過去15か月分まで確認でき、家計管理や支出の振り返りにも便利です。
2）自動ログイン機能
2回目以降は、eオリコID・パスワードの入力不要で、生体認証によりログインできます。
また、生体認証を設定していない場合でも、4桁のアプリロックコードでログインできます。
3）ポイント確認・交換
暮らスマイルやオリコポイントの残高をすぐに確認できます。
商品やオンラインギフト券への交換、他社ポイントへの移行もアプリから簡単に行えます。
4）カード利用通知・安心機能
カードをご利用いただくたびにリアルタイムでアプリへ通知します。
直近7日間の利用履歴も確認でき、不正利用の早期発見に役立ちます。
また、カードが見当たらない場合は、一時的にカードの利用を制限することもできます。
5) デジタルカード
カードを取り出すことなく、カード番号、有効期限、セキュリティコードをいつでも確認できます。
オリコが発行する国際ブランド付きクレジットカードはすべてデジタルカードに対応しています。
※一部法人カードなどは対象外となります。
6）ショッピングクレジット・オートローンの確認
ショッピングクレジットやオートローン契約内容やお支払状況をアプリから確認できます。
7）オリコモール
オリコモールは、ネットショッピングでオリコポイントがおトクにたまるポイントアップサイトです。
人気通販サイトやファッション、コスメ、旅行予約など、幅広いジャンルのショップをご利用いただけます。オリコモールを経由するだけで、いつものお買い物やご予約などでポイントをおトクにためられます。
8）Orico優待ナビ
Orico優待ナビでは、全国の飲食店、レジャー施設、ショッピング、旅行などで利用できる会員向け優待サービスをご利用いただけます。
会員限定の優待特典や割引サービスを検索でき、おでかけやお買い物をおトクにお楽しみいただけます。
■ご利用条件
eオリコへの会員登録（無料）が必要です。
■動作環境
iPhone:iOS15以上
※タブレット端末の場合は正常に動作しない場合がございます

bluejetty:00152033:ios.description:
Litbuy is your all-in-one shopping agent and parcel-forwarding app designed for purchasing products from popular online marketplaces in China — fast, easy, and reliable.
Whether you're looking for fashion, electronics, accessories, or daily essentials, Litbuy helps you order, check quality, consolidate, and ship worldwide with a seamless user experience.
 Key Features
• Paste the link & order instantly
Just paste a product link, choose options, and place your order in seconds.
• Real warehouse QC photos before shipping
Receive clear, real QC photos from our warehouse so you can approve your items with confidence.
• Pack First, Pay Later
Preview the actual weight and size of your parcel — pay only the accurate shipping fee.
• Real-time parcel tracking
Track every step of your shipment with detailed, up-to-date logistics information.
• Consolidation & extra packaging
Combine multiple orders into one parcel and enjoy free extra protection for safer delivery.
• Lower shipping fees with exclusive 40% OFF & 30% OFF coupons

bluejetty:00071260:ios.description:
Start each day with personal guidance messages from God and your Guardian Angels!
Your guardian angels are with you now and always, sent to you by God to guide, protect, and support you. Listen to your three personalized messages from God and your guardian angels, along with specific actions to help you move forward.
FEATURES
- BEGIN your day by releasing to God and your guardian angels any worries or concerns you may have
- RECEIVE three personalized messages from your guardian angels every day
- LISTEN to the deeper meaning of your messages explained
- COMPLETE the action steps associated with each message
- REPLAY your guardian angel messages any time before the day's end
- SHARE your daily guardian angel messages with others
About the My Guardian Angel Messages subscription 
- Includes a free 1-week trial period with either subscription.
- Your subscription will start after the trial period ends
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscribe monthly or annually to access to all content
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase 
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription
Privacy Policy
http://www.oceanhousemedia.com/privacy/
Terms of Use
http://www.oceanhousemedia.com/terms/
A special gift for you… based on the tremendous success of the “My Guardian Angel Messages” app, we are able to drastically reduce the monthly subscription price (by about 40% in most countries). You see, the more people that use the app, the less we have to charge each person. So, enjoy the new lower monthly price or sign up for the annual subscription. Either way, you will always receive the benefit of your low rate, as long as you remain a subscriber, even if prices increase in the future.

bluejetty:00039799:ios.name: Swiss Snow
bluejetty:00039799:ios.summary: Rediscover winter! With the Swiss Snow app from Switzerland Tourism, you can check the snow and weather conditions at your favourite ski region in no time at all, take a look at the 360° webcams or get inspired to try out a new winter hobby
bluejetty:00039799:ios.description:
Rediscover winter! With the Swiss Snow app from Switzerland Tourism, you can check the snow and weather conditions at your favourite ski region in no time at all, take a look at the 360° webcams or get inspired to try out a new winter hobby. Everything in a single place and in a single app.
Which areas have the best snow and weather conditions? Where are most of the lifts open? Which kind of sports can I do at a particular winter destination? Where should I plan my next day trip?
The Swiss Snow app from Switzerland Tourism can easily provide answers to these questions and many others. The extensive winter database contains snow and ski lift information for over 200 Swiss winter destinations. The database is updated several times a day and provides detailed information relating to the following winter sports: skiing, snowboarding, cross-country skiing, tobogganing and winter hiking.
But that’s not all. We have listened to your feedback and implemented the following new features:
- The design has been completely revamped and refreshed. Using the app has never been easier.

bluejetty:00164616:ios.summary: Explore the world of intrigue and suspense with "Detective Club: Missing in the Fog", a captivating journey through the dark streets of Victorian London. Perfect for fans of mystery hidden object games, unsolved mysteries games, and grippin
bluejetty:00164616:ios.description:
Explore the world of intrigue and suspense with "Detective Club: Missing in the Fog", a captivating journey through the dark streets of Victorian London. Perfect for fans of mystery hidden object games, unsolved mysteries games, and gripping detective games, this story-driven adventure puts you in the shoes of young sleuths Thomas and George. Race against time to find their missing friend Emily while uncovering a sinister conspiracy that will keep you guessing until the very end. Packed with engaging puzzles, thrilling crime investigation, and immersive search and find games, this is a mystery you won’t want to miss!
Step into the foggy streets of Victorian London and follow Thomas, a daring young detective, as he races to uncover the truth behind his best friend Emily's mysterious disappearance. With his loyal companion George by his side, he unravels a web of secrets: a murder, a sinister laboratory, and a shipwreck conspiracy. The journey is fraught with peril as the company faces threats from ruthless criminals, who harbor sins of their tragic past and deadly motives. Will Thomas be able to save his friend and bring the villains to justice, or will the shadows of Victorian London claim another victim? In this thrilling hidden-object game, the answers lie at your fingertips.
Explore Victorian London!
Step into the atmospheric streets of London, from shadowy back alleys to bustling docks and eerie mansions. Each location in this mystery hidden object game is brimming with clues, secrets, and puzzles waiting to be uncovered. Fans of unsolved mysteries games will love the richly detailed settings and haunting soundscapes.
Solve Challenging Mysteries!
Use your wits and detective skills to crack intricate puzzles, uncover hidden objects, and decode clues. Each search and find game challenge brings you closer to solving the biggest crime investigation in the city. With every discovery, you’ll unravel a sinister web of lies and conspiracies in this engaging detective game!
Make Critical Choices!
Your decisions matter! As you progress through this mystery hidden object game, you’ll face tough choices that shape the story. Will you save Emily in time or lose her to the shadows of London? With multiple endings, this crime investigation experience ensures replayability for fans of unsolved mysteries games!
Achievements and Collectibles!
Show off your detective prowess by earning a variety of achievements. Discover collectibles hidden throughout the game to deepen your experience. No matter if you're solving a crime investigation or mastering each search and find game puzzle, there’s always something to uncover in this gripping detective game!
Will you unravel the secrets hidden in the fog, or will the shadows of the past consume you? Join Thomas and George in the free trial of "Detective Club: Missing in the Fog" and find out!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Break the language barrier! Translate All - Text&Photo is a powerful and convenient translation app that provides you with a full range of translation solutions. You can easily translate what you want anytime and anywhere. 
Core functions
bluejetty:00153557:ios.description:
Break the language barrier! Translate All - Text&Photo is a powerful and convenient translation app that provides you with a full range of translation solutions. You can easily translate what you want anytime and anywhere. 
Core functions:
Text translation: Supports text translation. Whether you are writing an email, browsing an article or reading a document, just enter or paste the text and translate it anytime and anywhere. The interface is simple and clear, and you can quickly get the information you need. 
Voice translation: Built-in speech recognition technology, turn on voice input, say what you want to translate, and the app will automatically recognize and translate it into the target language. 
Camera photo translation: Encountering printed text such as menus, road signs, and manuals that is difficult to understand? Use the camera translation function, aim at the target text and shoot, the app will recognize and translate it instantly, and the translation results will be directly displayed on the screen, so that you can see the text information in the surrounding environment at a glance, which is convenient for travel. 
Dialogue translation: Designed for multi-person communication scenarios, after turning on the dialogue mode, the app can automatically distinguish the languages of different speakers and perform two-way translation in real time. Language differences will not affect communication.
Translate All - Text&Photo opens up a global communication journey for you with ease and convenience. Let language no longer be an obstacle for you to explore the world and communicate.

•Remove all advertisements completely.

Local 5-Star Cat Sitter Service
The Cat in a Flat cat sitting app makes it super simple to find trusted pet sitters near you. Our local cat sitters offer cat care at your home: house sitting, overnight stays or daily drop-in visits.
Cat sitting is a great alternative to cat boarding.
You can join Cat in a Flat for free as a cat owner looking for a lovely cat sitter. Or become a cat sitter and get paid to do what you love, cuddling kitties of course.

· Browse 5-Star cat sitters in your neighborhood
· Detailed cat sitter profiles - learn about the sitters and see their experience
· All our cat sitters are vetted by our team 
· Contact cat sitters for free, no subscription fees
· Get to know your cat sitter with a free meet and greet
· Home visits once or twice a day
· Overnight stays, especially popular for kittens or elderly cats
· Book and pay securely through our service

· All bookings on Cat in a Flat are covered by our Cat in a Flat Guarantee
· We offer a 24/7 online customer support

- Feeding and fresh water
- Cleaning the bowls
- Cleaning the cat toilet / litter box
- Playtime and cuddles
- Daily updates and photos
What we offer to the cat sitters:
· Free profile to promote your cat sitting service
· You can offer house sitting as well as visits at the cats home.
· Fast reliable messaging system
· Secure online payments. 
· Set your own rates for your cat sitting job
· Availability calendar
· Review reminder
· A great community of cat lovers
The Cat in a Flat app is suitable for cats of all ages, providing the best cat care solution for all your kitties needs. 
Download the app to find a trustworthy and reliable cat sitter.
To find out more about Cat in a Flat, visit www.catinaflat.com

bluejetty:00071273:ios.description:
The Gospel Living mobile app is designed to support the Children and Youth program through engaging, fun, inspiring and relevant experiences to help live the gospel in their everyday life. The app includes:
• Inspiring content
• Group activity ideas
• Group activity and meeting creation
• Personal goals
• Reminders
• Communications
• Reflection and thoughts
Core Features
Discover
The Discover feed is updated regularly with inspiring articles, videos, audio, and images. It will include links to current Come, Follow Me lessons to support gospel learning. Additionally, you can explore ideas for service, activities, and personal goals.
Goals
Set personal goals for things you would like to try or learn about to help you grow socially, intellectually, spiritually, or physically. Manage your efforts and track progress of your personal goals.
Thoughts
Reflect on goals, write down your ideas, your thoughts or keep a journal of your experiences.
Circles
The Circles feature connects you with family, classes, quorums, and others who serve with you in the Church. You can have conversations about group activities, discuss what you are learning, share goal progress, and encourage and support one another. From the Discover feed, content can be shared such as inspirational articles, images, quotes, videos, and ideas for service and group activities. Within Circles, members can create group activities or meetings and invite others to events; participants can RSVP indicating participation."

The Best Pickup Basketball App!

bluejetty:00157144:ios.description:
The Best Pickup Basketball App!
Are They Hooping is the only cross platform pickup basketball app that lets you scout the competition! Before you waste your time driving to an empty basketball court, use our map to find players, gyms, and schedule basketball games. 
Upload highlights to your profile and post them so people know you’re nice! Your goal is to level up and earn as many buckets as possible! Use your buckets to customize your profile and boost your stats.
Play the hardest basketball trivia ever and climb our leaderboard! 
Earn prizes, achievements, and unlock all types of skins for your player card and profile. 
Listen to our soundtrack of over 100 unique songs! Discover all the fun ways to level up your profile and master our app so you never walk into an empty basketball court again! 
Questions?: Our ATH pickup basketball app tutorials will help navigate you along the way! 
List of Features: 
-PROFILE
Your profile is your hub for everything! It’s your way to show off all your stats, accomplishments, and basketball trivia IQ. Customize everything like your animated skin, highlights, player card, and stats (ppg, rpg, apg). Our soundtrack will start playing as soon as you open the app, let us know your favorite songs or playlists!
-MAP
We have thousands of gyms all over the world to find pickup basketball! Find and favorite your go-to basketball court! You can even request a court to be added if you can’t find it. Use our map to let people know you’re hooping, find players, and schedule basketball games. 
How to use the ATH map: 
 -Click the basketball court you want to hoop at
 -View gym: See who’s hooping 
 -Check-in: So people know you’re hooping
 -Schedule Game: So people don’t forget! 
-SOCIAL PAGE
The social page lets you connect with every hooper in our app! The timeline shows what everyone is posting so you can find the best pickup basketball. You can also message friends or anyone you’ve played with!
-LEVEL UP!
Earn points and level up by using features in the app! Boost your stats to unlock rookie, starter, all-star, MVP, and HOF rankings among our leaderboard.
-LIVE
Go live and show off your skills! Earn gifts while playing pickup basketball games!
-TRIVIA
We have thousands of different basketball trivia questions! See how many questions you can get right as your streak goes up. Unlock a custom animated skin by climbing the leaderboard!
-BUCKETS
Level up for endless rewards and buckets! You can earn even more buckets by unlocking achievements, betting on 1v1 games, and getting gifts from going live! 
-SOUNDTRACK
Our soundtrack and playlist feature some of the best artist in the world! We have over 100 hand picked songs by hoopers, producers, and rising stars!
WE LOVE FEEDBACK
We upgrade our app based on user feedback!. If you like the Are They Hooping app, please rate and leave a review for us in the app store.

bluejetty:00140154:ios.name: Coin Identifier: Money Scanner
bluejetty:00140154:ios.summary: Unleash the power of numismatic expertise right from your pocket with this state-of-the-art coin identification app. Whether you're a seasoned collector or a curious beginner, this tool transforms your device into a professional-grade coin
bluejetty:00140154:ios.description:
Unleash the power of numismatic expertise right from your pocket with this state-of-the-art coin identification app. Whether you're a seasoned collector or a curious beginner, this tool transforms your device into a professional-grade coin analyzer, offering instant insights into the world of currency.
Utilizing cutting-edge image recognition technology, the app provides swift and accurate identification of coins from around the globe. Simply snap a photo or use an existing image, and watch as the app reveals detailed information about your coin's origin, age, composition, and estimated value.
Dive deep into numismatic history with our extensive database, covering ancient coins to modern mints. The app's intelligent algorithm can identify worn or damaged coins, making it invaluable for analyzing old or rare finds. For collectors, the built-in collection management system allows you to catalog, track, and valuate your entire coin portfolio with ease.
But it doesn't stop at coins – expand your knowledge to paper money and even precious metals. The jewelry appraisal feature helps you estimate the value of gold, silver, and other precious metal items, making it a versatile tool for both collectors and casual users alike.

bluejetty:00182513:ios.name: Idle Air Force Base
bluejetty:00182513:ios.summary: Idle Air Force Base is the most fun idle game you’ll play this year! Feel the need for speed with this really fun, strategic military game where you’ve got to build up the finest Air Force in the world, so you can do battle, take cities and
bluejetty:00182513:ios.description:
Idle Air Force Base is the most fun idle game you’ll play this year! Feel the need for speed with this really fun, strategic military game where you’ve got to build up the finest Air Force in the world, so you can do battle, take cities and conquer countries!
TOP REVIEW!
As one ex-USA Air Force pilot said, “I find this idle game especially amusing and fun!”
TRAIN TO WIN!
You are the Air Marshall and the enemy is spreading across the world. You need to train your cadets to be fully qualified pilots over a serious of rigorous and tough training areas. From practising ejector seats, to G-Force gyroscopes to bomb assembly to parachute training. Are you ready?!
TIME FOR BATTLE!
Once your training is complete, your squadron will be ready to unleash an attack of drones, fighter jets, airships and warplanes. You don’t need to become a tycoon or be some kind of capitalist or billionaire, just the best at training troops and a strategist for war.
TOP GUNS…
You have a full air force at your disposal with some awesome planes to unlock, fly and do battle with. Become a top gun with these mighty fine beasts of the sky:
RQ-4 Global Hawk
F-16 Fighting Falcon
A-10 Thunderbolt
C-130 Hercules
SR-71 Blackbird
F-35 Lightning II
B-2 Spirit
C-5 Galaxy
TAKE CITIES!
Compete in a series of battles and wars where you need to take out ground troops, enemy airfields, communication satellites, destroy cities and take out the capital.
READY FOR ADVENTURE?
Don’t bother being idle and going to the supermarket, hotel, water park, rollercoaster, just sign up to be a pilot and build your air force base to be the best in the world. Are you ready for adventure?
TRAINING PROGRAMME!
The Training Program ahead of you is extensive, tough, but fun!
EJECTOR SEAT - Emergency! Eject, eject, eject! The last chance to save your life so make sure you’re fully trained.
GYROSCOPE - Can you cope with the G-Force? Prepare your body to stay in control when you’re pulling some serious G.
GYM - You gotta be fit to be in our Air Force. So work it hard in the gym to be super fit.
BOMB ASSEMBLY TRAINING - There really is a right way to assemble a bomb. Learn well, or lose a few fingers.
WATER SURVIVAL - It’s not just the air you need to master. Make sure your squadron knows what to do in a crash landing.
PISTOL RANGE - Always be ready for hand-to-hand combat, this is war after all.
DRONE FLIGHT - Learn how to have an eye in every sky with the coolest drones in the air.
AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE - Those planes don’t just stay in good working order by themselves. Keep your spanner handy.
FREE FALLING - Who doesn’t want to fly? Get some wind in your hair and learn to control your fall.
MARSHALLING - Control which planes enter and exit the barracks
RAPPEL - Spring into action and with only the aid of a rope learn how to properly throw yourself out of a plane.
SIMULATOR - When all the training is done, the simulator will make sure your squad is ready for the wars to come.
So if you think you have what it takes to create the best air force base in the world, to unleash your awesome jets on the enemy, then download Idle Air Force Base now!

bluejetty:00120663:ios.summary: ***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum.
bluejetty:00120663:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
Preschool curriculum in one endearing alien-themed app. Land UFOs, explore extraterrestrial lands, vacuum the space, save the aliens, and much more. This fun-packed preschool educational adventure takes you out of this world to start a journey of learning. Have fun tracing letters, shapes, and numbers with aliens; or play 6 engaging educational mini-games to learn names of shapes, letters, numbers, and colors. 
==== FASCINATING TRACING AND LEARNING ADVENTURE FOR PRESCHOOL KIDS PACKED WITH EDUCATIONAL CONTENT TO HELP CHILDREN SUCCEED IN PRESCHOOL CURRICULUM ====
==== TRACE with ALIENS ====
* Uppercase letters
* Lowercase letters
* Shapes
* Numbers 1-10
* Numbers 10-20
* Numbers 1-100
==== LEARN in 6 FUN EDUCATIONAL MINI-GAMES ====
* Uppercase letters, lowercase letters, shapes, colors, numbers 1-10, numbers 1-100
* Mini-games include both matching and recognition activities
1. Feed the aliens. -- The cute little alien babies are hungry! Can you drag the flowers with the correct symbol to feed them?
2. Land UFOs. -- The shiny UFOs are coming for a landing. Land the UFOs to their right landing bases.
3. Connect the space dots. -- Connect the dots in an alphabetical or numerical order. Can you guess who is hiding behind the dots?
4. Color the aliens. -- Have fun learning with this special interactive coloring book. Crack the code to color the picture.
5. Vacuum the space. -- Operate our fancy vacuum cleaner to clean up the planet!
6. Match the planets. – Oh, who is it that hides behind the planets? Memorize the pictures and match them to help aliens get back home! 
==== EDUCATIONAL CONTENT ====
Teaches:
* Uppercase letters
* Lowercase letters
* Numbers 1-100
* Shapes
* Colors
* Fine-motor skills
* Memory skills
==== FEATURES ====
+ Educational, space-themed interactive mini-games
+ Professional animations, voice-over, and sound effects
+ Colorful child-friendly design
+ Developed in cooperation with teachers and parents
The aliens and other wacky space creatures are waiting. Time to learn! Prepare your children for success with this fun and quirky app by 22learn!

bluejetty:00068959:ios.description:
A station every 300 meters
Download the Vélo’v officiel app and access to 5 000 Vélo’v spread on 428 stations ! Enjoy a new experience of bike-sharing and ride in total freedom!
Riding a bike has never been so simple
Open the app and activate the geoloc service to find the nearest station with available bikes.
When close to the station, press « release a Vélo’v » and pick yours! 
The app allows you to receive a notification at the end of each trip, confirming that your bike has been properly returned (provided you have enabled notifications). You can also share your experience with the Vélo’v users community!
For a year, a day or even a trip: find the plan that suits you!
The Vélo’v officiel app offers you the choice between different plans. Whether you are a regular or occasional user, die-hard fan of mechanical bikes or electric assistance’s lover… you will find the one for you! Your credit card payments are secured.
One plan, several users
You can borrow up to 5 Vélo’v simultaneously and invite friends to discover the service with the Vélo’v officiel app. Holder or not of an annual Vélo’v plan, you can buy up to 5 short-term plan in one transaction!
Get rewards
Participate to the service and its improvment by evaluating your bike at the end of your trip, report a default to the technical service in the app or turn back your Vélo’v in an empty station.
Vélo’ news!
Keep in touch with Vélo’v: latest innovations, temporary stations closures, tips…for more fun with Vélo’v!
Hotline
Consult the list of your plans and past trips , find a a solution through the "need help" button or easyly contact our support by phone (French/English).

bluejetty:00119646:ios.name: T Wallet (Old)
bluejetty:00119646:ios.summary: T Wallet, the official digital wallet by Government of Telangana, makes digital payments for both government and private services with ease. With T Wallet, one can do Money Transfer, Bank Transfer, Mobile Recharge, Metro Card Recharge, Elec
bluejetty:00119646:ios.description:
T Wallet, the official digital wallet by Government of Telangana, makes digital payments for both government and private services with ease. With T Wallet, one can do Money Transfer, Bank Transfer, Mobile Recharge, Metro Card Recharge, Electricity Bill Payment, Water Bill Payment, Property Tax Payment, Travel Tickets Booking, Online Recharges and other digital Bill Payments.
Highlights:
• Language is not a barrier to do Digital Payments. Three languages have been introduced viz., Telugu, Urdu, English.
• Citizens can use T Wallet to make both Government and Private bill payments with just a click to avoid due dates.
• T Wallet does not charge for government transactions. This is fully secured and efficient. T-Wallet is the first and only official digital wallet from a state government in India.
• Bus tickets online booking option is made available anytime anywhere.
• T Wallet supports Money Transfer to any bank with no time delay and no charges.
• Recharge to any mobile with the plans browsing option.
• Receive money option on this wallet helps you to receive money from the sender with the unique QR code facility. Similarly, ‘Allow Pull Money’ option of T Wallet gives access to your QR code, OTP or Barcode to the Receiver.
• T Wallet gives Mini-statement of all your transactions and one can download the app from Appstore for free. 
• Citizens with feature phone or no Phone can use Mee Seva centres to open T Wallet, Load money into wallet and making payments.
• T Wallet uses two factor authentication, through Aadhaar based Biometric authentication and OTP to Aadhaar linked phone number, for feature phone and no phone users.
eChallan, Electricity bill, Water Bill, Property Tax
Number of Government Bills or Services such as Electricity bill, Water bill, eChallan (Traffic violation penalty), Property Tax, Sports Ground Booking, Public Service Commission Exam Fee, etc. can be made easily by entering consumer number or account ID followed by the payment gateway.
DTH Recharge, Mobile Recharge, Data card Recharge
Mobile Recharge, DTH Recharge, Internet bill payments to available service providers is hassle-free now as you can make payments through T Wallet from anywhere any time at your convenience.
Money Transfer
You can send money, without any inter-bank charges, to any bank account with the beneficiary’s valid IFSC code and account number. It could be to your own a/c or to your near and dear ones. You can also transfer money to other T Wallet a/c without any charges.
Tickets booking
Ticket booking services for various modes of transport (TSRTC and RedBus, Flights) are available from T-Wallet. 
QR Code Scanner Payments
Wherever T-Wallet is accepted, you can make secured payment just by scanning QR code displayed at various places like private merchants, government departments counters, etc.

bluejetty:00100882:android.description:
Ready to become a real business tycoon in automobile industry? Airplane Bike Transporter Plan is a new thrill where you can cargo your favorite motorbikes in an areophane. You could be very much familiar with transportation of different things via grand trucks and etc. But, cargo vehicles in a plane is really something new to cherish about. In this 3D simulation game you will find a chance to drive and park many sports moto in a big container. After this, you have to take this trailer truck towards the airport. Driving a big truck like this is itself a challenging task. 
After loading modern sports bikes into the plane, you have to fly in the air. In this way you can imagine and enjoy flying cars concept. Flying the plane like a pilot will give you unforgettable experience. This will not be an easy task to do. Your driving skills on roads in a city environment will really be tested there when you have to land this airplane in an island. This cargo plane flight will remember in your memories for long times.
Flying in the air has always been a fascinating thing for everyone. Our transporter plane will fulfill your this dream in a real 3D airport environment. Landing in an island will also be a worthy thing to recall. This enjoyment will be manifold when you will enjoy a ride of a sports vehicle as well. Like Cargo Plane Car Transporter you will be given with some wonderful bikes to load and park in cargo compartment of cargo freight plane. Take off the city airport flight carrying cars in your big airplane and navigate the landings properly.
This is not only a delivery but a safe delivery of expensive cars is mandatory. The safety and security of the motorbikes is on you now. Fly over the blue water and travel to different countries to transport cargo through your airplane. Cargo transportation is for relief or some other cause you have taken up the duty of international cargo transport. Fly high and reach destinations safely. Ensure the safety of your cargo. It requires perfect flight pilot skills to take off and lot of precision for accurate landing. 
***Features of Airplane Bike Transporter Plan***
- The Realistic 3D cargo airplane flight simulator.
- Real-time Plane Controls and Handling
- Transport sports bikes on your cargo plane
- Real experience of driving heavy bikes
- Real-time Physics Controls of Driving Heavy Vehicles
- Different camera

Not just a Transcriber
Turn your voice to text. Just speak into your phone, and voila, we'll convert your words into a handy transcription. But there is more.
What's in it for you?
ACCURATE TRANSCRIPTION
- Check out the written version of what you said—every little detail captured!
AI PROCESSED NOTE
- Let our AI organize your words into a neat and tidy note—clean up that messy text.
LIST OF IMPORTANT POINTS
- Get a list of the important stuff from your talk—no need to sift through a bunch of words.
SUMMARIZED VERSION
- We'll also whip up a short and sweet summary of what you said—so you can get the gist without all the gab.
5 Ways Our App Simplifies Your Life
MEETING MASTERY:
- Record your brainstorming sessions or team meetings effortlessly.
- Easily review the key points and decisions through the structured note and important points list.
- Share a quick summary with your team for a productive follow-up.
STUDY AID:
- Turn your class lectures into well-organized notes for better understanding.
- Quickly grasp the essential points from your lessons with the important points list.
- Create concise summaries to reinforce your learning.
IDEA JOURNAL:
- Capture your creative sparks on the go by speaking your thoughts into the app.
- Transform your ideas into a formatted note and extract key concepts effortlessly.
- Summarize your brilliant brainwaves for quick recall and inspiration.
INTERVIEW INSIGHTS:
- Record job interviews or important conversations for reference.
- Use the AI-processed note to review the discussion in a structured manner.
- Generate a summarized version to highlight crucial moments and decisions.
PODCAST PERFECTION:
- Record podcast episodes and let the app create transcriptions for easy content creation.
- Utilize the important points list to identify key topics and highlights.
- Share concise summaries on social media to engage your audience and spark interest.
It's like magic, but with words! Give it a go and see your ideas come to life.

bluejetty:00021361:ios.description:
Bridestory is a must-have app for brides-to-be. If you’re looking for a wedding planning app, this is it. Bridestory app is the place to find the best wedding vendors and professionals to make your dream wedding possible.
In this wedding app, you can browse through millions of wedding ideas and the vendors behind them. Send message and connect directly with vendors to learn more about their wedding services. Find the best wedding deals and promotions in the palm of your hand. You can also enjoy the reschedule option for a more convenience wedding planning.

- Find the right wedding vendors from 60+ countries with 20+ different categories (including wedding photographers and videographers, wedding decorators, wedding invitation designers, wedding venues, wedding dress designers, make up artists, bridal and more)

- Enjoy a more convenience wedding planning with reschedule** option
- Hire Hilda*, our professional wedding consultant, to assist you throughout the wedding planning process
- Read wedding ideas and wedding planning tips from thousand of articles in The Bridestory Blog
- Browse through vendors profiles and portfolios, contact vendors via email, message, phone, and more
- Browse through our vast library of wedding inspirations with countries, colors and categories filter
- Easily create your personal wedding inspiration board, save and share your wedding inspirations
- Run through wedding vendor reviews to make the right decisions
- Share your experience by leaving reviews and comments on vendor profiles
*Hilda services are currently only available for weddings in Indonesia, specifically Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya, and Bandung.

bluejetty:00178484:ios.description:
What can iFont do?
iFont lets you install new fonts for use in apps which support creating content using custom fonts, such as Pages, Keynote or Numbers.
What can't iFont do?
iFont can't change the system font; work with the keyboard; or force apps to let you customise the font. iFont also can't make Comic Sans look good.

***

CUSTOM FONTS
Install your own fonts (.ttf, .ttc, .otf formats supported, as well as these formats compressed in a .zip) for use in other apps. Simply download a font in a web browser, open in iFont and follow the simple instructions to install it on your device. You can also export a copy of the font, or send the profile to a friend to let them install it, too. iFont can also open archives containing multiple fonts.
FONT DOWNLOADS
iFont lets you download and install a range of fonts from the Google Fonts library, Dafont and more (including custom sources) within the app. It couldn’t be easier to find a suitable typeface for your next leaflet, poster or financial report.
***

Imported fonts are viewed as families allowing you to easily compare different weights and make the right choices. NOTEPAD
The Notepad you find under each font lets you test it out and type a message, and then export it as an image to send in apps such as Messages. Add some character to your texts by using a font which stands out from the crowd!
WATERFALL
See how a font looks at very small or very large point sizes easily using the Waterfall view. This lets you judge which size would be suitable for your use.
ZOOM
Zoom into a font up to 500%, allowing you to see the minute details in each character.
TECHNICAL DETAILS
See information about each font, from the designer and trademark information to the spacing of the ascents and descents.
***
“Missing fonts on iOS is an issue of the past, thanks to apps like iFont… I hope you saw how easy it is to install fonts on iPhone or iPad and I suggest you give iFont a try.” — Michael Kummer, blogger

bluejetty:00030182:ios.summary: Weigh Down is the PIONEER of faith-based weight loss programs and the only answer to permanent weight loss! National best-selling author of "The Weigh Down Diet" and founder of Weigh Down Ministries, Gwen Shamblin Lara, brought this groundb
bluejetty:00030182:ios.description:
Weigh Down is the PIONEER of faith-based weight loss programs and the only answer to permanent weight loss! National best-selling author of "The Weigh Down Diet" and founder of Weigh Down Ministries, Gwen Shamblin Lara, brought this groundbreaking approach to weight loss directly to you through the Weigh Down TV app and now, her daughter, Elizabeth Shamblin Kaufmann brings you the Truthstream app containing all that Weigh Down TV offered and more!  Weigh Down is unlike any other diet program because instead of making you focus on the food’s content, it walks you through how to replace your love for food with a love for God. 
Weigh Down does not require pills, special foods or drink concoctions, or “have-to” exercise regimens! Imagine the freedom of never walking down the diet food aisle again, all while losing your excess weight. God did not put chocolate, sour cream, and butter on this earth to torture you, and you can learn how to enjoy all His amazing foods with a permanent newly-found self control. The Weigh Down method has been around since the mid–1980s, and you will meet people (just like yourself), who have been free from 30, 50, even over 100 pounds, and they have kept the weight off for decades. If you are sick of yo-yo dieting, Truthstream is the answer!
Truthstream App Features:
• Hundreds of hours of content covering subjects such as weight loss in every stage of life, overcoming strongholds such as alcohol and smoking, parenting and family issues, finances, etc., with more content added regularly!
• Download videos to watch offline, or connect using WiFi, 4G, 5G, and LTE.
• Resume playing right where you left off - you’ll never miss a moment!
• Tell your friends about your favorite videos with social media and email, right from the app.
• Subscribers can also watch rentals and purchases directly through the app.
• Access to select live webcasts, conventions, and other special events
When you were a child, you naturally ate according to the way God created your body - eating only when you were hungry and stopping when you were full. Go back to that approach and you fill discover an amazing freedom to eat whatever your body is calling for with the rediscovered ability to STOP when you are full. Like Gwen has always said, you will really be able to stop in the middle of a candy bar and have no desire to eat the second half! You can do it...starting today! The Truthstream App will give you access to the tools for permanent success in your weight loss and with any of life's struggles.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Truthstream on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://www.truthstreamnow.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.truthstreamnow.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00081789:ios.summary: PRONTO makes buying fares for MTS and NCTD easier than ever. Add money to your PRONTO app, then scan your phone at the validator each trip you make. Our pay-as-you-go function means you always get the best fare! When using the app, hold you
bluejetty:00081789:ios.description:
PRONTO makes buying fares for MTS and NCTD easier than ever. Add money to your PRONTO app, then scan your phone at the validator each trip you make. Our pay-as-you-go function means you always get the best fare! When using the app, hold your phone 5 to 6 inches below the validator to scan your barcode.
The PRONTO app can also help you plan trips, see real-time arrivals, get service statuses, save favorite stations, and find stops for San Diego County area transit so you can plan your trip around San Diego without any problems.
Always Get The Best Fare
With PRONTO, you can pay-as-you-go* by adding money to your PRONTO account with a credit or debit card. Every time you scan your app, the appropriate one-way fare is deducted from your balance. Look for validators at Trolley, SPRINTER and COASTER stations, and onboard buses.
You will never be charged more than a Day Pass ($6 Adult or $3 Reduced Fare) in a given calendar day, regardless of how many trips you make. Likewise, you will never be charged more than a Month Pass ($72 Adult or $23 Reduced Fare) regardless of the number of trips in a calendar month. 
You can track your progress toward a Day or Month Pass in the PRONTO app.
*Pay-as-you go features not available for COASTER (must prepay for Day or Month Pass). 
Manage Your PRONTO Cards
• Register your PRONTO card for balance protection
• Load money onto your card using a debit/credit card 
• Set up autoload to top off your card automatically when your balance gets low
• See your balance, current fare, and earned passes 
• Look up your recent scans, transfer times, and payment history
• Manage multiple PRONTO cards for your family or group
• Block/Unblock a lost or stolen card
Next Departures:
• Find Next Departures using stop number, address or landmarks
• See real-time bus and train service statuses and news
• Map and List view of Nearby Stops
• List of recent stops and favorites
Trip Planning:
• Plan a trip using popular landmarks or addresses
• Full trip itineraries with fare information, actual walking distance, and map view
• Set alerts to notify you when transit is arriving 
• See a list of recent trip plans
• Save favorite stops for easy access
Need More Help?
Contact PRONTO Support at 619-595-5636

-Live Feed: Stay updated with instant notifications about buyer signals, so you can follow up at the perfect moment.
-People: Effortlessly search, view, and update contact info, keeping your data fresh and actionable.
-Workflow: Seamlessly manage your Workflow with AI-prioritized Rhythm tasks, ensuring your actions are focused and impactful. (Currently in feature preview)
-Calls: Make or receive calls no matter where you are, keeping your conversations continuous and connected.
-Text Messaging: Send and receive text messages directly from the app, maintaining real-time communication.

bluejetty:00060683:ios.description:
What if the character in your book knew you were reading about him? Meet Michael Sterry. A few hours ago, he fell asleep in his home in England. Now, he has woken up in a strange, deadly place called the Anomaly Zone, or Anzo. He has no idea how he got there, but he knows one thing: he is holding a mysterious medallion that connects his world directly to your smartphone.
Maginary is not just a text quest; it is a groundbreaking interactive novel where the boundary between fiction and reality disappears. Michael knows you exist. He will talk to you, beg for your help, and completely rely on you to survive.
To help Michael escape the bizarre and dangerous world of Anzo, reading is not enough. You will have to use every hardware feature of your device!
KEY FEATURES:
- Break the Fourth Wall: Communicate with a protagonist who is fully aware that he is a character in a story being read by you.
- Physical Interactivity: Reading is not enough. To keep Michael alive, you will need to use the hardware features of your iPhone in ways the story will reveal — and you won't see coming.Shake your device, walk with it, use most of its features. 
- A Bizarre, Captivating World: Explore Anzo, a surreal landscape filled with rusty rescue robots , deserts made of yellow autumn leaves , and a sarcastic ex-smuggler who has been turned into a talking conch shell.
Are you ready to turn the page? Michael is waiting for you
