bluejetty:00183162:ios.name: AccuBow
bluejetty:00183162:ios.summary: Play Virtual Archery Games and hunt around with the world with AccuBow 2025! Enhanced / Realistic shooting hunting archery graphics and Exciting new virtual archery hunting modes and games! This app requires AccuBow hardware for a realist
bluejetty:00183162:ios.description:
Play Virtual Archery Games and hunt around with the world with AccuBow 2025! Enhanced / Realistic shooting hunting archery graphics and Exciting new virtual archery hunting modes and games! This app requires AccuBow hardware for a realistic, immersive archery experience. Get your hardware at www.accubow.com.
FEATURES:
Bow Hunt the World
 Play multiplayer with friends across 7 thrilling modes! Play against time to hunt specific animals and advance to the next world. Watch out for Dangerous Game Mode, if you’re too slow, the animals might hunt you back!
Helicopter Hog Hunting
 Soar the skies of Texas in this 2025 update, shooting hogs and coyotes as they run below.
Midnight Hyena Hunt
 Survive a thrilling scenario: a fallen elephant attracts packs of attacking hyenas. Fend them off to stay alive!
Airboat Hunting
 Race through swamps on an airboat to hunt hogs, alligators, and nutria rats in this adrenaline-pumping adventure.
Multi-Language Support
 Play in your preferred language by selecting from multiple options in the game settings.
Serious Bow Hunting
 Hunt iconic game in diverse environments like the Midwest Classic, African Safari, Alaskan Adventure, Sonoran Desert, and more. Hone your skills and master the craft.
Virtual Crossbow Interface
 Switch between vertical bow sights or crossbow scopes. Customize crosshairs, distance reticles, and zoom magnification in all modes.
Bow Battle Online Multiplayer!
 Challenge your friends head-to-head in Bow Battle Mode for the ultimate showdown!
AccuGo Walk & Stalk Mode
 Explore your surroundings in real life to track and hunt animals. Use the wind, avoid dangerous predators, and stay safe in this versatile mode.
Bowfishing
 Day or night, aim lower than the yardage suggests to perfect your bowfishing skills!
Duck Hunting
 Test your accuracy by shooting flying ducks from the air—a true test of skill!
Horseback Archery
 Ride at full speed and hit bullseyes! This mode challenges your instinctive shooting skills.
Zombie Apocalypse
 Survive in a post-apocalyptic city as the last human standing. Fight off zombies in a true test of survival.
Protect African Migration
 Save wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles crossing the Nile from crocodiles. Your aim can save the day!
Sonoran Desert Hunting
 Hunt bighorn sheep, coues deer, and javelina in the Sonoran Desert.
Archery Golf
 Play a virtual golf course—but with arrows instead of golf balls! Compete with friends or in multiplayer mode for a unique gaming experience.
Build Your Own Archery Range!
 Create custom archery ranges using a library of environments and animals. Set your yardages and angles for endless practice opportunities.
Realistic In-App Sounds
 Every mode features immersive, lifelike sounds to enhance your archery experience.
Bow Sight Customization
 Choose between open sights or a 5-pin setup. Program yardages to align with your real-life bow for better accuracy.
PLEASE NOTE:
- Grant the app access to your microphone and camera for proper shot recognition.
- Securely attach your phone to the AccuBow mount (compatible without a phone case; tablets not supported).
- Keep your back camera unobstructed during gameplay.
With AccuBow 2025, enjoy the most realistic and engaging archery experience available. Whether you’re bowfishing at night, protecting a migration, or battling zombies, there’s a mode for every archer!
By using this app, you agree to our Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00161285:ios.description:
Discover tunes of any genre, explore foreign cultures, and follow events. All this is available in a completely free mobile app.
Even with a slow Internet or WIFI connection you can listen to the radio for free and experience the excellent quality of the broadcasts online. The application has absolutely no ads and simple interface that allows you to save Internet traffic. 
Pop — the best hits of pop music from different eras, from golden hits to modern tracks. Top stations: Disney, Exclusively Adele, Highland, and hundreds of other streams will not leave you indifferent. 
Rock — the combination of powerful guitar riffs, bass lines and energetic vocals, creating a true atmosphere of rock and roll. From classic rock to modern metal and alternative sound. Bright representatives of the genre: Classic Rock Florida, Free Classic Rock, WRIF Rock Detroit will show you the best of the world of rock music. 
Dance — fiery and rhythmic music that will not get bored and make you move in time with the music. Enjoy bright remixes and dance together with: Side Street, Z108, PromoDJ, Fleet EDM, Kiss FM. 
Relax — calm and melodic music, which helps to relax and drown in pleasant memories. Relax and enjoy relaxation at any time of the day or night! Ambient Sleeping Pill, Frisky Chill, Birdsong, intra Nature, Lounge FM will help you. As well as many other radio streams for your peace of mind. 
Retro — is a genre of music based on the sound of past decades. Energize with the energy of the past with: NonStopOldies, NYE Underground, America Dance 90's. Dive into a world of nostalgia and listen to the hits of the 50's, 60's, 70's, 80's, 90's, and even the 00's. 
Jazz — а musical genre based on improvisation and variations from Creole rhythms and blues to modernism. Experience the sound of saxophone, trumpet, drums and double bass with the radio: Jus Bues Radio, Smooth Jazz Florida, Smooth Jazz Utah.
Rap — is a modern genre based on rhythmic recitation with musical accompaniment. It embodies the individuality and self—expression of the artists. In radio format, some of the most interesting stations: Urban 2K Radio, Mixtape Heat Radio, RnB, Fleet DJ Radio, which will not leave any listener indifferent. 
Talk — in this section there are radio stations, where live presenters discuss current topics, interview experts and celebrities, also summarize the day's results and share the latest news. Popular stations in this direction: Voice of America, Davidzhon, National Public Radio, WFMG G 101—3 live, Business FM. 
The best mood in every corner of the world, rain or shine, with the ability to listen to thousands of radio streams in real time, without ads. 
FM modulator and other devices are no longer needed. To listen to just the radio, all you need is your phone. 
The application has a clear interface, but it is also rich in functionality:
— Easy search
— Stream audio to your TV or headphones via Bluetooth or Google Chromecast
— Share any radio station with family and friends
— Create your media library with just 1 button, adding stations to favorites
— For users with disabilities, there are font size settings as well as full support for VoiceOver interface 
The app has a Premium subscription. It expands the functionality of users of the application:
— Alarm Clock. Meet the morning with your favorite hosts
— Sleep Timer. Fall asleep with the air of any station
— Track title. Find out what is on the air now with a convenient Google and Youtube search
Privacy Policy:
https://involtaradio.com/privacy_policy.pdf
Terms of Use: 
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
You can listen to any song in the background. Stereo sounds with you in the car, while traveling, on the way to work or at home. Sports news, favorite voices, modern music — play it all in a simple player.
If you own a radio station and want to add/remove a station to the app, email: info@involtaradio.com

bluejetty:00177575:ios.description:
Quran Reading is a Smartphone app made for Muslim iPhone/iPad users to read, recite, and listen the complete Holy Quran (قرآن) on the go. It has uniqueness in terms of its matchless audio recitation and rephrasing the Arabic wording of Al- Quran in English. It also presents the users with translation of the Sacred Ayahs in various languages. 
Features
Some of the most distinctive features of this application are:
• Heart touching and soulful mp3 recitation/Tilawat of the verses of Quran e Pak in the beautiful voice of world renowned Qari known as Mishari Rashid al-Afasy is the touchstone of this app.
• Translation of all the 114 Surahs of Quran Kareem () in English makes it easy to comprehend the actual gist of the instructions included in them. 
• Transliteration option helps individuals in knowing the accurate method of articulating the Sacred Verses in Arabic. In this way, this attribute gives great value to the consumers of this app by making them aware of how to properly read Quran e Majeed in Arabic.
• For those who want to look for a specific Surah, Ayah or any other text, a significantly developed Search bar assists them in finding any specific word put in it.
• Daily Notification is highly useful and distinguishing characteristic of this mobile application that daily tells the user about a new “Ayah of the Day”. This day by day notice about Quranic Verses helps people knowing about different subject matter each day.
• Go To choice functions for moving straight to a particular Ayah in a Surah at whatever time. So, if due to any reason, users want to read a specific section of a Chapter, this option serves them in the best way.
• Bookmarks selection lets the users to save any fraction of recitation to assist in continuing from same part of Surah for later recital. 
• Stop Signs are separately given in Settings to make the readers of Quran Kareem know about their true sense of usage during recitation.
• 14 Sajdahs are also individually stated to let the users be acquainted with their places of occurrence at some stage in Quran Recitation. 
• Font Size and Font Styles options give users freedom to set their desired size and pattern of the characters visible on screen. Thus, user interface is not limited and it could be made interesting as per individual`s choice.
• Save and Reset options could be used to keep and alter any changes made to the settings of the app. 
Download this free of cost and user-friendly Quran application now to be able to read, listen and understand the true essence of the Holy Quran in the best manner.

bluejetty:00115305:ios.name: Backyard Football '99
bluejetty:00115305:ios.summary:
HUDDLE UP FOR BACKYARD FOOTBALL
Backyard Football 1999 is now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, rushing with Pete Wheeler, scoring touchdowns with Pablo Sanchez, or e
bluejetty:00115305:ios.description:
HUDDLE UP FOR BACKYARD FOOTBALL
Backyard Football 1999 is now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, rushing with Pete Wheeler, scoring touchdowns with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter of hosts Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!
GAME MODES
Single Game: With 5 backyard fields and unique weather condition settings, players can pick their team, design their team logos, and play a pick-up game!
Season Mode: Players can draft seven players from the 30 iconic Backyard Sports characters and a collection of legendary pros including Barry Sanders, Jerry Rice, John Elway, Dan Marino, Randall Cunningham, Drew Bledsoe and Steve Young to compete against 15 other teams in the Backyard Football League. Each team plays a 14-game season. By the end of the regular season, the 4 division champions and 4 wild card teams enter the Backyard Football League Playoffs to compete for the Super Colossal Cereal Bowl!
EARN CLASSIC POWER UPS
Earn power-ups by completing passes on offense and sacking the opposing QB on defense.
Offensive
• Hocus Pocus – A pass play which results in a receiver teleporting down field.
• Sonic Boom – A run play which causes an earthquake to knock over the opposing team.
• Leap Frog – A run play which causes your running back to leap down field.
• Super Punt – A very powerful punt!
Defensive
• Cough Drop – A play that causes the opponent to fumble when tackled.
• Chameleon – A trick play that results in your team wearing the other team's colors for ultimate confusion.
• Spring Loaded – A play that causes your player to leap over the line of scrimmage to sack the QB.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.
Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. However, Backyard Football ‘99 runs well, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

bluejetty:00034142:ios.name: Smart Air Printer:Scan & Print
bluejetty:00034142:ios.summary: Smart Air Printer: Scan & Print is an easy-to-use printer app that helps you handle everyday printing and scanning tasks directly from your phone. The app combines mobile printing, document scanning, and file management into one simple expe
bluejetty:00034142:ios.description:
Smart Air Printer: Scan & Print is an easy-to-use printer app that helps you handle everyday printing and scanning tasks directly from your phone. The app combines mobile printing, document scanning, and file management into one simple experience so you can quickly prepare, organize, and print files whenever you need.
1. Main Features
• Print, scan, and share documents directly from your phone
• Wireless printing through smart printer connection
• Print documents, PDF files, photos, and other files easily
• Access and print files stored in cloud or online storage
• Find images online or prepare templates and edit before printing
2. Smart Air Printer
Smart Air Printer: Scan & Print is a reliable printer app that helps you handle everyday printing and scanning tasks directly from your phone. With this smart printer app, you can print documents, print PDF files, print photos, and scan documents quickly without complicated setup.
The app also works as a printer scanner, allowing you to scan documents using your camera and manage files directly on your device. After you scan documents, you can review them, organize files, and prepare them for printing or sharing.
This combination of print and scan tools makes the app useful for both personal and work tasks.
3. Wireless Printing With Air Printer
Smart Printer provides a smooth wireless printing experience using airprint technology. The app connects your phone to a compatible airprint printer through Wi-Fi so you can start printing in seconds.
With this airprint printer app, you can print documents from phone, print PDF files, and print photos directly from your device. Wireless connectivity allows you to print files anytime as long as your phone and printer are on the same network.
The printer app keeps the print workflow simple so users can send documents to their printer quickly.
4. Print & Scan PDFs, IDs and Receipts
Smart Air Printer makes it easy to print and scan documents directly from your phone. The app supports common formats so you can print PDF files, print documents, print photos, as well as scan IDs, receipts, invoices, and passports without extra steps.You can select files, preview them, or quickly scan documents with automatic edge detection and enhancement. Everything can be done in just a few taps, making the app useful for everyday tasks such as printing study materials, managing work documents, or saving important paperwork.
With the ability to print and scan from your phone, you can handle files faster without transferring them to another device. Whether it’s an ID, a receipt, or a document, everything is ready when you need it.
5. Print From Cloud & Online Storage
Smart Air Printer:Scan & Print also supports cloud printing, allowing you to print documents stored online. This feature makes the printer app more flexible for users who store files in online storage services.
You can browse files, select documents, and print documents directly from cloud storage. This helps simplify the printing workflow and saves time when accessing files from different devices.
6. Print Photos With Editing Options
Smart Printer is not only designed for document printing but also works as a convenient photo printing tool. The printer app allows you to print photos from your phone while preparing images before printing.
You can search photos online, choose images from your gallery, and adjust layout before sending them to the printer. Preparing images helps improve results when you print photos.

Privacy policy: https://clever-ai-global.web.app/policy.html

bluejetty:00144674:ios.description:
Everything you need from your bank, in one app.
Open a free EUR account, pay with neon, shop in installments, save for your plans and manage your loans.
Everyday essentials and bigger possibilities, all in the tbi bank app.
Make managing your money easier
Open a EUR account in the app with no opening or monthly maintenance fee. Check your balance and transactions whenever you want.
Get your neon card with no issuance or maintenance fee, delivered to your address. Pay in stores and online, or add it to Apple Pay or Google Wallet.
Withdraw cash twice a month from ATMs with no fee from tbi bank. ATM operators may charge their own fees.
Add money to your neon account using a card from another bank.
Pay bills and send money in just a few taps
Open a term deposit from €1, choose a term, and add more money during the first 30 days. Check your balance and accrued interest in the app. Rates depend on the term and currency you choose. Eligible deposits are protected under the applicable deposit guarantee scheme.
Put more options in your pocket
If eligible, activate a Shopping Limit of up to €2,500 for purchases with neon. Switch between your own money and Shopping Limit in the app, and see both balances separately.
Split an eligible neon card purchase into 3, 6 or 12 installments from your transaction history. Three-installment plans have no fee; other options may have fees.
Changed your mind about paying all at once? You can also split an eligible purchase you already made with your own money. The amount returns to your account, and you repay it in installments. See the available options and any fees before confirming.
Find more in the Shopping mall
Explore online stores and offers across fashion, electronics, home and more, directly in the app.
Shop with available installment options and earn Rewards on eligible purchases. Convert your Rewards into money in your account.
Take care of your loan on the go
See if you have a pre-approved offer or apply for a personal loan of up to €40,000 in the app. If approved, review the terms, choose from the available options and sign digitally.
Track upcoming installments, pay in the app, and view or download your repayment schedule.
Request full early repayment. If eligible, use Payment Holiday to postpone an installment for one month.
Questions? We’re here.
Chat with our team in the app, 24/7.
Availability
Note: The Greek version of the app does not yet offer all the services listed above. More services will be added soon.
Note: Interest rates may vary by market and product and may change. Eligibility and terms apply.
tbi bank provides loans in amounts ranging from €200 to €40,000, with repayment terms ranging from 5 to 120 months and an Annual Percentage Rate (APR) ranging from 13% to 50%. The time required for the loan to be disbursed depends on the credit assessment of the borrower and the selected method of disbursement.
Example: For a loan disbursed as of 01 January 2026 in the amount of €10,000, with a repayment term of 60 months and without insurance, the customer will make 60 equal monthly instalments of €251.34 each, with the first instalment due on 05 February 2026. The total amount of the loan is €10,000. The total amount payable by the customer is €15,080.48. The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is 18.91% and the Fixed Annual Interest Rate is 17.52%.
TBI Bank EAD, with headquarters and address for correspondence: Sofia 1421, Lozenets district, 52 - 54 Dimitar Hadjikotsev Street, e-mail: office@tbibank.bg, website: www.tbibank.bg, registered in the Commercial Register at the Registry Agency at the Ministry of Justice with UIC 131134023, licensed as a Bank and respectively carrying out banking activity according to License No B 30 and Orders RD 22 - 1067 / 13.08.2003, No RD 22 - 1067 / 12.06.2007, RD 22 - 1560 / 20.07.2007, RD 22 - 2270 / 16.11.2009, RD 22 - 0451 / 28.02.2012 and RD 22 - 0451 / 22.10.2012 of the BNB.

bluejetty:00022462:ios.summary:
A BRAND NEW EPIC CYBERPUNK FANTASY ACTION GAME
Cyber Fighters is a free-to-play of the new shadow stickman style game in cyberpunk theme, a great combination of action games, role-playing (RPG), and player versus player. 
A new experience
bluejetty:00022462:ios.description:
A BRAND NEW EPIC CYBERPUNK FANTASY ACTION GAME
Cyber Fighters is a free-to-play of the new shadow stickman style game in cyberpunk theme, a great combination of action games, role-playing (RPG), and player versus player. 
A new experience for players to enjoy the classic fantasy action fighting game. You will be amazed that Cyber Fighters is an offline cyberpunk game, which doesn't need the internet to dive in a fantasy world & fighting the epic shadow battle. Fight in your own way because you can select among 5 unique cyber fighters with diversity skill & battle style. You can choose Cyber Officer Swordsman, The Punisher of God Thunder, The Queen Bee Archer Assassins, Cyborg Senseless Killer, and The Deathly Shadow Panther.
Ready to plunge into the cyberpunk world with infinite hack and slash battles & countless fast-paced action? Then welcome to Detroit city, where it all begins!
In 2077, World War 3 ended, the world map was redrawn. North America was divided into 5 regions intersecting in the city of Detroit. After a series of failed agreements between states, the city fell into anarchy.
More than 750.000 of civilians were forgotten by the rest of the world. Over time, in the forgotten city, formed criminal forces. They rebelled and fought with each other to compete for their influence over the city.
Everything in Detroit is now operating like an amip. If you can not be a part of it, then you will soon become its prey. 
Will you be powerful enough to change that, cyber fighters?
For fans of classic Action RPG and Stickman Fighting Games around the world, you will not be disappointed for sure once join this game - a massive cyberpunk world full of gang wars, cyber weapons, hack n slash combats, survival battles, and many more. 
Let's start the adventure right now, fighters! It's time for you to become the Greatest Cyber Fighter Legends!
**********
THE LEGENDS STICKMAN CYBER FIGHTER
Cyber Fighter offers five different heroes with a diversity of combat styles for players to choose: Slashing monster by a Thermal Blade, Thunder Hammer & Energy Spear or shooting their way over bosses by a Mighty Arrow or Power Cannon.
Choose your stickman cyber fighter with a diversity combat style to fight the monster cyber hunter in this dark cyberpunk world. Build your own fighting style with your own skill tree and deep inventory system that encourages endless combat experimentation and customization.
BRING JUSTICE FOR THE DARKNESS CYBERPUNK CITY
Each chapter goes through, you'll experience an epic battle with the darkness shadow force: zombie, ninja, yakuza, cyber monster, gangster, assassins, cyber dark angel, or the gigantic boss.
COMRADE-IN-ARMS SYSTEM
Besides the unique combat style, each hero will have their own comrade-in-arms to summon and it has their own combat style too. Fighting alongside your soul knight robot through the deathly shadow battle. 
STUNNING DESIGN, EFFECT & GRAPHICS
The Cyberpunk world in Cyber Fighters is full of the amazing design concept from background to character, & enemy design. You will be amazed by the fascinating graphic & effect skill in Cyber Fighters. 
Game Features:
- Offline Mode: Experience the game with no internet connection required! 
- Enjoy incredible graphics of the Cyberpunk world!
- Fight against other Player with online mode (PVP)
- Dive into this Action RPG on your own fighting style!
- Learn skills, face against many cruel enemies, evil cyber monster, the cyber mafia, cyber shadow hunter assassins, and mighty bosses. 
- Collect lots of cyber weapons in the huge weapon system!
- Customize your hero with the costume & drones system.
- Challenge yourself to survive in challenge mode with endless waves of cyber hunter enemies.
- Many more interesting features that you will find out in-game!.
Follow us at: 
https://www.facebook.com/OfficialCyberFighters/
Feel free to send us feedback via email
ezgcyberfighters@gmail.com

No Detran Inteligente você tem também o Detran QRCode. No dia do atendimento agendado, ao chegar na unidade de trânsito, procure pelo cartaz com o Detran QRCode e confirme sua presença utilizando o aplicativo. Rápido e fácil, sem filas.
É simples e prático. É Detran Inteligente.

bluejetty:00120906:ios.description:
Beat Maker Go is the ultimate drum pad machine app. With Beat Maker Go, you can perform beats easily and create amazing music tracks with 200+ sound packs from our library. Share your music with friends and other people on social media or anywhere you like.
This app is for beginners and PRO beat makers. If you are just getting started with music, our easy lessons will help you learn how to get into beat making the right way. Get a new cool hobby with Beat Maker Go.
But it’s not just for beginners. Experienced beat makers will love our "Advanced mode". Practice skills and grow with 2,000+ lessons. Listen and repeat the beats, create your own loops, record and share them.
Use loops, blend them, and record your performance in a fun way. Use the pads to create top-notch mixtapes or music sets. Play while you are on the move.
The presets library offers the most recent sound packs in various genres:
Hip-Hop
Trap
House
EDM
Dubstep
Techno
Rock
Synthwave
This app is ideal if you would like to create music like an established producer. High-quality samples are made by professional sound producers and dedicated musicians. This partnership helps us keep the app up-to-date and provides you with even better stuff on a regular basis!
ACADEMY:
Learn how to make beats like a pro with the academy. Lessons in 70+ packs. Learn how to make beats like a pro. Upgrade your skills.
FEATURES:
- High-quality samples (uncompressed 16-bit, 44.1 KHz).
- 32 pads in two banks.
- Predefined beat loops in every sound preset.
- Overdub feature to add sounds to recorded loops.
- Music recording and sharing.
- Voice recording.
Follow our interactive tutorial and go through every step of beat making right now!
The app contains the following subscription options:
- Pro Version weekly 5.99 with 3-days free.
- Pro Version yearly 29.99 with 7-days trial. 
- Music One weekly 9.99 with 3-days trial.
- Music One Promo weekly 9.99 with 14-days trial.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to the publication.
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to our Premium features:
* All sound packs unlocked
* Recording a track
* A video course on beat making
* Advanced mode with loops
* No ads

bluejetty:00024230:ios.name: Epic War: Thrones
bluejetty:00024230:ios.summary: Play as a lord in the Three Kingdoms and lead your army to conquer the chaotic land. Build your city, research technologies, and expand territories to boost resource production. Arm your loyal generals with the best skills and battle with t
bluejetty:00024230:ios.description:
Play as a lord in the Three Kingdoms and lead your army to conquer the chaotic land. Build your city, research technologies, and expand territories to boost resource production. Arm your loyal generals with the best skills and battle with thousands of other players online in real-time! You can join an alliance to grow and conquer with your friends, or else you can become a ranger that plunders the world as a lone wolf. Made by Unreal Engine 4, Epic War: Thrones brings PC-level experiences to mobile. Experience the realistic landscape and weather, and implement them into your strategy. Command, conquer, and claim the throne!
**Game Features**
【Epic battles between hundreds of players】
Join real-time epic battles with hundreds of players, every decision you make matters! Full assault or sneak attack? Ally or foe? Choose your strategy carefully. Capture ports and passes to strengthen your position, fight for resource grids to boost your production. Rule the battlefield like a real commander.
【The world of the Three Kingdoms recreated】
Embark on a conquest that took place a thousand years ago, into the well-known history of the Three Kingdoms. Witness the clashes of warlords, tactics from the Art of War being implemented, and legendary generals confronting each other. Will you be able to survive in this chaotic land and eventually claim the throne?
【Legendary generals at your command】
Summon legendary generals of the Three Kingdoms to join your cause! Be they the formidable general Guan Yu, or the loyal marshal Jiang Wei who tried to defend his empire until the end. Each with unique skills and troop type, use them to build your powerful legion! All generals are detailed modeled in the game, they are once made alive from the past history and are waiting for your command!
【Alliances, factions, and rangers】
Are you a team player or a lone wolf? As an alliance player, you can fight with your friends, defeat strong enemies together and help each other to grow. Or else, you can be a stealthy and maneuverable ranger, a lone wolf that plunders the battlefield and a true predator. It is up to you to choose who you want to become.
【Realistic world with diverse terrains and weathers】
Explore the massive map with over 4 million tiles, march your troops across mountains, rivers, deserts, forests, and frozen lands. The global weather system will affect your army, generals, and overall combat effectiveness. Use the terrain and weather as your advantages, and you can defeat enemies that once seemly untouchable.
【Unlimited possible strategies】
Hundreds of general skills, 4 troop types with 28 variants, 6 different battle formations, and various Strategies that can utilize weather to strengthen your army. You have unlimited strategies to choose from, use them well and prove your wisdom!
**Get more information about Epic War: Thrones**
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EpicwarthronesSEA
Official Website: http://www.archosaur.com/epicwarthrones/
Discord: https://discord.gg/zujkyBnMwW
**Device Requirement**
System version: iOS 10 or above/ iPhone6s or newer are recommended.

bluejetty:00143764:ios.description:
The complete studio for piano visuals.
Record performances, edit MIDI, and visualize your playing in real time.
Create beautiful videos with falling notes, glowing lights, and stunning effects.
Used by top YouTube creators, music educators, and pianists worldwide.
CREATE
• Import a MIDI file and turn it into a piano video
• Record synchronized MIDI, audio, and camera video, in any combination
• Use AI to convert piano audio recordings into MIDI for falling-note visuals
• Add your own piano footage, customize the visualization, and export your video
PERFORM
• Connect a MIDI keyboard and visualize every note in real time
• Perform with responsive colors, lights, particles, and effects
• Create live piano visuals for livestreams and concerts
EXPLORE
• Open MIDI files and MusicXML scores
• Follow synchronized sheet music as the music plays
• Reveal pitches, patterns, and harmony through color
DESIGN YOUR VISUAL WORLD
• Create a realistic 3D grand piano scene with animated keys and hammers, reactive lighting, and customizable camera movement
• Add particles from presets or refine their gravity, friction, turbulence, and blending
• Simulate LED strip lighting and shadows, even when you record without an LED strip
• Blend your piano footage with atmospheric Saber glow effects
CREATE YOUR SIGNATURE STYLE
• Choose single-color, 12-color, gradient, track, or random note colors
• Explore 2D and 3D note styles, including gems, crystals, and reflective glass
• Customize note shapes and materials, or apply your own textures
• Import images or videos as custom backgrounds
• Save and reuse visual presets for a consistent look across videos
EDIT AND SYNCHRONIZE
• Add, remove, split, join, move, and change note length
• Adjust pitch, timing, velocity, tracks, tempo, and playback
• Synchronize MIDI, audio, and video
• Automatically detect and align the keyboard in your footage
• Isolate your hands and keys, with keying, color, and lighting controls
• Crop, rotate, and position your piano footage
FINISH AND SHARE
• Record on mobile, then transfer your recording to SeeMusic on desktop for editing and video creation
• Create widescreen or vertical videos for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and more
• Export in up to 4K at 60 FPS, with rendering optimized for desktop and mobile
• Choose your format, resolution, frame rate, and quality
• Save complete projects with their presets and media
MAKE MUSIC VISIBLE
Give each of the 12 musical pitches its own color. Add pitch names, solfège, guides, bar lines, and other musical references to see familiar music from an entirely new perspective.
Use SeeMusic to create videos for social media, produce visuals for live performances, or discover more in the music you play.
SUPPORT
https://www.seemusicapp.com/support
Instagram: @seemusicpiano
YouTube: youtube.com/seemusicpiano
Website: https://www.seemusicapp.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/visualMusicDesign
Terms of Subscription:
https://www.seemusicapp.com/subscription-terms-of-use
Privacy Policy:
https://www.seemusicapp.com/privacy

Com o GetNinjas, v
bluejetty:00162101:ios.description:
Você trabalha com prestação de serviços? Está cansado de procurar vagas de emprego e pretende desempenhar sua função de forma freelancer? Baixe o GetNinjas, aplicativo para profissionais, e seja um profissional autônomo!
Com o GetNinjas, você realiza o seu trabalho online pelo celular, como freelancer, tudo isso sem ficar caçando vagas de emprego. Aqui não importa se você é marido de aluguel, diaristas ou tem qualquer outro tipo de emprego na prestação de serviços, o GetNinjas tem um lugar para você!
Pensando em você que trabalha como profissional autônomo, o nosso aplicativo para profissionais têm como principal objetivo conectar quem precisa com quem sabe fazer, com uma quantidade gigantesca de serviços disponibilizados. Além disso, aqui você tem à sua disposição um trabalho online e diversos outros benefícios. Confira:
Benefícios de ser profissional cadastrado no GetNinjas:
- Um pedido fechado a cada 30 segundos
- Academia Ninja: nossa plataforma de capacitação
- Clube Ninja: descontos exclusivos com nossos parceiros
- Atendimento 24 horas (por chat no app ou site e redes sociais)
- Você nas rédeas do seu negócio: negocie os valores do seu trabalho diretamente com os seus clientes
- E muito mais…
Como funciona o GetNinjas?
Trabalhar como prestador de serviços com o GetNinjas é bem simples. Vem ver:
1. Baixe o nosso aplicativo pensado para profissionais (GetNinjas Profissionais) e faça o seu cadastro, selecionando a categoria de serviços que irá prestar
OBS: você vai precisar cadastrar seus dados pessoais, informações sobre o serviço que presta e a cidade que atua.
2. Compre um dos pacotes de moedas que você vai usar para desbloquear o contato de um pedido
3. Assim que um cliente fizer um pedido na sua categoria e próximo de você, uma notificação irá surgir para que você consiga desbloquear e assim entrar em contato com a pessoa. É uma forma simples e efetiva de conseguir trabalho online.
Categorias que você pode trabalhar através do GetNinjas:
Reformas e Reparos
Trabalhe como eletricista, marido de aluguel, pedreiro, pintor e muito mais para ajudar nas reformas e reparos com os seus serviços.
Serviços Domésticos
Uma categoria para prestação de serviços como diaristas, faxineiras, babás e outros serviços para ambientes domésticos.
Assistência Técnica
Seja um profissional técnico no conserto de eletrodomésticos, celulares e computadores, relógios e diversos outros serviços.
Design e Tecnologia
Realize suas atividades de audiovisual, como edição de fotos e vídeos, marketing, criação de logos, desenvolvimento de sites e aplicativos, podendo ser um profissional freelancer.
Eventos
Tudo para fazer a festa com os seus clientes e os convidados! Assessoria de eventos, fotógrafos, buffet, bartenders e muito mais.
Moda e Beleza
Para você deixar todos os clientes sempre estilosos e bem arrumados, seja um cabeleireiro, maquiador e manicure cadastrado no GetNinjas.
Saúde
Cuidar da saúde tem que ser uma prioridade. Cuide do bem-estar dos seus clientes atuando como nutricionista, psicólogo e muitos outros.
Aulas
Transmita o seu conhecimento! Trabalhe como professor particular de idiomas, música, informática e muitas outras áreas.
Consultoria
Faça atendimentos e consultorias de diversas especialidades, como advogados, contadores e tradutores, podendo até atuar como freelancer e oferecer seus serviços de forma online.
Automóveis
Tudo para fazer a manutenção dos carros, com especialistas em mecânica, guincho, borracharia e muitos outros serviços.
Vem divulgar os seus serviços aqui no GetNinjas. Não importa em qual categoria você trabalha, seja como diaristas, advogado, bartender, aumente a sua clientela, faça o seu trabalho online pelo celular, se torne um profissional freelancer e não procure por mais vagas de emprego.

bluejetty:00161263:ios.description:
A game created with passion by one person!
Embark on a journey to a vast world in Almora Darkosen RPG, a classic retro-style hack and slash game!
Immerse yourself in a huge, open world full of secrets and dangers, spend countless hours exploring, fighting, and developing your character.
DISCOVER THE EXPANSIVE ISLAND OF ALMORA:
Traverse diverse locations, from lush fields and dark forests to treacherous swamps, ancient crypts, and vast deserts.
Discover hidden caves, dungeons, and towns, full of treasures, quests, and secrets to uncover.
KEY GAME FEATURES:
• Classic retro-style RPG: Feel the nostalgia of old-school RPGs with pixel art graphics and addictive gameplay.
• Engaging storyline: Take part in an epic adventure full of main and side quests that will provide you with many hours of entertainment.
• Extensive item system: Find and use hundreds of items such as swords, axes, shields, armors, potions, and many more.
• Classic inventory: deposits and old-school inventory system.
• Crafting and mining: Create your own items, upgrade them, and search for valuable minerals in the mines.
• Mercenaries: Hire a helper to fight by your side and face hordes of monsters together.
• Diverse opponents: Fight bosses and unique monsters, each with their own skills and tactics.
• Minigames: Relax and try your hand at various minigames available in taverns and hidden locations.
• NPC conversations: Meet the inhabitants of Almora, discover their stories, and complete tasks for them.
• Character development: Choose the skill path that best suits your playstyle and become a powerful hero.
• In-game encyclopedia: Gain knowledge about items, monsters, and crafting thanks to the built-in encyclopedia.
• Achievements and statistics: Track your progress and earn achievements for completing difficult challenges.
• New Game+: Finish the game and start a new adventure at a higher difficulty level.
• NO Pay to win!
JOIN THE ALMORA COMMUNITY:
• Official game website: https://almoradarkosen.com
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AlmoraDarkosenRPG
• Discord: https://discord.gg/J8cDhzh
• YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj9CP_2jixcstempw294PFw

bluejetty:00153272:ios.description:
Transync AI - Real-Time Interpretation & Translation for Meetings, Presentations & Conversations
Powered by advanced end-to-end speech models, Transync AI provides low-latency simultaneous interpretation for meetings, presentations, and in-person conversations. Work across 60+ languages with a bilingual dual-screen display, AI voice playback and Voice Clone, an AI Translation Assistant, AI-generated meeting minutes, and Presentation Mode for live multilingual events. One account syncs across iOS, macOS, and Windows, and new users receive a 40-minute free trial upon registration.
Key Features
- Real-Time Simultaneous Interpretation: Speak naturally with low-latency two-way translation that keeps meetings and conversations moving.
- Dual-Screen Bilingual Display: View source and translation side by side for smooth reading and effortless comprehension.
- AI Voice Playback & Voice Clone: Speak translated content instantly with natural AI voices. Voice Clone support, where available, enables a more familiar and flexible voice experience for conversations, talks, demos, and live interactions.
- Presentation Mode: One host can share live translated text and optional AI voice with an audience. Invite attendees by link, QR code, or Room ID, while each participant follows in the language they choose.
- AI Translation Assistant: Improve terminology accuracy with custom keywords and context tailored to your topic or domain.
- AI Meeting Minutes: Capture bilingual transcripts, extract key points, and generate meeting notes with one-click export.
- 60+ Languages: Switch flexibly across Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, and more.
- Multi-Platform & Meeting App Support: One account works across iOS, macOS, and Windows. On desktop, use Transync AI with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and more, with no plug-ins required.
Use Cases
- Enterprise Global Meetings: For multinational companies, trade teams, consultancies, educational institutions, and law firms.
- Presentations, Education & Events: International symposia, business negotiations, trade shows, online roadshows, training sessions, campus lectures, and product demos.
- Individuals: Expat professionals, international students in classes and discussions, freelancers, and travelers needing cross-border communication.
Why Choose Transync AI?
- Advanced AI speech translation models optimized for low latency and high-quality live communication.
- Bilingual dual-screen and floating subtitle views that improve understanding and collaboration.
- Natural AI voice playback and Voice Clone support, where available, for more familiar and flexible voice delivery.
- Presentation Mode lets one host share live translation with an audience, while each participant chooses their own language.
- AI Translation Assistant with custom keywords and context, plus AI meeting minutes that save time after the conversation.
Whether it's formal business, academic discussions, a live presentation, or day-to-day travel, Transync AI provides a reliable, accurate, and intelligent translation experience.
Get Transync AI Now
Transync AI helps you handle online international meetings, offline conferences and exhibitions, campus lectures, and live multilingual presentations, offering 60+ language simultaneous interpretation, real-time voice playback, bilingual subtitles, and AI-generated meeting minutes.

Privacy Policy: https://www.transyncai.com/privacy/

The Creative Whack Pack is the App Store's "premier creative thinking/innovation tool." 
The Creative Whack Pack is a “creative workshop in an App.” It consists of 100 illustrated creativity strategies. Each of these is packed with stories, examples, and questions.
These 100 creativity strategies will “whack” you out of your habitual thought patterns and allow you to look at what you're doing in a fresh way. Use the workshops to stimulate your thinking.
••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••
For: Creatives, business people, educators, students, coaches, designers, and anyone else who'd like to boost their creativity.
••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••
Based on the million-selling Creative Whack Pack card deck, this App can serve you as a: Creativity tool, mind jogger, Oracle, workshop, and coach. 
“A cross between a tarot card and a best friend, the Creative Whack Pack forces your psyche to look in the mirror and challenge what it sees.” — Elle Magazine 
••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••
The Creative Whack Pack is a “creative workshop in an App.” It consists of 100 illustrated creativity strategies. Each of these packed with stories, examples, and questions.
— 25 Explorer strategies highlight places to find new information.
— 25 Artist strategies provide techniques to generate new ideas. 
— 25 Judge strategies lend decision-making advice. 
— 25 Warrior strategies give you the “kick” you need to get your ideas into action.
Work with these interactive creative strategies in the Creative Workshops. 
You can use the Creative Whack Pack by yourself, or with colleagues and friends.
The ideas you generate will delight you! Your involvement in each session can be as brief a 30-second “quick hit of stimulation,” or as long as ten-minute “creative workshop.”
Roger von Oech created this product. His seminars and products have enhanced the creative thinking skills of millions worldwide. He is the author of the creativity classic A "Whack on the Side of the Head," "A Kick in the Seat of the Pants," "Expect the Unexpected," and "The Creative Contrarian." He also created the popular Ball of Whacks (set of magnetic design pieces), the X-Ball, and the Star-Ball. He earned his Ph.D. from Stanford University in the “History of Ideas.”
“Roger von Oech has won a loyal following around the country.”
— BusinessWeek Magazine
“Business Brilliance!” —USA Today
“What a technique!” —ABC’s 20/20

Join the Live event “Battle Pass - Season 3” & unlock Papi & Doge: Our beloved meme character skins. 
Welcome to Battle Stars: Battle Royale game, an epic brawl stars multiplayer games with fast-paced gun clash & exciting new shooting games modes where you dont stumble guys. 4v4 Team DeathMatch, 3-player Squad Battles & Battle Royale games are fun & quick-to-play battle shooting games for you to enjoy with super weapons & exclusive skins for every brawl stars. Play easy-to-learn multiplayer shooting games to upgrade as you level up. You need not stumble guys. 
🤩Exciting Game Modes:😎
4v4 TDM mode!
Join the brawl stars clash royale game in a real-time 4v4 TDM gun action with your friends. TDM is played in your favorite map 'Badlands', giving you the Zooba feel! Get into the multiplayer shooting games as you join a 12-player clash of clans with your friends or a private team & compete against them. Make sure you don't stumble guys!
Classic Battle Royale & Squad BR Mode!
Enjoy the Classic Battle Royale game & the 3-player Squad Battle Royale in city maps. Play squad battle against the other Mobile legends in quick gun mortal combat without stumble guys. Brawl, clash, fight, & shoot online against the real players in Battle Royale and become the last person standing in this shooting games. Shoot without stumble guys.
Team Rumble mode! 
Team rumble is a new TDM mode where you can throw GRENADES and destroy opponents with drag & aim shooting gun controls for higher accuracy without stumble guys in a battle arena. Rumble while you put your shooting games skills into action in battle !
🤩 New Skins & Perks as you upgrade:💥
Level up, complete missions & unlock new skins for your favorite battle royale shooter hero. With every multiplayer brawl victory, earn rewards to open legendary gun heroes, allowing you to emerge as a pro in shooting games without stumble guys.
🤩Explore Super Weapons: 💪
Each star has his own weapons & abilities to give you an edge in this brawl stars multiplayer games. After dealing enough damage with primary guns in battle royale, use the super weapons. Express your shooter style with secondary weapons in the battle arena.
🤩Upgrade Heroes & Play with Friends

bluejetty:00097805:ios.description:
Hexa Coin Match is a game that offers simple and intuitive gameplay, making it accessible to players of all ages. Just tap to start stacking those colorful coins. It’s easy to get into but mastering it requires some clever thinking and strategy, making it great for quick sessions or deep dives. The graphics are finely detailed, with each frame crafted like a piece of art. The minimalist design transports you into a vibrant, organized world that's both soothing and engaging. Whether you're looking to relax or sharpen your focus, you'll find yourself immersed in the delightful universe of Hexa Coin Match. Each new level brings fresh challenges to keep your mind sharp. From simple stacking to complex strategies, every level is designed to be both fun and challenging. As you progress deeper into the game, more surprises and enjoyment await.
How to Play:
- Tap to lace a coin.
- Matching Coins Stack Automatically and Disappear.
- Keep stacking and matching until you hit your target.
- Clear levels to take on brand-new challenges.
Game Features:
- One-Tap Controls: Super easy to pick up, perfect for all gamers.
- Eye-Catching Colors: Enjoy a visual treat with soft tones and bright colors.
- Play Offline: No internet? No problem! Play anytime, anywhere.
- Brain Teasers: Sharpen your skills and stay focused.
- Power-Ups: Use boosts to power through tough spots.
- Unlock New Modes: Discover fresh gameplay elements as you advance, adding endless variety.
For Gamers:
Whether you're looking for a chill session or want to challenge your brain during downtime, Hexa Coin Match has got you covered. Download now and dive into this addictive stacking adventure!

bluejetty:00073937:ios.name: System Status Pro: hw monitor
bluejetty:00073937:ios.summary:
An advanced tool for monitoring your iPhone and iPad performance.
System Status provides graphical monitoring of all the device's resources such as CPU, memory, disk, battery and wifi/cell data usage. Further, it shows network-related info
bluejetty:00073937:ios.description:
An advanced tool for monitoring your iPhone and iPad performance.
System Status provides graphical monitoring of all the device's resources such as CPU, memory, disk, battery and wifi/cell data usage. Further, it shows network-related info such as wifi/cell connection details and the routing table. Finally, System Status displays operating system details such as kernel version, memory page statistics and shows various hardware-related data.
BATTERY
• Graphical battery level display
• Battery state monitoring (discharging, charging, full)
• Estimated battery work time for different usage patterns (standby, audio and video playback, Wi-Fi and 3G browser usage, talk time)
• Adjustable battery health to make the estimated work times usable for older batteries
MEMORY & DISK
• Real time memory usage monitoring - graphical display of wired, active, inactive, and free memory
• Detailed page statistics including page ins and outs, page faults, page lookups, page purges and others
• Used and free disk capacity monitoring
• File statistics (number of songs, videos, podcasts, artists, genres, etc.)
• Mounted file system list
CELL & NETWORK
• Cell and Wi-Fi network connection information
• IP address of the current connection
• Carrier information such as network technology used
• External IP address
• DNS server, default gateway
• Received and sent wifi/cell data since last boot
• Routing table
CPU
• CPU usage updated in real time
• Average load over the last 1, 5, and 15 minutes
OPERATING SYSTEM & HARDWARE INFORMATION
• System boot time and uptime
• Operating system and kernel version
• Device model and user name
• Detailed CPU and GPU information - model, core number, CPU and BUS frequency, L1, L2 cache sizes, and others
• Hardware features of the device including display resolution, pixel density, battery voltage, battery capacity, front and rear camera resolution and many more
RESOURCE GRAPHS
• Possibility to record up to 3 minutes of background activity
• Pinch to zoom & pan
• Play/pause to see real-time or history data
MORE
• Real time updates of the display every time the monitored parameters change
• Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop for most info
• Light/dark theme
• Copy/paste support
• Detailed help
• Regular updates

bluejetty:00178860:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed about having a dog? About a cute little puppy that you will take care of… Dreams come true with Tamadog. It is your new virtual friend. Care for it, love and make it happy.
Don’t hesitate and get a virtual faithful friend. Such a lovely, charming and cute puppy, who loves having fun, eating yummies and making selfies. You’ll never get bored with your doggy. Discover the Tamadog’s bright world with a variety of exciting adventures.
TAMADOG FEATURES:
VIRTUAL PET IN YOUR REAL HOME
Your pet needs everyday care. Feed it, clean and play with it. You can play both 3D and AR mode. Allow the app to use a phone camera and your puppy will appear right inside your house. 
RAISE A SMART PET
Record voice commands and train your doggy. From “sit down” to “break dance” – you can teach your Tamadog lots of cool tricks. Talk to your friend, it is so eager to learn.
CAPTURE AMUSING MOMENTS
Take sweet selfies with your puppy, make hilarious videos and share them with friends.
UNLOCK NEW LEVELS
Keep raising a happy pet, play with it and enjoy extra activities as a reward.
DRESS UP YOUR PUPPY
Stylish suits for agile male pups and fancy dresses for fluffy girl puppies - dress up your little friend trendy.
ULTIMATE CUTENESS
Your new friend loves you and goes head over heels when you rub its belly. Can you imagine that your doggy will gladly lick your nose anytime you move the screen closer?
MINI-GAMES
Your puppy is asleep or you just need to relax from the daily routine? Challenge yourself with exciting mini-games and set your records. There are games for any taste: shooting bubbles is just as entertaining as healing and grooming your dog in diverse and enjoyable mini-games.
Check out the Tamadog pet-simulator and enjoy taking care of your little pet. The only virtual dog that looks like and feels like a real dog. Take it wherever you want, your doggy with its pet’s world is always at hand. No-stop fun with your virtual doggy.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Weekly Membership offers weekly subscription after 3-day free trial for unlocking all content and features.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00069499:ios.name: Dad's Monster House
bluejetty:00069499:ios.summary:
Dad's Monster House tells the story of Carlos' journey after he receives a distress call from his father, pleading for him to return to his old home and rescue his dad.
As he continues exploring the house, Carlos encounters many terrifying
bluejetty:00069499:ios.description:
Dad's Monster House tells the story of Carlos' journey after he receives a distress call from his father, pleading for him to return to his old home and rescue his dad.
As he continues exploring the house, Carlos encounters many terrifying yet 'cute' monsters. As he solves the puzzles before him, he draws ever closer to the truth...
Freud once said: "Love and work, work and love...that's all there is."
But what of the pain, the struggles that arise
when we're forced to choose between our ambitions and love?
In dealing with such conundrums, we’ve all likely hurt those we hold dearest to us.
For it's often in the darkness that we feel most safe.
With Dad's Monster House, I wish to provide those kinds of heartrending memories a chance at redemption.
I dedicate it to scientists, to my childhood dreams;
to those I love, and to faded memories.
I hope that within you'll find the greatest of answers, be they for your love, for science, or dreams.
[Gameplay]
A sudden call in the deep of night has you return to a house you haven't visited for many a year. You must unravel one puzzle after another: to from within scenes intertwined with memories find clues and get to the bottom of your father's secret.
The choice of whether to redeem or ultimately end this sad story lies in your hands.
[Features]
Instead of going for bright and vivid colors, I have opted for a black-and-white art style. The fragmented narration, plentiful puzzles, and delicate sound designs create an immersive experience where you as the player get to truly feel the ups and downs of the protagonist's emotions. Continue to unravel the story as you collect more items...

OVERNIGHTSCRIBE Accent is the all-in-one clinical notes platform built exclusively for physicians who demand speed, accuracy, and flexibility in their documentation workflow.

** FEATURES **
** Dictate & Submit for Professional Transcription > Human accuracy when it matters most.
Record your clinical dictations with crystal-clear audio capture and submit directly to our professional medical transcriptionists — ensuring compliance, precision, and peace of mind for complex cases.

Can't wait? Use our AI-powered Speech-to-Text engine to generate structured clinical notes instantly. Perfect for high-volume days when every minute counts.
** Edit, eSign & Finalize > Complete control over every note.
Review and refine notes with an intuitive editor, then apply your legally binding electronic signature in one tap. Your documentation, perfected. 
** Print, Email & Fax > Seamless delivery, every time. 
Send finalized notes directly from the app via print, secure email, or fax — keeping your care team connected and your workflow uninterrupted. Export notes as PDF, RTF, or text files.
** Voice Chat with Multi-LLM AI > Your intelligent thinking partner.
Chat with multiple leading AI language models through natural voice conversation. Explore differentials, options, and suggestions.

bluejetty:00070159:ios.summary:

Word Bubbles is a word puzzle with a twist: instead of loose letters, every word is split into syllables floating in coloured bubbles. Tap them in the right order and the word snaps b
bluejetty:00070159:ios.description:
Pop the bubbles. Connect the syllables. Build the word.
Word Bubbles is a word puzzle with a twist: instead of loose letters, every word is split into syllables floating in coloured bubbles. Tap them in the right order and the word snaps back together.
EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN
Tap two bubbles to join them. Get the order right and the word locks in. Get it wrong and nothing is lost, so you can experiment freely. The rules take five seconds; the harder levels take a lot longer.
WHY SYLLABLES CHANGE THE GAME
Most word games hand you a pile of letters and let you brute-force your way through. Here the pieces already mean something, which means guessing gets you nowhere. You have to hear the word before you can build it.
THOUSANDS OF LEVELS
From short warm-ups to long chains that will genuinely make you think. New words are added with every update.
BONUS WORDS AND REWARDS
Spot a valid word we did not ask for and you still get credit. Bonus finds earn coins you can spend on clues when a level has you stuck.
CLUES WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Stuck on one word? Use a clue and keep moving. No level is a dead end.
PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No connection required. Perfect on a plane, on the train, in a waiting room or anywhere with no signal.
GOOD FOR YOUR VOCABULARY
Every level is a small workout for your word recall. Players use it to keep sharp, to build vocabulary, and to practise English. Breaking words into syllables is how people learn to read, which is part of why this sticks.
WHAT YOU GET
- Thousands of syllable puzzles, regularly expanded
- Full offline play, no account needed
- Bonus word rewards and a coin economy
- Clues to break through hard levels
- Clean interface built for one-handed play
- No timers, no pressure, no streaks to lose
- Family friendly, ages 4+
Free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases are available for extra coins, and a Remove Ads upgrade if you want to play without interruptions.
Download Word Bubbles and see how many you can connect.

bluejetty:00175671:ios.description:
It's easy to save time and money while on the go, with the Costco Mobile App! We've improved our mobile app, to make it easier for members to access the incredible values found only at Costco.
DIGITAL MEMBERSHIP CARD: Access your membership card from the home page of the app. Use your membership card to enter the warehouse and at checkout.

SAVINGS: Conveniently receive the latest Warehouse Savings right on your own device.
GAS PRICES: Just tap the locator pin on the map to view current gas prices.

BUSINESS CENTER: Stock up on everything from Restaurant Supplies to Office Essentials, and keep your business running smoothly and efficiently.
SHOPPING LIST: Keep track of the items you want to pick up on your next trip to Costco.
WAREHOUSE INFO: See details about your nearest Costco warehouse, including regular and holiday hours, services provided, driving directions and gas prices.
FEEDBACK: Visit our app feedback page and help provide important feedback for Costco, because your opinion matters!

bluejetty:00033850:ios.description:
Animation Draw - Flipbook App is the ultimate mobile application for animators and artists of all skill levels. Whether you’re a beginner exploring your artistic side or a seasoned professional looking for a convenient way to create animations on the go, our app provides all the tools you need to bring your ideas to life effortlessly.
Features:
• Intuitive Drawing Interface: Easily sketch your ideas with a user-friendly interface designed for artists. Perfect for beginners and experienced users alike!
• Frame-by-Frame Animation: Create detailed animations by drawing frame by frame, just like a traditional flipbook.
• Customizable Brushes and Tools: Access a wide range of brushes and tools to enhance your drawings and animations.
• Onion Skinning: See previous and next frames as you draw to maintain smooth motion in your animations.
• Export and Share: Export your animations as GIFs or video files and share them with your friends, family, or social media followers.
• Undo and Redo: Easily correct mistakes with the undo and redo functions.
• Built-in Tutorials: Get started with step-by-step tutorials designed for beginners.
Ease of Use:
• Quick Start: Jump right into animating with no steep learning curve.
• Simple Controls: Our intuitive design ensures that anyone can start animating quickly, with easy-to-use controls.
• Guided Experience: Follow our built-in tutorials to learn the basics and master advanced techniques effortlessly.
Who is it for?
Animation Draw - Flipbook App is perfect for:
• Aspiring Animators: Learn the basics of animation and develop your skills.
• Professional Animators: Create and refine animations on the go.
• Artists and Illustrators: Add motion to your drawings and expand your creative toolkit.
• Educators and Students: Teach and learn animation techniques in an engaging and interactive way.
• Social Media Influencers and Content Creators: Create engaging animated content to grow your audience.
• Game Designers: Develop animated sequences and storyboards for your games.
• Marketing Professionals: Design animated advertisements and promotional materials.
Why Choose Animation Draw - Flipbook App?
• Easy to Use: Our intuitive design ensures that anyone can start animating quickly, without a steep learning curve.
• Portable: Create animations anytime, anywhere, directly from your mobile device.
Download Animation Draw - Flipbook App today and start animating your imagination with ease!
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION

• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or yearly at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• You can cancel your subscription via this URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00014523:ios.description:
OnePageCRM is a unique combination of a simple CRM app and a productivity tool with follow-up reminders next to every contact. It helps you keep in touch with clients, prospects, and partners, and nurture business relationships.
Built for consulting and professional services businesses, OnePageCRM adjusts to your needs and works as both—a personal CRM and a team collaboration tool.
Set reminders to follow up and stay in touch
— Add follow-up reminders next to any contact
— Create a reusable list of consecutive actions
— Dial contacts straight from within your CRM
Keep complete client information within CRM

— Call and meeting notes (with file attachments)
— Upcoming interactions, sales deals, and more
Call clients in just one click

— Use free email templates with attachments
Grow sales in a proactive way
— Manage your sales pipeline on the go
— Create and update deals in a few clicks
— Add notes and attachments to any deal
Keep the whole team aligned
— Assign contacts to other team members
— @mention your teammates and notify them about changes
— Integrate with other business apps

bluejetty:00129179:ios.summary: The Member Tools app provides members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints with the ability to contact ward and stake members, access event calendars, and locate Church meetinghouses and temples. Leaders can also access additi
bluejetty:00129179:ios.description:
The Member Tools app provides members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints with the ability to contact ward and stake members, access event calendars, and locate Church meetinghouses and temples. Leaders can also access additional membership information and reports.
Directory. View contact information and photos of members in your ward and stake, including members you’re assigned to minister to and those assigned to you, and update your contact information.
Messages. View messages with important updates or actions needed.
Organizations. View ward and stake callings by organization.
Reports. Ward and stake leaders can view and update membership reports for members of their ward and stake, including recording attendance and ministering interviews.
Manage records. Bishops, branch presidents, and clerks can move records and record ordinances.
Calendar. View event calendars for your ward and stake.
Groups. Create custom groups of members in your ward and stake.
Temples. View your assigned temple, temples nearest your current location, ordinance schedules, submit names to the prayer roll, and set up a temple recommend expiration reminder.
Meetinghouses. Find meetinghouse locations and addresses, sacrament meeting times, and contact information for bishops.
Missionary. Access contact information for the full-time missionaries assigned to and serving from your ward or stake, and refer a friend to the missionaries.
Finance. Organization presidencies can submit payment requests.
Update. Turn on automatic updates and manually update your data.
Settings. Select a light or dark theme for the app, set photo downloading preferences, and allow former mission leaders to view your contact information.

Dig Deep, collect resources, and build your dream city! In Train Digger – Idle Game, you control a mining train that digs deep underground to uncover valuable materials. Deliver them to the surface and use them to construct and expand a bustling city above.
Start small with a simple train and a quiet town. Upgrade your digging power, add more wagons, and unlock colorful, faster engines to mine deeper and faster. Every layer you dig brings new challenges and greater rewards.
Use your resources to build roads, houses, towers, and landmarks, turning your city into a vibrant metropolis. Balance between upgrading your underground mining and expanding your city for maximum progress.
Even when you’re offline, your trains keep working — earn resources and grow your city at your own pace!
Features:
Fun, easy-to-play digging & building gameplay
Upgradeable trains and mining power
Build and customize your city

bluejetty:00117977:android.description:
English Discord Invitation:
https://discord.gg/YUDFfn8
IMPORTANT NEWS:
- Instant mach (play a match just after the logo disappears)
- Different control schemes
- Difficulty selector (and AI improvement)
- Velocity movement selector
- Play only in defense or only in attack and let the AI help you
- Want to GET RID OF ADS? Tap the red icon in the main menu (labeled REMOVE ADS), watch a couple of ads, and they'll be deactivated until you close the game. NOTE: If you don't see it immediately upon entering, wait a second, go to the options menu, and then come back.
3D Foosball is a game for Android devices, which translates into the world of table soccer in the palm of your hand.
You have different game modes:
- One player against the CPU
- One player against another
- Two players against the CPU
- Two players against two others
- Tournament Mode (3 consecutive matches to win the trophy)
(And everything from the same mobile or tablet. How many games do you know to be able to play more than one person on the same device?)
It also has different control schemes:
- Standard: With the left thumb you move goalkeeper and midfield and with the right thumb you move defenses and forwards. This has been done so that you can defend and attack at the same time. Once accustomed, it is the best way to control the game.
- Alternative: With the left thumb you move goalkeeper and defenses and with the right thumb you move midfield and forwards. Many players asked for this method of control (although, personally, we see it as an error: because when you move together goalie and defenses, you can not cover the gaps when defending, and the same happens when attacking. But you asked for it and you already have it!).
- Individual: You control the four bars. Method that players have also requested.
- Defense only: Thumb left goalie, right thumb defenses. The CPU takes care of your midfield and your forwards. It is the best option if you want only to leave the goal to zero. To start is also good, because this way you control only one bar with each thumb. The intelligence of the CPU depends on the level of difficulty chosen.
- Attack only: Left thumb midfield, Right thumb forwards. The CPU takes care of your goalkeeper and your defenses. It is the best option if you want to dedicate only one goal to rivarl. To start is also good, because this way we control only one bar with each thumb. The intelligence of the CPU depends on the level of difficulty chosen.
You can choose from 5 velocity options to move the bars:
- Very slow
- Slow
- Standard
- Dynamic
- Fast
And you can choose the difficulty levels:
- Easy
- Normal
- Hard
With each level of difficulty, the challenge increases!
Download it now :)
And if the touch control for a game of this type does not go with you, connect a gamepad (USB or Bluetooth) and enjoy the game! When playing with gamepad, to pass or kick, use the triggers (L1 or R1).
The game is fully translated to English (the videos also).
3D Foosball lands on Spanish press:
https://www.diaridetarragona.com/costa/El-futbolin-de-un-vendrellense-al-que-se-juega-con-los-pulgares-20181008-0055.html

Rave Guardian is the best way to improve your personal safety by leveraging those you trust to be your own private safety network. Rave Guardian provides rapid and proactive communication with your organization. Guardian is completely configured by the organization(s) you are associated with to make connecting in times of crisis or just plain confusion simple and easy. 
Easy 2 field sign-up process for most people.

• Send in anonymous tips

• Share location information with safety official during an emergency call
• Quick access to safety or important phone numbers
• Robust resources selected by your organization for convenience
• If you allow Guardian, you can receive important notification based on your location. 
If you allow Rave Guardian, you can received push notifications related to on-going events in your area.
If you wish to customize Rave Guardian for your campus or workplace, contact us at demos@ravemobilesafety.com
Notes:

 • Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00143546:ios.description:
Эрудит – это знакомая всем с детства увлекательная интеллектуальная игра, которая идеально подходит как для семейного досуга, так и для новых знакомств. 
Играйте с друзьями или со случайными игроками по сети, составляйте слова из предложенного набора букв и обменивайтесь знаниями в чате! Такое времяпрепровождение несомненно является не только приятным, но и полезным, ведь Эрудит развивает внимание и сообразительность, а также значительно расширяет словарный запас: любое слово можно тут же проверить, одним нажатием отыскав его значение во встроенном толковом словаре. 
Результат в Эрудите напрямую зависит от ваших умственных способностей, любви к русскому языку и, несомненно, эрудиции! 
Блесните знаниями и загоните соперников в угол – никогда прежде игра в слова не была такой захватывающей и азартной! 
Эрудит – это головоломка, совмещающая в себе анаграмму (игра, в которой первые буквы одного слова являются началом другого) и кроссворд, поэтому игра Эрудит пользуется большой популярностью среди других настольных игр. Особый интерес у игроков вызывает Эрудит онлайн, так как играть с незнакомым противником всегда увлекательно и азартно.
Особенности игры:
• Игра с друзьями из ВКонтакте, Одноклассники, Facebook, Game Center
• Богатый, регулярно обновляющийся словарь
• Быстрый Online-чат с игроками
• Приятный, стильный дизайн
• Красочные темы

bluejetty:00090783:ios.description:
Discover Hidden Structures with Stud Finder Wall Wood Detector.
Ever been frustrated by the guesswork of hanging a picture or mounting a shelf? Do you wish you had a reliable companion to locate studs, nails, and metal objects hidden behind your walls? Whether you're a DIY enthusiast, a professional contractor, or a cautious homeowner, Stud Finder Metal Detector is your go-to solution for precise, effortless stud detection.
Powered by your iPhone's magnetic sensor and a user-friendly interface, Wall Wood Stud Finder transforms your iOS device into a powerful wall wood studfinder tool. Slide your phone slowly along the wall to find the screws and nails that hold the drywall to the studs, so you know where to drill.
Key Features
Easy Value Reading with an Intuitive Indicator
Our clear, on-screen indicator displays real-time readings, allowing you to effortlessly interpret measurements. With a glance, see when you are over a screw, nail, or other metal object.
(Premium subscription required.)
Magnetic Field Reading on X, Y, Z Axes
See the magnetic field and its X, Y, and Z components in real time to find the spot where the change is strongest.
(Premium subscription required.)
Vibration and Audible Notifications
Stay alerted with customizable vibration and sound notifications. Whether you're in a noisy environment or focusing intently on your project, our notifications ensure you're always in sync with the app's findings.
(Premium subscription required.)
Adjustable Sensitivity Settings
Tackle any project with confidence by fine-tuning the sensitivity of your scans. Whether dealing with thick walls or delicate surfaces, our customizable settings let you optimize detection for every scenario.
(Premium subscription required.)
Apple Watch Support
Scan walls directly from your wrist. Get real-time haptic feedback and results without reaching for your phone—perfect when you're in tight spaces.
(Premium subscription required.)
Why Choose Stud Finder Metal Detector?
Finds the Metal in Your Studs
The app detects the screws and nails that hold your drywall to the studs through their magnetic field, showing you where the studs are before you make any holes in your walls.
User-Friendly Interface
Designed for both beginners and professionals, the app's sleek interface and intuitive controls make stud detection simple and effective. Real-time feedback and clear visual indicators guide you through every scan.
Enhanced Project Safety
With real-time readings and customizable alerts, you can confidently secure your wall-mounted items by targeting the strongest points behind your walls. Protect your investments and prevent unnecessary damage.
Premium Subscription Required
To access all scanning features—including the intuitive indicator, X/Y/Z magnetic field readings, vibration and audible notifications, and adjustable sensitivity settings—a premium subscription is required. Choose from flexible subscription plans that best suit your project needs, whether you're a weekend DIYer or a professional contractor.
Get Started Today!
Don't let uncertainty slow you down. With Stud Finder Metal Detector, you have the power to uncover hidden studs, nails, and metal objects with clear readings and reliable alerts. Transform your iOS device into an indispensable tool for safe, efficient, and professional installations.
Download Stud Finder Metal Detector now and experience the future of wall scanning technology—backed by premium plans that unlock all of our advanced detection features.
Privacy Policy: https://thestudfinder.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://thestudfinder.app/terms/
Contact Support: support@thestudfinder.app
Take control of your home improvement projects—get Stud Finder Wall Wood Detector today and build with confidence!
