bluejetty:00128120:ios.description:
Wormix — Turn-based tactical battles: intense PvP duels and epic boss fights!
Wormix is optimized for iPhone 6s and above, iPod touch 7th gen and above, iPad Air 2 / iPad mini 4 and above. 
— — — — — — —
Wormix is a turn-based tactical game that combines arcade action, strategy, and shooter elements. Battle against bots or challenge your friends in exciting PvP duels — the choice is yours!
With colorful cartoon-style graphics and fun voice acting, Wormix keeps the action entertaining. The progression system and competitive gameplay will keep you coming back for more. Call your friends - and into battle! You will make a great team!
TACTICS WITHOUT STRATEGY IS JUST CHAOS
In Wormix, luck alone won't bring you victory. Sharpen your reflexes, aim with precision, and plan several moves ahead. Strategy and execution go hand in hand!
MULTIPLE GAME MODES
- Master the basics in quick solo missions
- Sharpen your skills in 1v1 or 2v2 PvP battles
- Challenge your friends to exciting duels
- Take on cunning bosses in tough encounters
- Team up with friends or random allies to defeat powerful superbosses
- Climb the daily leaderboards and earn valuable rewards
- Compete in tournaments for fame, recognition, and exclusive loot
- Grow your clan and join the seasonal clan wars
A LOT OF STUNNING RACES
Choose from fierce boxers, demonic brutes, agile hares, cunning cats, cold-blooded zombies, fiery dragons, and high-tech robots — each with unique traits that impact every battle.
THERMONUCLEAR ARSENAL
Arm yourself with dozens of powerful weapons: shotguns, mines, grenades, AK-47s, flamethrowers, Molotov cocktails, teleporters, flying saucers, jetpacks, and much more!
POWERFUL UPGRADES
Level up your weapons to boost their stats and unlock new abilities. Collect them all and gain the upper hand in battle!
EQUIP YOUR FIGHTERS
Unlock new hats and artifacts to boost your squad’s stats and customize their look. Win battles in style! 
MAPS WITHOUT BORDERS
Explore the vast universe of Wormix — from floating islands and futuristic cities to haunted ruins and distant planets. No matter where you go, thrilling battles await on every map!
LIKE IT?
If you enjoy the game, leave a rating or review — your feedback helps us make Wormix even better!
— — — — — — —
VIP ACCOUNT SUBSCRIPTION:
- a VIP account grants the user access to all weapons
- You will gain access to all weapons after the purchase of a VIP account subscription.
- All weapon available after subscription cannot be upgraded in the craft room. To upgrade an available weapon please buy it in the game store.
- VIP accounts pricing:
 - $4.99/week

About auto-renewal of a VIP account subscription:
- The subscription is set to auto-renew. The subscription payment will be charged to your iTunes account only after your confirmation.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
- The auto-renew function can be turned off in the settings of your iTunes

With Weathershot you can edit photo and share the weather report from the place where your are now – on top of your favourite photo that you have just snapped with your iPhone camera. Then you can use photo editor to crop, filter and apply weather text.
Edit inspirational & informational photos to share quickly and easily. In seconds you can check weather edit weather overlay and talk weather.

Make your friends jealous, place a perfect weather report on top of your edited photo!
Use weather editor with over 90 different skins.

Photo editor with filters & weather overlay editor with custom skins for every weather situation.
Weather works in Celsius & Fahrenheit, kilometers, miles.
Install and share the weather with friends! Let the good weather be always good for you!

Welcome to *Awesome Park: Idle Game*, the ultimate hyper-casual arcade idle game that combines fun and endless excitement! Build, manage, and expand your perfect amusement empire right at your fingertips. Here’s what makes this game a must-play:

bluejetty:00178061:ios.name: CarryMap
bluejetty:00178061:ios.summary:
CarryMap app offers a comprehensive set of tools for collecting, processing and analyzing spatial geodata. It provides seamless field work without authorization, payments and in-app purchases.
It is designed to work with maps in a specific
bluejetty:00178061:ios.description:
CarryMap app offers a comprehensive set of tools for collecting, processing and analyzing spatial geodata. It provides seamless field work without authorization, payments and in-app purchases.
It is designed to work with maps in a specific mobile format CMF2. To export your ArcGIS maps to this format, use CarryMap Builder, an extension to ArcGIS Desktop. 
Maps management
- Download maps of only needed areas and store them in a convenient catalog. The maps provided in the catalog were created based on OpenStreetMap data.
- Upload your own maps prepared in ArcGIS and work with them offline.
- Use reliable methods for your maps protection.
- Create fully functional projects for work with all the needed information.
- Save selected map areas as bookmarks.
Working with objects
- Create and edit point, line, and polygon features on the map.
- Add media attachments (photo, video and documents) to features.
- Record voice comments when creating and describing features on the map.
- Create points on-the-fly using your device camera.
- Create points on the map with a single tap while moving, add description later if needed.
- Add graphic marks as text, arrows or free hand graphic.
GPS tracks and navigation
- Use external Bad Elf GPS receiver to find your current location.
- Save tracks automatically without being distracted by editing them as you go.
- Use features on the map as landmarks or destination points on your route.
- Search and identify features offline.
- Measure distances and areas.
Data export
- Share coordinates of features on the map by sending a file or a link.
- Upload maps in MBTILES* formats.
- Share collected data in GPKG (GeoPackage), GPX, KML/KMZ and SHP formats.
*Maps in MBTILES format with raster tile type only are supported.
The application is accessible to a wide range of users, regardless of GIS skills, and can be used in various fields, including electrical energy industry, agriculture, geology and geodesy, housing and utility, environmental protection, water and land resources management, ecology and incident management, urban management, etc.
Take the opportunity to create your own branded application for viewing and working with mobile maps based on CarryMap for your company. Read more: https://carrymap.com/en/features/branding/
Read more about all the capabilities of CarryMap Builder extension at https://builder.carrymap.com/en/
To learn more about CarryMap application, visit https://carrymap.com/en/overview/
Watch educational videos on our YouTube page: 
https://www.youtube.com/c/CarryMap/videos
Your questions or comments are welcome at support@xtools.pro

bluejetty:00164258:ios.description:
Travel Smarter and Save More with AirAsia MOVE
AirAsia MOVE - ASEAN’s favorite travel app, making it easy to book cheap flights, hotels, airport transfers, activities and exclusive deals across Asia and worldwide.
Looking for the best travel deals? AirAsia MOVE is your all-in-one travel companion for flights, stays, rides and more. 
Whether it is a weekend break, a business trip or a last-minute holiday, AirAsia MOVE makes travel easy, affordable and secure. With access to over 700 airlines and more than 900,000 hotels across 130 destinations, your next adventure is just a few taps away.
BOOK CHEAP FLIGHTS IN SECONDS
Fly for less without the fuss. Compare and book flights from over 700 airlines worldwide, including AirAsia and other leading carriers.
- Official AirAsia Flight Booking Platform: Book directly on AirAsia MOVE to access exclusive flight deals, promotions, and discounts. Enjoy guaranteed low fares and a secure, seamless booking experience every time.
- Compare Flights and Prices: Find the best flights for your budget. Choose from low-cost or full-service airlines to suit your travel plans.
- Find the Best Flight Deals: Discover cheap flights with daily promotions, exclusive deals and last-minute offers.
- Book Flights Worldwide: Search and book international and domestic flights across Asia, Australia and beyond.
- Manage Your Flights: Mobile check-in, E-Boarding Passes and real-time flight updates on AirAsia flights. 
- Customise Your Journey: Select seats, add baggage and pre-book meals with ease.
FIND YOUR PERFECT HOTEL STAY
From luxury resorts to budget-friendly rooms, explore and book over 900,000 hotels worldwide.
- Choice for Every Traveller: Hotels, apartments, hostels, villas and more for all budgets and styles.
- All Hotel Classes Available: From 5-star luxury to 1-star stays, find the perfect option for your trip.
- Exclusive Deals: Unlock app-only rates and member-exclusive hotel discounts.
- Smart Search Filters: Sort by price, location, ratings and amenities to find the ideal stay.
- Worry-Free Booking: View cancellation policies, hotel details and high-quality photos before booking.
- Flexible Payments: Pay now, pay at the hotel, or enjoy free cancellation options for peace of mind.
SAVE MORE WITH SNAP (FLIGHT+HOTEL)
Why book separately when you can bundle? SNAP combines flights and hotels in one package.
- Maximise Savings: Save up to 30% with exclusive Flight+Hotel rates.
- Convenience: Manage your full itinerary in one place.
RELIABLE AIRPORT RIDES
Skip taxi queues with pre-booked e-hailing rides for airport transfers.
- Pre-Book Transfers: Schedule your ride in advance to avoid stress.
- Instant Booking: Secure a ride without waiting in line.
- Transparent and Safe: See fares upfront and track your driver in real time.
DISCOVER ACTIVITIES AND EVENTS
Make every trip memorable with curated experiences and local activities.
- Book Entertainment: Tickets for concerts, shows, tours and attractions.
- Unique Experiences: Art exhibitions, sports, fitness classes and local adventures.
SHOP DUTY-FREE AND TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
Save and stay connected before and during your trip.
- Duty-Free Shopping: Up to 70% off perfumes, cosmetics, gadgets and more. Pre-order for delivery to your seat or shop on board!
- e-SIM Connectivity: Roaming data without the hassle of a physical SIM.
- Travel Insurance: Protect your trip with insurance available in the app.
WHY CHOOSE AIRASIA MOVE
- All-in-One Platform: Flights, hotels, rides and activities in a single app.
- AirAsia Rewards: Earn points on every booking and redeem for cheaper trips.
- Seamless Payments: Link your BigPay account to use MOVEPay for secure, one-tap purchases.
- 24/7 Support: Chat with AskBo, our virtual assistant, or join travel communities for tips.
Download AirAsia MOVE today and travel smarter, see more, do more and connect with the world.
Note: Some features and promotions may only be available in selected countries.

bluejetty:00152251:android.description:
This casual game centered around "tightening screws" has become the perfect companion for fragmented time, thanks to its simple and easy-to-learn controls, creative level designs, and extremely stress-relieving experience. People of all ages can quickly immerse themselves in it and unlock the unique joy of casual level-clearing.
The game’s core gameplay may seem straightforward, but it’s full of clever details. Players only need to tap with one finger to complete operations—yet don’t underestimate this simple action. In different levels, the types of screws, the distribution of holes, and the structure of components vary; you need to accurately match colors to sort the colorful screws into corresponding storage boxes. Every "click" sound of a screw fitting into a hole is accompanied by crisp sound effects and smooth animations. The meticulous polishing of visuals and sound effects fully enhances the sense of immersion.
Whether you’re looking for a purely stress-relieving game to release pressure, or want to train your focus and responsiveness, this screw-tightening game can perfectly meet your needs. It transforms the seemingly boring mechanical operations in daily life into a fun and challenging gaming experience. As you tap your fingers, you can not only feel the charm of mechanical aesthetics but also enjoy the joy of overcoming difficulties. Now, become a "screw-tightening expert," unlock more levels, and let the rhythm of tightening screws heal all your tiredness and anxiety !

bluejetty:00180024:ios.summary:
Disclaimer: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government entity, including the UK Home Office.
Attribution: Study materials in this application are based on the official handbook “Lif
bluejetty:00180024:ios.description:
Disclaimer: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government entity, including the UK Home Office.
Attribution: Study materials in this application are based on the official handbook “Life in the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents” (3rd edition), © Crown copyright. Formatting and presentation have been adapted for mobile use.
Official information about the Life in the UK Test is available from the UK Government at:
https://www.gov.uk/life-in-the-uk-test
The Life in the UK Citizenship Test is a computer-based exam constituting one of the requirements for anyone seeking naturalisation as a British citizen. It is meant to prove that the applicant has a sufficient knowledge of British life and sufficient proficiency in the English language. The test consists of 24 questions covering topics such as British values, history, traditions and everyday life.
You’ll be tested on information in the official handbook for the Life in the UK Test included in this app - this is the only book recommended to prepare for the test. You’ll have 45 minutes to answer 24 questions.
This app also contains 1,200+ practice questions you will be asked in the citizenship test.
- Take a practice test and see if you can score well enough to pass the actual test
- Based on real test questions
- Learn as you practice with our full explanations feature
- You can track how many questions you have done correctly, incorrectly, and get a final passing or failing score based on official passing grades
- Progress metrics feature to keep track of your results and score trends
- Helpful hints and tips let you know how you can improve your score 
- Option to review all your mistakes so you don't repeat them in the real test
- Track Past Test Results - Individual tests will be listed with pass or fail and your mark
- Send questions feedback directly from the app
- Get immediate feedback for correct or incorrect answers
- Dark mode allows you to study in the dark
Note: Remember that you must book your Life in the UK Test online at least 3 days in advance. There is a fee to register. There are around 60 test centres in the UK - choose one of the 5 closest to where you live. If the centre isn’t close to where you live, you won’t be allowed to sit the test and you won’t get a refund. Remember to bring proof of your address to the test. If you have covered all the material in this app - It should be a breeze!
-----------------------------------
If you choose to purchase the Full Access subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Current Full Access subscription price starts at £1.29 GBP/week. Prices are in Pound Sterling, may vary in countries other than the U.K. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase the subscription, you can simply continue accessing the sample content.
Terms of Use: http://www.spurry.org/tos/index.html

bluejetty:00016035:ios.description:
Beasts of Balance is an award-winning game of dexterity, strategy and creation. Stack magical Artefacts in precarious towers to create digital worlds bursting with life on your phone, tablet or TV!
 Play together in Co-op Mode or get ready to tussle in Battles Mode.
 It takes skill and smarts to build a huge tower and keep your beasts alive, but watch out… the world explodes when the tower collapses!
 This is no standard dexterity game – every time you add an Artefact to the tower, watch your world burst to life with magical creatures and effects!
 With Battles Mode, 2 to 3 players can embrace weird and wonderful new powers, battling to become the mightiest god! It’s still Beasts of Balance, but just a bit... fightier.
 There’s real skill in deciding on the next piece to add to the stack, and it takes smarts and teamwork to build high-scoring towers and discover the most elusive Beasts. 
 Make screen time… family time!
 Parents' Choice Gold Award – WINNER
 Toy of the Year 2018: Game of the Year – FINALIST
 Key Features
 • App-enabled gameplay brings your physical creation to life on your connected device
 • 24 beautiful Artefacts designed to stack in surprising ways
 • Two unique game modes: Co-op Mode (1-5 players) and Battles Mode (2-3 players)
 • Stack your beasts on the sensing Plinth and see them appear in your digital world
 • Discover and collect more than 100 fantastic hybrids and fabulous beasts as you play
"Infusing molded plastic with storylines and magic, this game shows what’s possible when you pair toys and tech" – TIME
"Your entire family will love it" – MOM DOES REVIEWS
"The wildly inventive, gloriously addictive game which essentially reimagines Jenga for the iPhone generation" – THE INDEPENDENT
"The hilarious panic as you desperately re-assemble your fallen tower before a volcano erupts is worth the price alone" – THE TELEGRAPH
“Beasts of Balance is fantastic. I think it’s one of the greatest kids games ever made.” – TOM VASEL, THE DICE TOWER

bluejetty:00130138:ios.description:
Landmarks brings the world’s most iconic places to life.
Powered by Apple Maps, the app lets you explore over 600 interactive landmarks across 40+ major cities worldwide through immersive and beautifully detailed interactive cityscapes.
Browse curated city tours or dive into categories like tourist attractions, museums, theaters, churches, and stadiums. Fly over iconic places like the Louvre, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Empire State Building, Buckingham Palace, and the Basilica of the Sagrada Família. Save your favorites, revisit top destinations, and earn achievements as you go.
Learn about landmarks as you explore, switch between daylight and moonlight themes, view useful location details, and use your device’s built-in gyroscope for an even more immersive perspective.
With the new Quizzes feature, Landmarks becomes even more engaging. Test your knowledge, discover new places, and learn more about famous sights around the world in a playful new way.
Landmarks is available on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS. Featured landmarks may appear differently depending on device.
The app’s collection is updated regularly as new Apple Maps Detailed City Experience models become available.
Some content and features require an active World Pass plan.

bluejetty:00115177:ios.description:
Join thousands on the path to freedom. TBreak is the #1 app for quitting cannabis, designed to help you regain control, build healthier habits, and live with clarity and purpose. Whether you’re cutting down or quitting for good, TBreak equips you with science-backed tools to reshape your relationship with weed and dopamine.
With a structured recovery program, real-time progress tracking, guided meditations, and a supportive community, TBreak gives you everything you need to reset your habits and rediscover your potential.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE TBREAK
REWIRE YOUR BRAIN
Grounded in addiction science, TBreak helps you retrain your mind and overcome cravings. Step by step, you’ll build resilience and reclaim control over your life.
MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT
Daily check-ins, mindfulness exercises, and evidence-based strategies keep you motivated and focused—one day at a time.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Stay inspired with a sobriety timer, milestone celebrations, and detailed stats that show your improvements in focus, energy, and overall well-being.
A COMMUNITY THAT UNDERSTANDS
Connect with others on the same journey. Share your wins, find accountability, and draw strength from a network that knows what it’s like to quit cannabis.
CELEBRATE MILESTONES
Every day sober is a victory. From your first 24 hours to long-term success, TBreak marks your progress and keeps you moving forward.
TRANSFORM YOUR FUTURE
Quitting cannabis brings powerful benefits for your mental clarity, motivation, and relationships. Start today and experience the difference.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
A TBreak subscription unlocks full access to features and content. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew anytime in Account Settings.
If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the remaining trial period will be forfeited upon purchase.
DISCLAIMER: Seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app for medical decisions.

Privacy Policy – https://www.tbreakapp.xyz/privacy

가장 빠른 로또 QR 당첨확인 — 전국 명당부터 내 근처 판매점까지! 여러 장의 로또·연금복권을 터치 없이 연속 스캔! 분당 수십 장을 확인하는 압도적 속도의 무료 로또 앱 '로또대박'을 만나보세요.
■ 여러 장을 빠르게 QR 당첨확인 카메라를 갖다 대기만 하면 끝! 동행복권 로또 6/45와 연금복권 720+를 터치 없이 연속 스캔하여 당첨 결과와 금액을 즉시 확인합니다. 분당 수십 장의 당첨번호 조회가 가능한 가장 빠른 무료 로또 앱입니다.
■ 전국 명당부터 내 근처 판매점까지 전국 로또 1, 2등 배출 명당과 내 위치에서 가장 가까운 복권 판매점을 지도에서 한눈에! 바로 찾아가서 행운을 잡으세요.
■ 로또+연금복권 당첨 이력 관리 내가 구매한 모든 로또·연금복권 내역을 한곳에서 관리하세요. 과거 당첨 이력부터 미추첨 복권까지 놓치는 번호 없이 깔끔하게 정리됩니다.
■ 자주 쓰는 내 번호 관리 직접 고른 로또 번호를 최대 5개까지 저장해 두세요. 매주 같은 번호를 다시 적지 않아도, 저장해 둔 번호로 간편하게 등록할 수 있습니다.
■ 당첨 번호 분석과 세금 계산 홀짝, AC, 출현 순위 등 42종 통계로 지난 당첨 번호의 흐름을 살펴보고, 당첨금의 세금과 실수령액도 바로 계산해 보세요.
■ 모바일 슬립지로 오프라인 판매점에서 간편하게! 종이 슬립지 없이도 OK! 앱에서 로또 번호를 선택하고 모바일 슬립지(QR코드)를 오프라인 판매점에서 보여주면 바로 구매할 수 있습니다.
※ 이렇게 사용하세요
1. 앱 실행 → 카메라를 복권 QR코드에 맞추면 당첨 결과 즉시 확인!
2. 명당·판매점 메뉴에서 가까운 명당과 판매점을 찾아보세요.
3. 자주 쓰는 번호는 내 번호에 저장하고, 모바일 슬립지로 판매점에서 바로 구매!
지금 바로 무료 다운로드! '로또대박'과 함께 행운의 주인공이 되어보세요.
• QR 당첨 확인은 보조 수단이므로, 반드시 실물 복권과 대조하시기 바랍니다.

bluejetty:00098403:ios.description:
We’re ready to steal your heart with P5X, the latest anime RPG adventure game of the popular Persona series. Take back your stolen self as you live your double life as a student and Phantom Thief. This epic anime role playing game allows you to collect characters, battle enemies, and make the most of being a high schooler in Tokyo by hitting the bustling streets of Shibuya, Shinjuku and Kichijoji. Once the bell rings, don the mask of a Phantom Thief and infiltrate the hidden realm of the Metaverse and engage in RPG battles with the dark beings that lie within. 
Live your best high school life during the day! Deepen your friendships, devote your time to clubs, or even work part-time in this open world RPG adventure. Make visible impacts on the world around you by meeting new faces and diving into everyday experiences that will help you grow and collect characters along the way. 
During the night, infiltrate the vast metaverse and battle Menaces as the Phantom Thief in this turn based RPG. Take back the desires that have been stolen and exploited. The bonds you have made along the way will aid you in each metaverse adventure.
Join Wonder and the Phantom Thieves in this exciting anime rpg adventure today!
P5X APP FEATURES:
EPIC ANIME RPG SET IN THE PERSONA UNIVERSE 
･Explore this stylized anime adventure game featuring a unique art style and energetic soundtrack.
･Engage in fast paced turn based RPG battles & infiltrate massive palaces within Mementos to steal treasures and stop their Rulers.
･Visit the velvet room, a space between dream and reality and explore the world of Mementos.
･Unlock, collect, & upgrade characters, skills, weapons, Personas, and more! 
FORGE FRIENDSHIPS IN THIS ROLE PLAYING ADVENTURE
･Freely interact with people around the city to build relationships.
･Strengthen these bonds and collect characters to unlock powerful abilities in battle.
･As you watch movies together, share meals, and lend an ear to their troubles, those strangers might just become a best friend or even a soulmate...
･Your social interactions will be the key to moving the story forward.
EXPERIENCE HIGH SCHOOL STUDENT LIFE IN THE BIG CITY
･How you spend your high school day is completely up to you in this open world role play game. 
･Join after-school clubs, make a quick buck at a range of part-time jobs, hang with friends, go out on dates, or dive into a new rpg adventure!
･Your decisions will transform your journey and define your story.
ENTER THE METAVERSE & EMBRACE THE PHANTOM THIEF
･After school, step into a twisted anime world where enemies, known as Shadows, lurk and drain all hope from the world.
･Awaken the inner power of your Personas to infiltrate palaces, steal treasures, and stop their Rulers.
･Skillfully use Personas to take down foes in stylish turn-based battles and rewrite history.
Download today and reclaim your desires with Wonder in P5X| Persona5: The Phantom X!

bluejetty:00169273:ios.summary:

Step into immersive story chapters filled with passion, secrets, betrayal, mystery, and unforgettabl
bluejetty:00169273:ios.description:
Midnight Stories is an addictive interactive romance game where you choose your story — and your choices control love, drama, and destiny.
Step into immersive story chapters filled with passion, secrets, betrayal, mystery, and unforgettable characters. Every decision changes relationships, unlocks new episodes, and leads to multiple endings.
Will you choose loyalty or temptation?
Trust or revenge?
Safe love… or dangerous desire?
--- WHY YOU'LL LOVE MIDNIGHT STORIES ---
- Choose your story from dozens of interactive romance chapters
- Multiple endings — every choice truly matters
- Customize your character's look and personality
- Build relationships, flirt, fall in love… or break hearts
- Explore diverse genres: dark romance, forbidden love, supernatural mystery, historical drama, sports rivalry, thriller, horror, and fantasy
- Cinematic storytelling with immersive chat-style moments
- Replay chapters to unlock hidden scenes and secret story paths
- New episodes added regularly
--- YOUR STORY, YOUR GENRE ---
Choose your path in stories that span every romantic universe: forbidden love, second chance romance, supernatural drama, royal intrigue, taboo relationships, detective thrillers, and dark fantasy. Every interactive story chapter delivers emotional depth and high-stakes choices.
Taboo love. Secret identities. Deadly rivalries. Heartbreaking betrayals.
Each character has secrets. Every relationship has consequences. And every chapter can change everything.
--- FREE TO PLAY ---
Midnight Stories is free to download and play.
Some story choices and features require in-game currency. In-game currency can be earned through gameplay, daily rewards, and watching ads, or obtained via optional in-app purchases.
Optional subscriptions provide access to exclusive customization items and additional premium features.
--- PRIVACY ---
Privacy Policy: https://ilark.games/privacy-policy-2/
Terms of Service: https://ilark.games/terms-of-use/
Questions or suggestions? Contact us: support@ilark.games

bluejetty:00119793:ios.description:
28Hse (28House) App - No.1 Hong Kong Property Platform in Hong Kong (From comScore Data).
1. Rental Property, For Sell Property: Lots of properties in all districts of Hong Kong. It including residential, offices, shops, land and car park. All are updated by agencies or landlord with latest price and information. People also can choose share rental and short-term rental that suitable for people who looking for short-term accommodation. 
2. List your own property: No matter you are landlord or agency, you are welcome to use our App or 28Hse.com website to list your own property for rental and sell. By the No.1 Property Platform, you can easily to get in touch with the potential Buyer or Tenant easily. No Commissions are required.
3. New Property: Our people will collect all kind of new properties under selling from the developers. Latest price lists and pictures will be shown. Make sure you can select your dream house in Hong Kong.
4. Transaction Data: No idea of the current market price in Hong Kong? We have latest transaction data sourced from the market and Land Dept Hong Kong daily. Studies it before you make decision to make a deal with agency or landlord.
5. Service Apartment: Looking for short term rental with home feeling? Managed serviced apartment is your choice. All are listed from known suppliers. Enjoy your stay in Hong Kong.
6. Subscription: Subscribe the favorite condition. When there is some properties that you might be interested, 28Hse will send message by push notification.
7. Save your listings: Many properties are your cup of tea? Bookmark it inside the app and you can review it anytime you want.
8. Properties finding via maps: Find your favorite properties without leaving your home 
9. Mortgage calculator: How much you need to repay to the bank for your mortgage based on the property price? Monthly repayment can be calculated easily inside the App.
10. Widget: Add widgets on your phone. Find homes and mange listing in the desktop quickly. Users also can see the transaction data of bookmarked and favorite estate here
11. Property News: With daily market news in Chinese and English. Get the latest market trend easily.
12. Second Hand Furniture: You can easily to find a cheap second hand furniture in here. Most of the seller in here are very friendly. Try your luck.
13. Agreement: Free to use. Convenient to all landlords, tenants and brokers. Paperless can use APP or website to do the digital sign. 
14. Manage the listings: App provides the function of managing the listings. Member can change the photos and information when you need. 
28Hse has serviced in Hong Kong for more than 10 years. Our aim is to provide latest and updated information in the Hong Kong Property Market. We hope you can enjoy it and thanks for your support :)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28Hse (28House) 香港屋網 App - No. 1 香港地產資訊平台. ( 根據 comScore 數據 )
1. 二手售盤、租盤：各區盤源充足，最新業主及地產代理售盤與租盤，包括住宅、工商、店舖、土地及車位等，內容全面，放盤人可自行管理樓盤，確保資料最新最準。租屋另有分租及短租選擇，方便尋找短期住宿的人士。
2. 業主、代理放盤：放盤人可選用 28Hse.com 主網站或 28Hse App 放盤或管理樓盤。樓盤資料在網站及App同步更新。我們不會收取任何佣金。房屋交易更輕鬆。
3. 新盤：最新的一手新盤地產資訊，專人拍照及更新最新價單及折扣優惠。
4. 成交數據：提供市場最新3個月成交及土地註冊處成交，圖表分析，讓你更了解香港的樓市走勢，部份屋苑同時包含租價的成交。
5. 服務式住宅：適合國外用家及本地尋找短期租盤單位的租客，租客可帶包即住，避免自行租屋的麻煩，也不用簽署任何租約。
6. 樓盤訂閱：訂閱心水條件，當28Hse找到有合適的樓盤後，會推送通知搵樓人士。
7. 收藏樓盤：把你喜愛的售盤、租盤儲存於應用程式內，可隨時再查看及比較。
8. 地圖搵樓：即使足不出戶，都可以隨時隨地搜尋心水樓盤。
9. 按揭計算：簡單易用按揭計計算機，即時計算每月供款及負擔能力測試。
10. 小工具：可在電話加入小工具，在桌面都可以快速搵樓及管理樓盤，並且可見到已追蹤及收藏的屋苑成交資料，即時掌握最新資訊。
11. 地產新聞：每日準時更新的在專業地產新聞，地產市況走勢一目了然。
12. 二手傢俬：方便業主搬屋時，放售沒有用的二手傢俬，環保又可以幫助有需要的人士，租屋人士也可試下尋寶。
13. 電子租約：免費使用，簡單易用，方便各業主、租客及代理使用，完全無紙化，可於電腦或APP上即時簽約。
14. 樓盤管理：App同時提供樓盤管理功能，放盤照片及資料管理更加容易。
28Hse 服務香港市民已超過10年，幫助過不少人尋找安樂窩，我們一直希望利用互聯網把最新地產資訊傳遞給大家，不論你在任何地區，大陸、台灣、歐美都可下載我們的 APP。如我們的服務有不完善的地方請多多包涵，非常感謝大家一直的關注與支持 :)

KINETICOACH – CUSTOM WORKOUT BUILDER
Get LEAN & FIT in a HOTEL, HOME, or GYM with the easy-to-use KINETICOACH Custom Workout Builder. Select your equipment, time available, & how you’re feeling—KINETICOACH instantly delivers professional workouts personalized to your goals & experience. Track results & join teams to stay motivated. Download FREE today! Custom Workouts. Zero Excuses.
WHY KINETICOACH IS THE BEST FITNESS APP
•FREE – Get started with custom workouts at no cost
•Auto-programming timer (no messing with the clock – get straight to the workout) 
•You WON’T get bored: 1000+ workouts & 300+ movements in a wide variety of workouts
•Go beyond bodyweight workouts – USE WEIGHTS if you have them
•Professional movement demos
•Alternate movements for injuries
•NO OTHER APP PROVIDES KINETICOACH’S WORKOUT VARIETY & CUSTOMIZATION!
•Versatile timer with stopwatch, countdown & programmable interval functions
•Create & join teams for motivation
TRULY CUSTOM WORKOUTS DESIGNED BY PROFESSIONALS
•Full-body functional movements that improve overall fitness
•Fun, challenging workouts
•3 experience levels to stay safe & motivated 
•Thorough warm-up guidance
WE DON’T AVOID WEIGHTS & NEITHER SHOULD YOU!
•Life demands you lift & carry things – KINETICOACH teaches you safe lifting mechanics that get you fit & apply to everyday life
WHO WE ARE
•KINETICOACH was created by professional fitness trainers with 30+ years of experience coaching & traveling for business
•We know the challenges of staying fit on the road & designed incredibly effective workouts tailored to YOU & YOUR NEEDS
•The athletes in our demo videos are the creators of KINETICOACH, not hired models – we use KINETICOACH’s workouts to get & stay fit
WHY OUR USERS LOVE KINETICOACH
•5-Stars – KINETICOACH. You guys have nailed it! No equipment? No problem. Not sure how to do the moves? There are high-quality demos built in. No excuses! The KINETICOACH app has it all." -Kristie
•5-Stars – "KINETICOACH gives you access to years of expert coaching experience, right at your fingertips. You never again have to stress about what workout to do." - David

bluejetty:00044056:ios.description:
Pocket Coach Snowboarding App, your ultimate companion on the mountain. Whether
you're a beginner or an advanced rider, this app is designed to accelerate your progress
and take your snowboarding skills to new heights within months.
With a user-friendly interface and a wealth of interactive features, PocketCoach is built to
cater to every type of rider. It provides tailored coaching and training programs,
personalized to your skill level and goals. From mastering the basics to perfecting advanced
techniques, this app will guide you every step of the way.
Track your progress with detailed analytics and performance metrics. Receive real-time
feedback and tips from professional snowboarders and coaches. Explore video tutorials
that break down each trick and maneuver, ensuring you understand the mechanics behind
them.
Whether you prefer cruising groomers, hitting the park, or conquering powder,
PocketCoach has you covered. It offers comprehensive training plans specific to your
preferred riding style, allowing you to develop your skills in the areas that matter most to
you.
Unlock new levels, earn achievements, and challenge yourself with fun and engaging mini-
games designed to enhance your balance, agility, and board control. Connect with a
community of fellow riders, share your achievements, and learn from their experiences.
Experience the thrill of progressing rapidly as you navigate the mountain with confidence
and style. Download PocketCoach Snowboarding App now and embark on a journey that
will transform you into a better rider within months. Get ready to shred like never before!
The price of “Access to all paid features” subscription is just $9.99/Month and $99.99/Year and applied to your iTunes account on confirmation. The price may vary from time-to-time and may change without notice, but you can always see the exact price in the app. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. 
Terms of use (http://pocketcoachadmin.com/Teams_condition.html) 
Privacy-policy (http://pocketcoachadmin.com/privacy_policy.html).

bluejetty:00100398:ios.description:
Train your brain and unwind with Word Merge: Associations – the ultimate relaxing puzzle game where word skills and lateral thinking come together!
If you enjoy trivia, word search, and puzzles that challenge how you connect ideas, this is the perfect game to keep your mind sharp. Designed for players who love discovering themes, Word Merge lets you pair words that belong to the same topic — from everyday categories to the delightfully unexpected.
HOW TO PLAY • Analyze the Grid: Look at the board filled with mixed words. • Find the Connection: Tap on four words that share a common theme. • Make the Match: Merge them to clear the group and reveal the topic. • Clear the Board: Find all the pairs to complete the level!
KEY FEATURES
Relaxing & Cozy Gameplay Designed for stress-free fun. There are no timers, no penalties, and no rush. Play at your own pace, whether you are enjoying a morning coffee or winding down at night.
Hundreds of Unique Levels Enjoy endless gameplay with increasing difficulty. The word groupings range from obvious everyday items to clever, surprising abstract themes that will make you think twice.
Brain Training Improve your vocabulary, memory, and associative thinking. It is a fun mental workout that feels like a break, not a chore.
Elegant Visuals Enjoy a clean, calming interface designed to be easy on the eyes. The intuitive controls make it accessible for puzzle lovers of all ages.
WHY PLAY WORD MERGE? Our players love the balance of mental stimulation and peaceful vibes. If you are looking for a game that respects your time and challenges your intellect without the stress, this is for you.
Download Word Merge: Associations today and see how well you can connect the dots!

Amazing Strategy: Plan your angles, time your moves, and manage your upgrades
Visually Addictive: Every bounce and brick break is a mini fireworks show
Completely Free: In-app purchases for those who want to play faster
Download Bounce Heroes: Clash Battle now and start your journey through bouncing balls, tricky puzzles, and explosive fun!

bluejetty:00026527:ios.name: Solitaire Smash: Real Cash!
bluejetty:00026527:ios.summary:
Looking for a Solitaire game that offers a fun and challenging gameplay experience, as well as the chance to win real cash prizes? Look no further than Solitaire Smash!
Our game has been carefully crafted to offer a modern and sleek gamepla
bluejetty:00026527:ios.description:
Looking for a Solitaire game that offers a fun and challenging gameplay experience, as well as the chance to win real cash prizes? Look no further than Solitaire Smash!
Our game has been carefully crafted to offer a modern and sleek gameplay interface, incorporating classic Solitaire game elements that we all know and love.
Our platform is committed to ensuring a secure gaming environment based on fair, social competition for all our players. When you play Solitaire Smash, you will be matched with other players at the same skill level as you, all using the same deck.
This ensures that the game is fair and based purely on skill.
Solitaire Smash offers a range of thrilling features:
* Play in real money tournaments!
* Secure deposit using PayPal and Apple Pay!
* Cash-out Safely!
* Ad-free gaming experience!
* Daily gifts and bonuses!
* Multiplayer tournaments with trophies and big prizes!
Additionally, we regularly offer special challenges and surprises to keep the game exciting and engaging.
How to Play Solitaire Smash:
1. Put your Solitaire skills to the test in our exciting tournaments. The game is the same whether you are playing for virtual currency or real money.
2. Build sequences of the same type of cards in the four foundations, which are the piles at the top left corner. Place the Ace you uncover into one of the four foundations. If you find the same card type, in ascending order, place it over the Ace.
3. To play in the tableau, drag cards to build sequences in descending order and alternating colors. Empty columns can only be filled with a king. If you have no face-up cards to move, tap the stockpile to draw from the top and use the first card. Redraw if needed.
4. When you're out of moves, you can undo your moves to try a different play. If you cannot find another move, submit your score and take advantage of the bigger time bonus. Timing is key. The faster you clear the board, the higher your score, and the bigger bonus you will get!
5. The top three players in the Solitaire tournament will win real money or gems. Keep playing to win daily rewards and treats! Enjoy our unique and special events, missions, and challenges.
So, brace yourself for an addictive experience that will not only sharpen your mind but also provide a relaxing and rewarding experience. With the potential to enhance your solitaire skills and strategies, you'll find yourself getting lost in the fun of becoming the ultimate solitaire player - all while winning exciting cash rewards! Get set to take on this challenge and feel the rush of anticipation!
Kindly note:

bluejetty:00087253:ios.summary:
The DUOTONE Academy App
A unique all-in-one tool to improve your Wing Foil skills in no time!
The Duotone Academy App is designed for aspiring Wing Foilers wanting to reach the next level. Whether you are a rookie or an experienced rider,
bluejetty:00087253:ios.description:
The DUOTONE Academy App
A unique all-in-one tool to improve your Wing Foil skills in no time!
The Duotone Academy App is designed for aspiring Wing Foilers wanting to reach the next level. Whether you are a rookie or an experienced rider, the Duotone Academy App will show you what tricks to learn next in your progression. From beginner lessons to advanced freestyle moves, jump variations, and wave riding, the app offers step-by-step tutorials for each kiteboarding discipline and level. In addition, you can connect with Super Coaches, including professional riders like Paula Novotná, Klaas Voget, Stefan Spiessberger & more, to get further tips from the world’s best & land the trick of your dreams. It’s never been easier to stay connected to the community; you can search for other riders, Wing Foil spots, Pro Centers, events, and our partner shops all in one place. Follow centers & events to stay updated with what’s happening near you. Direct message other Wing Foilers to meet up for a session and get local insights on the spot.
What it’s all about:
- More than 100 tricks
- Five Wing Foil disciplines
- Finding new Wing Foil buddies with the spot feature has never been easier
- Get in touch with riders from all over the world
- See our partner shops, Pro Centers, camps & test events
- Learn from the best
LEVEL UP your riding
- Watch the correct execution of a trick/study lesson videos/follow the how-to’s, read the descriptions, and memorize the key elements
- Get pointers directly from the Wing Foil community by sharing your trick on the all-new stage
- Get feedback from our Super Coaches
Stay MOTIVATED
- Collect points, unlock badges, and compete with your friends on the leaderboard
- Upload your tricks and receive votes from the Wing Foil community
Use the app WHEREVER you are
- Wing Foil spots are not always located within signal reach, which is why the app also operates in offline mode
- Download lesson videos beforehand and access them even in the most remote places
Become PART of the DUOTONE family
- Get feedback directly from our Super Coaches
- Search for spots and get in touch with local riders
- Improve your general Wing Foil level and reduce injuries by having the necessary information
- Get to know more experienced Wing Foilers having the exact right tips for you to improve
- See & follow our partner shops, upcoming camps, & test events, and get automatic push notifications to stay up-to-date
- Get direct navigation to the events, shops & spots
- Check out our TRY IT NOW products
- Become an ambassador by helping others to achieve their next steps
- REDEFINE YOUR LIMITS TOGETHER!

bluejetty:00185464:ios.description:
Gin Rummy Classic, Oklahoma, Straight rummy and Hollywood Gin!
Gin Rummy card game is a form of the rummy game where players place cards into sets and runs.
The object of the game is to collect a hand where most or all of the cards can be combined into sets and runs and the point value of the remaining unmatched cards is low.
PLAY FOR FREE - Experience all features totally free.
- Now including Oklahoma and Straight Gin!
- Arrange your hand as you play, or let the app sort it for you!
- 3 different decks of cards available
- Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty settings
- Landscape or portrait view for iPhone
- Choice of backgrounds
- User stats
- Gin Rummy Rules & Help
TERMS OF USE, PRIVACY POLICY, SUBSCRIPTIONS
Gin Rummy Classic app offers a weekly subscription (1 week), monthly and a yearly subscription (1 year) called Premier.
If you subscribe in another currency, the price may vary slightly if your bank charges you a conversion fee.
Payment for your subscription will be debited from your account after your purchase is confirmed.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Find out more about our general terms of use at http://www.ginrummycardgame.com/terms-of-service/
Find out more about our privacy policy at http://www.ginrummycardgame.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00137373:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00137373:ios.description:
Send and receive faxes from your iPhone. No fax machine, no landline.
FaxFlow turns your iPhone or iPad into a fax line: scan a document with your camera, enter the recipient's fax number, and it's delivered — with a confirmation you can keep.
What you can do
• Send faxes to any fax number in the US, Canada, and worldwide
• Get your own US fax number and receive faxes with instant notifications
• Scan paper documents with automatic edge detection and cleanup
• Attach PDF, JPG, and PNG files from your phone or the Files app
• Add a cover page with your name, number, and a short message
• Get delivery confirmation for every fax, with a receipt you can share
• Failed fax? We retry automatically
What people fax with FaxFlow
Tax forms to the IRS, applications to government offices, prescriptions and records to doctors' offices, insurance claims, signed contracts, bank documents. If an office still asks for a fax, FaxFlow handles it from your phone in about a minute.
Is it secure?
Yes. Faxes are encrypted in transit and delivered over dedicated phone lines — often the very reason medical, legal, and government offices still rely on fax.
What does it cost?
The app is free to download — scanning, cover pages, and fax preparation cost nothing. Sending and receiving require a subscription, because every fax travels over real phone lines we pay to operate. Weekly, monthly, and annual plans are available, and you can cancel anytime. Need just one fax? Take a weekly plan, send it, and cancel — no further charges.
Questions?
Reach us in the app under Settings → Contact Us, or at www.fax-flow.com. Real humans answer.
Privacy Policy: https://fax-flow.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://fax-flow.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00178090:ios.description:
Master Your Focus, Conquer Your Exams
Struggling with procrastination? Overwhelmed by exam stress? Meet the study companion designed to turn chaos into productivity. Whether you’re a medical student managing revision, a professional fighting ADHD time blindness, or just trying to finish that essay—this is the focus tool you’ve been waiting for.
WHY STUDENTS & ADHD BRAINS LOVE US:
Scientific Pomodoro Technique
Break work into manageable 25-minute intervals (or customize your own!). The rhythm of "Focus" and "Break" keeps your mind fresh and prevents burnout. Perfect for the Pomodoro method enthusiasts who need structure.
Built for ADHD & Neurodivergence
We understand the struggle of "starting." Our low-friction interface and gentle reminders act as a digital body double, helping you overcome executive dysfunction and stay on track. Say goodbye to time blindness.
Immersive Study Environment
Block out distractions with built-in white noise, Lo-fi beats, rain sounds, and library ambience. Turn your phone into a sanctuary of concentration, no matter where you are.
Track Your Progress
Meaningful analytics show you exactly when you are most productive. Visualize your study streaks, track total focus hours, and categorize time by subject (Math, Coding, Biology, Work).
KEY FEATURES:
Customizable Timer: Set 25/5, 50/10, or any custom interval to suit your flow.
Live Activities & Widgets: Check your remaining time directly from your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island (iPhone 14 Pro/15/16).
Aesthetic Themes: Choose from Minimalist, Dark Mode, or Cute themes to match your studygram aesthetic.
Flip Clock Mode: A classic full-screen digital clock designed to keep you off your phone.
Background Mode: Timer runs perfectly while you use other essential study apps.
PERFECT FOR:
High School & University Students preparing for SATs, GCSEs, or Finals.
Remote Workers & Freelancers needing structure.
Anyone with ADHD, ADD, or Executive Function challenges.
Language Learners & Avid Readers.
Stop scrolling and start achieving. Download Pomodoro Focus Timer - Study now and reclaim your attention!
=== Subscription options ===
The app is free to download, but to access premium features, a subscription is required. With the subscription, you'll enjoy uninterrupted access to our premium features. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
If you wish to cancel the automatic renewal of your subscription, you can do so at any time by accessing your iTunes account settings. However, please note that refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To ensure a successful cancellation, please make sure to turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Need help? Contact us at:
Email: andychung.cc@gmail.com
- Terms & Privacy
By using this app, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
Terms of Use: https://pomodoro.andyrgb.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pomodoro.andyrgb.com/privacy

bluejetty:00022651:ios.description:
In both a figurative and literal sense, forensic meteorologist David Zander has hit rock bottom. Trapped deep underground on a lost and forgotten island, David’s priority shifts from finding answers about the mystery surrounding him, to surviving the crisis he now finds himself trapped in. It’s now up to you to find an escape from the madness of meridian 157, but be warned, as escape may not come so easily. Will David find the answers he searched so hard for, or will his efforts all be in vain?
Meridian 157 is a point and click adventure series involving interactive puzzles and an intriguing storyline taking place over a long series of chapters. Built using state of the art rendering technology, this installment focuses on immersing players in unique and frightening environments, while allowing them to enjoy notable puzzles and engaging interactions. Try out the fully free prologue to get a taste for what the Meridian series has to offer!

• Custom written music to compliment the high quality visuals
• All new item combine feature, supporting many different styles of play
• Latest episode continuing a spooky and thrilling storyline

• A logical hint system for some of the most difficult riddles
• Available in 8 languages, including English, French, Russian, German, Chinese (Mandarin), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Japanese!
• New colour blind mode available for people who might have trouble with colour based puzzles

Are you ready to experience a unique car driving gameplay? Start with your SUV and unlock new vehicles as you progress through the game, playing different and unique levels. Drive your favorite vehicles, and navigate your way around new challenging environments.
We welcome all racing car game fans to experience this new driving game! Real Drive 3D is the best car simulation game of 2021 which will give you a unique arcade experience.
Become a pro driver and master your parking skills in this new classic car simulator! Use your extreme stunt sports ability to navigate your way through a virtual multi-story environment. 
Start with a 4x4, be it a Prado or an SUV, and get the ultimate driving school experience! Learn to park with a manual gear shift. Make sure not to crash or burn out - drive safely especially when you are driving offroad.
Fasten your seat belt and unleash your inner racer by taking control of extreme vehicles in this parking mania. Challenge yourself with the rooftop levels or have fun in amusing virtual environments. Parking from one level to another has never been so much fun!

- Modern hyper-casual controls: Easy one-finger control for a new and unique 
 experience
- Addictive controls: Hold to drive, release to brake
- Portrait mode: For single-handed gameplay
- Vehicles include: Truck, Jeep, SUV, off-road vehicles, hypercars, and an 
 exclusive sports car

bluejetty:00124051:ios.summary:

From the makers of Mini Metro, Mini Motorways is a game about drawing the roads that drive a
bluejetty:00124051:ios.description:
Have you ever been stuck in traffic and wished you could do something to fix it? In Mini Motorways, the city’s traffic problems are in your hands.
From the makers of Mini Metro, Mini Motorways is a game about drawing the roads that drive a growing city. Build a road network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your city to keep the traffic flowing, and carefully manage upgrades to meet the changing demands. How long can you keep the cities of the world moving?
Features:
• Draw roads in dynamic cities that grow and change—every game is unique!
• Explore stunning maps inspired by cities all around the world.
• Choose from a variety of upgrades to meet the demands of your ever-expanding road network: highways, roundabouts, and more!
• Build without limits in Creative Mode—design your dream city exactly how you want it with unlimited upgrades and editing tools.
• Stress-free Endless Mode offers you a relaxing gameplay experience, plus you can continue building your city after Game Over.
• Tackle our Expert Mode, which features twists such as permanent roads and limited upgrades for the ultimate challenge.
• Select different color palettes on every map including colorblind and night modes.
• Relax to a responsive soundtrack from Disasterpeace that grows along with your city.
• Unlock new maps and achievements as you achieve mastery. 
• Export GIFs of your city layouts to share with your friends.
• Compete against other players in Daily and Weekly Challenges.
• Compatible with Siri Remote, Bluetooth and MFi controllers.

bluejetty:00175146:ios.summary:

Acres is the ul
bluejetty:00175146:ios.description:
Acres makes discovering property lines, landowner information, and land for sale easier than ever. Now with route tracking, offline maps, 3D maps, waypoints, and custom maps that sync between your mobile device and desktop.
Acres is the ultimate on-the-go mapping and land analysis tool for landowners, developers, land investors, and real estate professionals. Effortlessly locate property boundaries, evaluate parcel-level insights, and browse land listings. With Acres, you’ll have access to data for millions of parcels across the US—plus the power to save and share your property maps on the go.
◆ NEW FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS
• Route Tracking: Track and save your path as you walk.
• Offline Maps: Access saved satellite-view areas or custom maps when you’re off grid.
• 3D Maps: Visualize terrain in 3D mode.
• Waypoints: Mark, save, and share points of interest on the map.
◆ SEARCH LAND FOR SALE
• Land Listings: Instantly find and share land for sale across the US.
◆ FIND OWNER NAMES & PROPERTY LINES
• Owner Info: View landowners’ names.
• Property Lines: Check precise property boundaries.
◆ RESEARCH LAND ON THE GO
• Soil Maps: Assess soil composition and quality.
• Elevation & Topography: Quickly view topographic data with adjustable contour lines.
• Historical Imagery: Historic satellite imagery at the parcel level.
• Vegetation Index: Historic plant health based on light wave reflection..
• Crop History: Annual crop coverage gathered via satellite imagery.
• County Rent: Estimates for cash rental rates for cropland and pastureland.
• County Yield: Farmer-reported survey data of annual expected crop yields.
• Property Tax: Stay informed with recent property tax info.
• Flood and Wetlands: Check flood risk and identify wetland areas.
◆ ACCESS & SHARE LAND DATA ANYWHERE
• Save Parcels: Keep track of parcels for offline viewing.
• Share Maps: Share your property map and land data directly from the app.
• Waypoints: Mark, save, and share points on the map.
• Sync with Desktop: Seamlessly move between your mobile device and desktop for full-scale analysis.
• Free 3D Maps: Toggle on/off to explore land from every angle—fully compatible with insights and custom maps.
◆ CUSTOM MAPS
• Geotag Photos: Snap pictures on-site and automatically mark their location.
• Add Notes: Label and add descriptions to your map customizations.
• Points of Interest: Mark buildings, hunt stands, and other points of interest.
• Save & Sync: Access your custom maps seamlessly across mobile and desktop.
• Offline Access: Download your maps before heading out for offline use.
◆ ROUTE TRACKING
• Track Every Step: Measure distance, elevation changes, and more as you walk.
• Save Your Route: Save your route for later use.
◆ NO ADS
◆ FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
We’re always here to help. Send feature requests or get assistance from our team at: support@acres.com.
---
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed and canceled at any time through your iTunes account settings. If you cancel during the subscription term, you will not receive a refund of subscription fees for that term. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited. For more details, please review our www.acres.com/terms-of-use and www.acres.com/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00179585:ios.summary:

The exact text of the law, not a summary of it. Built for the moment you need to read
bluejetty:00179585:ios.description:
Statutes for New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Colorado, Florida, California and many more states, plus the full US Code, on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
The exact text of the law, not a summary of it. Built for the moment you need to read the actual statute: on a shoulder, in a courthouse hallway, in a basement with no signal.
WHY PROFESSIONALS USE IT
• Complete records. Full statute text, not headnotes and not excerpts.
• Updated at the source. Titles refresh as each state publishes new data. The app tracks state legislature sites directly, so amendments reach you without you going looking for them.
• Fast search, by heading or across the full text of a title.
• Tap a cited section to read it in a pop-up without losing your place.
• The list and the law, side by side on iPad, Mac and an unfolded iPhone Duo.
• Works offline. Once a title is downloaded it works with no connection, no signal and no cell data. Nothing loads from the web when you search.
• Favorites and bookmarks for the sections you return to daily.
• Your own notes on any section, with optional iCloud backup.
• Favorites can sync and restore through iCloud across your devices.
• Dark mode throughout.
BUILT FOR
Police and law enforcement · Attorneys and public defenders · Paralegals and legal assistants · Investigators · Court staff · Corrections and probation · Code enforcement · Law students
MOST-USED TITLES
New Jersey Title 2C (Criminal Justice) and Title 39 (Motor Vehicles). Pennsylvania Title 18 (Crimes) and Title 75 (Vehicle Code). New York Penal Law and Vehicle & Traffic Law. Colorado Title 18 (Criminal Code) and Title 42 (Vehicles and Traffic). Title 18 of the US Code (Crimes and Criminal Procedure). Florida Title XLVI (Crimes). California Penal Code and Vehicle Code. Connecticut Title 53a (Penal Code) and Title 14 (Motor Vehicles). Virginia Title 18.2 (Crimes). Plus criminal procedure, civil practice, tax, insurance and education codes across every state in the library.
STATES AND JURISDICTIONS INCLUDED
Alabama · Alaska · Arizona · California · Colorado · Connecticut · Delaware · District of Columbia · Florida · Hawaii · Idaho · Illinois · Indiana · Iowa · Kansas · Kentucky · Louisiana · Maine · Maryland · Massachusetts · Michigan · Minnesota · Missouri · Montana · Nebraska · Nevada · New Hampshire · New Jersey · New Mexico · New York · North Carolina · North Dakota · Ohio · Oklahoma · Oregon · Pennsylvania · Rhode Island · South Carolina · South Dakota · Texas · Utah · Vermont · Virginia · Washington · West Virginia · Wisconsin · Wyoming · United States Code
Colorado is included as an officially sanctioned publication using the official text of the Colorado Revised Statutes.
HOW IT WORKS
Buy only the titles you need, or a complete set for a state. Free titles are available so you can see the format before you buy. More states are added on an ongoing basis.

bluejetty:00089560:ios.description:
Reach your fitness goals with fat-burning and muscle-building workouts created for you by Certified Personal Trainer and long-time advocate for women’s health and fitness, Cristina Capron.
No more aimlessly wandering around the gym trying to figure out what to do - quick and effective workouts are now planned for you and available in the palm of your hand.
Select from hundreds of workouts tailored to help you meet your fitness goals, including burning stubborn belly fat, gaining muscle, toning & tightening, or a little bit of everything. 
The app consists of:
* Hundreds of different workouts designed to help women build strong, toned muscles and lose fat. New workouts are added weekly!
* A range of exercises for all experience levels including weight lifting, steady state cardio, HIIT circuits, stretching, and more.
* Structured programs with days and weeks of workouts planned for you. 
* Video demonstrations of each exercise to show proper form and remove confusion.
* Workout tracking capabilities to log when you’ve completed workouts and track your progress directly in the app.
* Cristina’s real workouts added weekly so you can follow her exact workout regime.
* A “Connect” section with updates from Cristina and other women in the CCFIT community
Free membership:
- Download the app for FREE!
- Sample a selection of free workouts
- Access to the “Connect” page to get updates from Cristina
- Access to CCFIT facebook group

- Access to ALL workouts and programs
- Additional exercise variations for each body part + stretches
- Workout history log and progress tracker
- Access to the “Connect” page to get updates from Cristina
- Access to CCFIT facebook group
Premium annual membership:
- 20% savings compared to the monthly plan when you pay for the full year
- Access to ALL workouts and programs
- Additional exercise variations for each body part + stretches
- Workout history log and progress tracker
- Access to the “Connect” page to get updates from Cristina
- Access to CCFIT facebook group
Premium membership is an auto-renewal monthly subscription for $9.99 or an annual subscription for $99.99. Free 7 day trial!

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://www.ccfit.app/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00040058:ios.name: Korean Reading: TTMIK Stories
bluejetty:00040058:ios.summary:
Stop studying. Start reading.
TTMIK Stories helps you learn Korean naturally through 1,000+ original stories across 10 levels — covering everything from daily life and culture to business, mystery, and more.
Your Learning Journey:
Stories
bluejetty:00040058:ios.description:
Stop studying. Start reading.
TTMIK Stories helps you learn Korean naturally through 1,000+ original stories across 10 levels — covering everything from daily life and culture to business, mystery, and more.
Your Learning Journey:
Stories is built around an immersive learning flow that connects reading, listening, and deep understanding.
- Read: Start with stories made for your level. Tap any word to see the meaning instantly.
- Go Deeper: Understand every sentence with translations and grammar notes that explain the why, not just the what.
- Listen: Follow along as professional voice actors bring each story to life. Train your ear with natural Korean pronunciation and intonation.
- Write: Put what you learned into your own words and turn passive reading into active Korean ability.
- Review: Reinforce new words with quizzes and flashcards, built from the stories you already read.
- Challenge: Build your streak, track your progress, and earn certificates that show how far you've come.
Main Features:
- 1,000+ Graded Stories: Original Korean stories across 10 levels, designed around the TTMIK curriculum and TOPIK vocabulary. Topics range from daily life and culture to mystery and business.
- Tap Any Word: Instantly see definitions without leaving the story. Keep reading without breaking your flow.
- Translations & Grammar Notes: Deepen comprehension with sentence-by-sentence translations and grammar explanations.
- Audio by Professional Voice Actors: Listen to clear, natural Korean while following highlighted text.
- Writing Practice: Reinforce what you’ve learned by expressing it in your own words.
- Vocabulary Review: Review words you’ve already seen in context through quizzes and flashcards. Words are sorted automatically based on your learning progress.
- Progress Tracking & Certificates: Save your study history, build consistency, and complete the 20-Day Challenge to earn a Reading Club certificate.
Perfect for:
- Beginners who want to start reading real Korean from day one.
- Intermediate learners who want to grow vocabulary and comprehension through context.
- Advanced learners who want to read natural, modern Korean with more depth.
- Anyone who wants to enjoy Korean, not just study it.
What You’ll Experience:
TTMIK Stories is more than a reading app. It’s the bridge between finishing a textbook and actually reading Korean.
- Feel the joy of finishing a story — in Korean — from beginning to end.
- Build vocabulary and grammar naturally through stories you actually want to read.
- Stay consistent with daily challenges, streaks, and certificates that make progress visible.
Proven by 1.5M+ Learners:
- Built on 14 years of Korean language expertise, TTMIK Stories is trusted by over 1.5 million learners across 190 countries.
- With 45 textbooks and more than 1,700 expert video lessons created by true Korean educators, we bring proven learning methods refined through years of experience.
Learn Korean with confidence — guided by the same team behind one of the world’s most trusted Korean learning platforms.
Start reading real Korean today with TTMIK Stories.
Download now and start your 7-day free trial.
Read a little each day — and feel your Korean become more natural with every story.
◈ Payment information is required to access full content. After the 7-day free trial, your subscription will start automatically unless you cancel before the trial ends.

bluejetty:00127302:ios.summary:

One app, two completely different ways to unwind. Whether you have two spar
bluejetty:00127302:ios.description:
Sudoku Blocks is two block puzzles in one calm, colorful app — fill a sudoku grid at your own pace, or pop block groups level by level. No pop-up ads, just blocks.
One app, two completely different ways to unwind. Whether you have two spare minutes or a whole cozy evening, there's a mode for your mood.
SUDOKU BLOCKS — Fill Rows, Columns & Squares
Drag block pieces onto the 9×9 grid. Complete a row, a column, or a 3×3 square to clear it and score. No timer, no pressure — just clean, endless block-placing with a sudoku twist. Every block you clear also reveals a hidden picture, piece by piece.
BLOCK POP — Tap Groups, Clear the Board
Tap two or more touching blocks of the same color to pop them. Clear the whole board to finish the level — the fewer taps you need, the more stars you earn. Watch out for stubborn stones, save the day with a Star block, and when you're stuck, a hint, a hammer or a brush gets you out of trouble. The levels never run out — and they grow trickier as you climb.
MORE TO PLAY FOR
- Reveal hidden pictures and collect them in your Gallery
- Level up your profile and unlock dozens of avatars
- Unlock block color sets and make the grid yours
- Climb the Game Center leaderboard
- Come back every day to claim your daily reward
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Two games in one — fill and pop in a single app
- No pop-up ads interrupting your play
- Simple to learn, genuinely hard to put down
- Calm, colorful design that's easy on the eyes
- Hints and power-ups for when you get stuck
- Plays offline — perfect for commutes and cozy evenings
Whether you're a sudoku fan, a block-puzzle veteran, or just looking for a colorful way to relax, Sudoku Blocks has a mode for your mood.

bluejetty:00087116:ios.description:
Sircles was designed by world renowned scientists and has been rigorously tested… and the results are in:
Sircles is making the world a better place one share at a time. Do you want to be a better person? Of course you do. That's why you NEED Sircles. 
There’s an epidemic of trolls, tricksters and tomfoolery plaguing our online world. We’re not saying all people suck but the internet, social media and review sites like Yelp have brought out the worst in our fellow humans. Sircles is the cure.
 - WARNING - Take Sircles only as prescribed by your physician.
SIDE EFFECTS MAY INCLUDE:
- warm and fuzzy feeling
- overcome by joy
- desire to delete all your other apps
- unexpected fits of smiling
- closer connections with your besties
- X-ray vision
- time travel
- unlocking mysteries of the universe
- in extremely rare cases users have reported being able to fly
By downloading Sircles today you enter a safe space where your friends share their favorite places, movies, shows, podcasts, etc. There’s no reviews because friends don’t exchange reviews or suggest places they dislike—friends recommend the things they think you’ll love. In this way, Sircles was designed to remain a positive environment. 
Like seriously, though. We don’t mess around with bullies. All users are validated by their phone number and we will ban trolls for life. It’s very difficult to troll, however (the way we’ve built Sircles), so don’t worry—you’re joining the Sircles revolution—you’re helping make the online world a better place.
SIRCLES IS GREAT FOR GROUPS—from very small to very large
- Sircles was built with our circle of friends in mind—how we connect, chat, share and plan with each other
- Sircles works great in single player mode as well
- Plan and manage events for your organization
- See trending entertainment from the community and your friends’ recent activity, and start a conversation
STAY ORGANIZED
- Add your Favorites as you travel to new places or just around your community
- Share your Favorites right into chat which automatically creates a topic for your group
- Topics are organized at the top of your chat and recently discussed topics shuffle to the front
- Not ready to try something shared with you? Save profiles for later
- Create custom topics
EARN REWARDS
- Level up and claim goodies while supporting local businesses
- Find the best kept secrets and hidden gems at home or on the road

bluejetty:00144952:ios.name: Circles - Mental Health Groups
bluejetty:00144952:ios.summary:
You know that feeling when you try to explain your relationship to someone and halfway through, you stop. Because you can hear how it sounds. And you're not sure they'd believe you.
Circles is for that.
-----------------------------
WHAT
bluejetty:00144952:ios.description:
You know that feeling when you try to explain your relationship to someone and halfway through, you stop. Because you can hear how it sounds. And you're not sure they'd believe you.
Circles is for that.
-----------------------------
WHAT HAPPENS HERE
It's a live voice room full of people who don't need the backstory. Because they lived it. The walking on eggshells. The second-guessing everything you said. The wondering if you imagined it all.
You join a session. Audio only, no video. An AI facilitator keeps things safe and moving. And then someone starts talking, and it's like they're describing your life.
That's the moment everything starts to change. Not because someone fixed you. Because you heard your own story in someone else's voice and realized you weren't making it up.
-----------------------------
WHAT STARTS TO CHANGE
- The 2am spiraling slows down
- You stop rehearsing arguments that already happened
- You start noticing patterns you couldn't see from inside them
- You begin making choices that are actually yours
-----------------------------
WHAT YOU GET
- Live group sessions, 24/7. Join whenever you're ready
- Audio only. No video, no profiles, no performance
- AI-guided facilitation trained in emotional support
- 15 to 45 minute sessions on narcissistic abuse recovery, boundaries, gaslighting, self-doubt
- A companion chat for processing between sessions
-----------------------------
WHAT MEMBERS SAY
"The person I talked to was ME in five years. Same story. I swear it was the first time I saw a way out." — Mara
"It's 3:14 AM. It's unbelievable to have a lifeline connected right now. I seriously appreciate all of you." — Kelly A
"Almost chickened out three times before joining. SO Glad I didn't. That's all." — Tamika
"My therapist helps me process. This helps me feel less alone while I'm processing." — Danielle K
"I was skeptical about the AI thing. So much better than most human-led groups I've been in." — SJ
-----------------------------
Show up as you are. Or just listen.
Either way, you're not carrying this alone anymore.

bluejetty:00078017:ios.description:
Measuring your heart rate and exercising every day is the key to getting better and healthier. Easily take your heart rate by placing your finger on the camera. Measure your heart rate daily to track your history with our advanced HRV technology. 
This heart health app will educate and inform you on how to keep your heart strong and risk factors minimal. Take the guess work out of your health and offers a broad suite of challenging, yet achievable programs with workouts you can do anywhere, anytime to progressively build your fitness. New programs give you more ways to push yourself and get you closer to reaching your goals. 
Disclaimer
The app is not intended for medical use. Measurements and statistics are used only for fitness purposes and cannot be used for diagnostics. Always seek a doctor's advice before making any medical decisions.
Heart Rate Monitor
Get your heart rate easily by placing your finger on the camera. This heart health app will educate and inform you how to keep your heart strong and minimize risk factors. Start getting healthier today!
How to Use:
- Hold your phone steadily and keep calm.
- Make sure your fingers are not too cold and don’t press too hard to avoid affecting accuracy.
- Cover the entire back camera lightly with your finger. Begin the reading with just a gentle touch.
Heart Rate Analysis Report
Heart Plus goes beyond taking heart rate, you will receive a comprehensive report based on your age, gender, weight, height, and status. It will help you develop lifelong habits to improve your heart health.
Enjoy targeted at-home workouts for all problem areas of your body! Dozens of programs and hundreds of thoroughly created and combined exercises are waiting.
Dive into an extensive library of keto meal plans with various delightful recipes. * Our standard subscription options are:
Weekly Subscription - $6.99, 3-day free trail

* Content provided during subscription period:
- Unlock all charging animations
- Access to all live wallpapers

bluejetty:00077626:ios.summary:
3D GO – 3D Printing, STL Viewer & Slicer
3D GO is a fast, all-in-one 3D printing app for finding, previewing, organizing, and slicing 3D models from the biggest sites in the world. Instead of jumping between five different websites, folder
bluejetty:00077626:ios.description:
3D GO – 3D Printing, STL Viewer & Slicer
3D GO is a fast, all-in-one 3D printing app for finding, previewing, organizing, and slicing 3D models from the biggest sites in the world. Instead of jumping between five different websites, folders, and slicers, you can do everything in one place.
Search across Thingiverse, Printables, MakerWorld, Cults3D, Creality Cloud, Thangs, MyMiniFactory and Sketchfab at the same time to find STL files for parts, tools, upgrades, miniatures, home décor, and just about anything else you want to 3D print. Whether you’re printing functional parts or artistic models, 3D GO makes it easy to discover the best files from the entire 3D printing community.
Select models with a full 3D preview and STL viewer, so you can rotate, zoom, and inspect it before you download or slice. This helps you avoid bad files, broken geometry, and wasted filament. You can also open any STL from your device and view it instantly inside the app.
When you’re ready to print, 3D GO includes a built-in 3D slicer that converts STL files into print-ready G-code. You can prepare files for PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, and more, then export them for your printer using your normal workflow. It works great alongside Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura, and Klipper-based setups.
You can save any model from any site and organize them into custom collections. Keep folders for different printers, materials, or projects, search through your saved models, and manage even huge STL libraries without losing track of anything.
3D GO also lets you explore what’s happening across the entire 3D printing world. Browse trending 3D models, check out design contests, and discover new creators without visiting each site individually.
No matter what 3D printer you use — Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Flashforge, Ultimaker, and more — 3D GO fits right into your workflow.
Key features
• Search Thingiverse, Printables, MakerWorld, Cults3D, Creality Cloud, Thangs, MyMiniFactory & Sketchfab
• Full 3D preview and STL viewer
• Built-in 3D slicer with G-code export
• Save models and create custom collections
• Search and manage your STL library
• View trending models and design contests
• Works with all major 3D printers
If you’re into 3D printing and tired of juggling multiple websites and slicer apps, 3D GO brings everything together into one clean, fast experience.
Download 3D GO and make finding and preparing your next 3D print simple again.
