listings.description:
3D GO – 3D Printing, STL Viewer & Slicer

3D GO is a fast, all-in-one 3D printing app for finding, previewing, organizing, and slicing 3D models from the biggest sites in the world. Instead of jumping between five different websites, folders, and slicers, you can do everything in one place.

Search across Thingiverse, Printables, MakerWorld, Cults3D, Creality Cloud, Thangs, MyMiniFactory and Sketchfab at the same time to find STL files for parts, tools, upgrades, miniatures, home décor, and just about anything else you want to 3D print. Whether you’re printing functional parts or artistic models, 3D GO makes it easy to discover the best files from the entire 3D printing community.

Select models with a full 3D preview and STL viewer, so you can rotate, zoom, and inspect it before you download or slice. This helps you avoid bad files, broken geometry, and wasted filament. You can also open any STL from your device and view it instantly inside the app.

When you’re ready to print, 3D GO includes a built-in 3D slicer that converts STL files into print-ready G-code. You can prepare files for PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, and more, then export them for your printer using your normal workflow. It works great alongside Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura, and Klipper-based setups.

You can save any model from any site and organize them into custom collections. Keep folders for different printers, materials, or projects, search through your saved models, and manage even huge STL libraries without losing track of anything.

3D GO also lets you explore what’s happening across the entire 3D printing world. Browse trending 3D models, check out design contests, and discover new creators without visiting each site individually.

No matter what 3D printer you use — Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Flashforge, Ultimaker, and more — 3D GO fits right into your workflow.

Key features
• Search Thingiverse, Printables, MakerWorld, Cults3D, Creality Cloud, Thangs, MyMiniFactory & Sketchfab
• Full 3D preview and STL viewer
• Built-in 3D slicer with G-code export
• Save models and create custom collections
• Search and manage your STL library
• View trending models and design contests
• Works with all major 3D printers

If you’re into 3D printing and tired of juggling multiple websites and slicer apps, 3D GO brings everything together into one clean, fast experience.

Download 3D GO and make finding and preparing your next 3D print simple again.

3D GO is an independent app and is not affiliated with any of the sites or printer brands mentioned. All trademarks belong to their owners.

bluejetty:00075496:ios.description:
Hit Em Up: Mass Texting, Individually Tailored
Hit Em Up turns your phone into a relationship factory, churning out stronger connections while you save hours.
Imagine having a 5-hour (or more) weekly gift of time. That's Hit Em Up - cultivating your network while you live your life.
The Hit Em Up Personalized Mass Text process is simple:
1. Write a message (or let our SmartWrite AI help you write a message based on your intent) using our custom inserts that personalize your message with your recipients' names (Hi ::firstname::!)
2. Select a list of contacts to send your message
3. Watch as Hit Em Up personalizes each message uniquely and personally to each recipient personally and privately!
A Revolution in Your Texting and Out Reach:
• SmartWrite AI: Your personal wordsmith, crafting bespoke messages at lightning speed.
• Scheduled Messages: Be the clockwork correspondent - your messages arrive precisely when they matter most.
• Smart Selectors: Your audience architect. Build perfect groups with a few keystrokes, no manual labor required.
• Unlimited Tags: The secret ingredients that turn mass messages into personal conversations. Sprinkle liberally for best results.
• CSV Contact Import: Your network's welcome mat. Roll out the red carpet for contacts from any source, and start the party immediately.
• Template Texts: Your message cookbook. Whip up tried-and-true recipes or save your signature dishes for future feasts.
• Fast Send: Your message's hyperdrive. Leap into lightspeed outreach with our advanced sending process.
• Personalized Mass Emails: Your communication chameleon. Adapt your personal touch from texts to inboxes seamlessly.
Hit Em Up speaks your audience's language - whether it's SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, or Email. You're fluent on every platform.
Take Hit Em Up for a 7-day test flight. No credit card, no risk - just pure networking altitude. Watch your connections soar.
Plant Hit Em Up on your phone today. Watch your network blossom with every personalized message you cultivate.
Your voice shapes our future. Be sure to leave us feedback either with customer support by pressing the “Help” button or emailing us at feedback@hitemupapp.com
---
Hit Em Up is free to download and try for 7 days. We offer both a Standard and Basic membership subscriptions for various features in the following durations:
- 1 month
- 1 year
Subscription prices vary depending on the features, length, and region. All prices and plans with features are clearly displayed within the app.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the iTunes Store/iPhone Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
---
We guard your data like a dragon guards treasure. See our ironclad privacy measures on our App's Privacy Policy: https://www.hitemupapp.com/privacy
By downloading Hit Em Up and using it, you are agreeing to our Terms of Service at https://www.hitemupapp.com/terms
With Hit Em Up, every time you tap our send button, you plant seeds of connection in garden of your community. Enjoy and welcome to our family!

bluejetty:00021227:ios.name: Schlage Home
bluejetty:00021227:ios.summary: For over a century, Schlage has been trusted by millions of homes to help protect what matters most – peace of mind. The Schlage Home app lets you control and monitor your home from anywhere when your Schlage locks are paired to a home WiFi
bluejetty:00021227:ios.description:
For over a century, Schlage has been trusted by millions of homes to help protect what matters most – peace of mind. The Schlage Home app lets you control and monitor your home from anywhere when your Schlage locks are paired to a home WiFi network. Through a secure, encrypted connection, easily lock and unlock your doors with the touch of a button, conveniently manage multiple homes, schedule unique access codes for trusted users, view lock history, and pair your Schlage locks with leading smart home systems. This app works with the Schlage Encode Plus™ Smart WiFi Deadbolt, Schlage Encode™ Smart WiFi Deadbolt and Lever, Schlage Arrive™ Smart WiFi Deadbolt, and Schlage Sense® Smart Deadbolt. The Schlage Home app for Apple Watch works with the Schlage Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt and Lever, allowing users to lock/unlock and check the status of their locks from the Schlage Home app on their Apple Watch.
SCHLAGE ENCODE PLUS SMART WIFI DEADBOLT, SCHLAGE ENCODE SMART WIFI DEADBOLT AND LEVER, AND SCHLAGE ARRIVE SMART WIFI DEADBOLT
These locks feature built-in WiFi, so you don’t need to purchase additional hubs or accessories for remote access. When your lock is paired to your smartphone and connected to your home’s WiFi network, conveniently use the Schlage Home app to:
- Lock/unlock; Check your lock’s status from anywhere
- Manage up to 250 unique access codes per lock (up to 100 codes for Schlage Encode Plus)
- Schedule access codes as always-on, recurring at specific times/days, or temporary with a specific start and end date/time
- Share virtual keys for full administrative access or guest lock/unlock only access
- View lock history log 
- Customize push notifications to be alerted if specific access codes are used and when your door is locked/unlocked
- Select time delay for auto-locking
- Receive low battery advance warnings
- Set built-in alarm warnings (excluding Schlage Arrive)
- Pair with leading smart home speakers and ecosystems
SCHLAGE ENCODE PLUS SMART WIFI DEADBOLT + APPLE HOME
In addition to the features & benefits above, the Schlage Encode Plus deadbolt works with Apple Home. After creating an account with Schlage, use the Schlage Home app to pair your lock with the Apple Home app to:
- Create an Apple home key in the Wallet app for easy, secure access to your home using your iPhone or Apple Watch
- Create and manage always-on access codes in your Apple Home app
- Lock/unlock your deadbolt from your iPhone and Apple Watch
- Use Siri voice control to operate and check the status of your lock
- Make your lock part of automations or control it with the Apple Home app remotely when used with a HomePod or Apple TV set up as a home hub
SCHLAGE SENSE SMART DEADBOLT
The Schlage Sense deadbolt features Bluetooth technology, allowing you to easily use your smartphone with the Schlage Home app to, within Bluetooth range:
- Lock/unlock and check your lock’s status
- Manage up to 30 unique access codes per lock
- Schedule access codes as always-on or recurring at specific times/days
- Share virtual keys for full administrative access or guest lock/unlock only access
- View lock history log 
- Select time delay for auto-locking
- Set built-in alarm warnings based on the type of disturbance detected
You must pair with a Schlage Sense WiFi Adapter and your home WiFi network to:
- Control and monitor your lock remotely
- Pair with leading smart home speakers and ecosystems
- Receive push notifications when specific access codes are used or when your door is locked/unlocked
- Make your Schlage Sense Smart Deadbolt accessible when you are away from home with Apple Home. Remotely control and automate your lock with the Apple Home app when used with a HomePod, Apple TV or iPad set up as a home hub
The Schlage Connect Smart Deadbolt is not supported by the Schlage Home app. Visit Schlage’s website for more information on compatible home hubs and apps for the Schlage Connect Smart Deadbolt. 
Works best in iPhone 11 or newer.

Prepare-se para a prova do DETRAN com o "Simulado CNH: Prova 2026", o aplicativo completo para quem deseja obter sua carteira de habilitação! Se você está se preparando para a CNH de Carro, Moto, Caminhão, Ônibus, entre outros, nosso app é a escolha certa para te ajudar na sua aprovação.

Principais Funcionalidades:
- Simulado Geral: Teste seus conhecimentos com mais de 700 questões atualizadas.
- Placas de Trânsito: Identifique e memorize as principais placas.
- Primeiros Socorros: Saiba como agir em situações de emergência.
- Legislação de Trânsito: Fique por dentro das leis e normas de trânsito.
- Mecânica Básica: Entenda o funcionamento básico dos veículos.
- Direção Defensiva: Aprenda técnicas para dirigir de forma segura.
- Meio Ambiente: Conheça as práticas sustentáveis no trânsito.
- Modo Escuro: Facilite a leitura e poupe seus olhos durante o estudo.
- Histórico de Simulados: Acompanhe seu progresso com a tela de histórico dos últimos simulados realizados.

Baixe agora o Simulado Prova CNH e esteja preparado para conquistar sua CNH de forma rápida e eficiente. Com uma interface amigável e funcionalidades completas, nosso aplicativo é o parceiro ideal na sua jornada para se tornar um motorista habilitado.

Baixe já e comece a praticar!

Este aplicativo não representa nenhuma entidade governamental.

bluejetty:00157679:ios.summary:

Effortless Photo Management
Say goodbye to duplicate and similar images that clog up your photo library. TidyMe-Clean’s advanc
bluejetty:00157679:ios.description:
Are you tired of cluttered photo albums,bloated video files,and a lack of storage space on your iOS device?
Effortless Photo Management
Say goodbye to duplicate and similar images that clog up your photo library. TidyMe-Clean’s advanced algorithm swiftly identifies and deletes these redundant pictures,ensuring that your photo album remains a treasure trove of unique memories,not a dumping ground for duplicates.
Smart Screenshot Cleanup
We all have those temporary screenshots that we took a quick glance at and forgot to delete. TidyMe-Clean can automatically detect and filter out screenshot files from your photo library. You can then view these screenshots and select the ones you want to delete. This way,you can declutter your photo library and free up precious storage space with full control over what stays and what goes.
Video Optimization
Your precious moments captured in videos shouldn’t be a burden on your device’s storage. TidyMe-Clean allows you to easily filter through your video files,view their sizes,and choose to compress them for reduced file size or delete them if they’re no longer needed. This way,you can keep your favorite memories while maintaining ample storage space for new adventures.
Personalized Aesthetics
Transform your device’s appearance with TidyMe-Clean’s exquisite wallpaper library. Download stunning wallpapers directly to your photo album and set them as your background,giving your iOS device a fresh and personalized look that reflects your unique style.
Customizable Charging Animations
Utilize iOS Shortcuts to set these captivating animations as your custom charging screens,adding a touch of flair and personalization whenever you plug in your device.
Why Choose TidyMe-Clean?
• Efficiency:TidyMe-Clean is designed to quickly identify and manage unnecessary files,saving you time and effort in maintaining a clutter-free device.
• User-Friendly:With its intuitive interface,even novice users can easily navigate through TidyMe-Clean’s features and enjoy a seamless cleaning and customization experience.
• Privacy:Your data remains secure and private as TidyMe-Clean focuses solely on helping you manage your device’s storage and appearance without compromising your personal information.
TidyMe-Clean is more than just an app;it’s your personal assistant in maintaining a tidy,efficient,and stylish iOS device. Download TidyMe-Clean today and experience the joy of a clutter-free and personalized digital space!

bluejetty:00162274:ios.description:
يوفَّر تطبيق ‘‘كتبي’’ تجربة فريدة للأطفال للاستمتاع بقراءة مئات القصص المصوَّرة باللغتين العربيَّة والإنكليزيَّة، والمنتقاة بعناية من قبل تربويِّين مختصِّين.
بينما صار إبعاد أطفالنا عن استخدام وسائل التكنولوجيا عمليَّة شبه مستحيلة في عالم اليوم، جاء تطبيق ‘‘كتبي’’ ليوفِّر للأهل والأطفال معًا وسيلةً تتحوَّل فيها التكنولوجيا من وسيلة إلهاء وتسلية، إلى وسيلة بناء وتعليم تحفِّز أبناءنا على القراءة والتعلُّم بطريقة ممتعة وتفاعليَّة.
جرى تطوير تطبيق ‘‘كتبي’’ ليُستخدم أيضًا في إطار المدرسة والصفّ، حيث عمل فريقٌ من التربويِّين على تصنيف الكتب بحسب أسس التعليم الحديثة، ووفق نظام ‘‘PYP’’، علاوة على إمكانية ربطه باللوح الذكي ليستخدمَه المعلِّمون في نطاق الغرفة الصفِّيَّة.
ميزات كتبي:
* أكبر مكتبة رقمية تفاعلية باللغتين العربية والانكليزية.
* تصنيف الكتب اعتمادًا على نظام PYP ونظام المكتبات.
* أكثر من 1200 قصة منتقاة من أشهر دور النشر.
* سهولة البحث بحسب الموضوع أو الفئة العمرية.

bluejetty:00160777:ios.name: Rem: Auto Sleep Tracker Watch
bluejetty:00160777:ios.summary: Unlock the secrets of a good night's sleep with Rem, the smart autosleep tracker. With its advanced AI-Machine Learning technology, Rem provides an in-depth analysis of your sleep patterns and helps you understand the impact of your habits
bluejetty:00160777:ios.description:
Unlock the secrets of a good night's sleep with Rem, the smart autosleep tracker. With its advanced AI-Machine Learning technology, Rem provides an in-depth analysis of your sleep patterns and helps you understand the impact of your habits and routines on your sleep quality. Get ready to say goodbye to restless nights and hello to sweet dreams with Rem.
 = Key Features =
— Completely Automatic and Easy to use
— Sleep Pattern Diagram (Rem stage included)
— Snore Detection
— Sleep Score
— Score Breakdown
— Heart Rate Analysis (Dip and Detail Diagram)
— Sleep Regularity
— Time to Sleep
— Trends
— Nap Detection
— Sleep History
— Sleep Assessment
— Smart Alarm Clock
— Low Battery Usage
— Compatible with All Available Apple Watch Versions
=============
HOW REM WORKS:
• All you need to do is wear your Apple Watch to bed.
• An iwatch sleep tracker, facilitates the AI-Machine Learning algorithm to analyze sleep cycle.
• Moving more or less than others, Rem adjusts automatically to your personal data
• We ignore sleep sessions that are less than 1 hour.
To enable snore detection:
1. Connect your iPhone to a power source
2. Tap the "Start Tracking" button
3. Optionally, set a gentle alarm to wake you up.
— EASY TO USE —
Just wear your Apple watch before bedtime and check your sleep log after you wake up. Your shut eye report is displayed in a clear and understandable way.
— SLEEP PATTERN DIAGRAM —
Understand your sleep cycles with simple graphs. Discover how to get the restful and restorative sleep you deserve! You can find out the exact times you’ve been disrupted, as well as easily learn the total amount of deep, light, and REM phases.
— SNORE Detection —
You can identify if snoring is affecting your sleep quality and take necessary actions to improve it. Rem is also equipped with environment sound detection, so you can monitor the ambient noise levels and make adjustments for a more comfortable sleeping environment.
— SLEEP SCORE —
Your Sleep Score is displayed clearly with a number 0-100 which is an accurate interpretation of your rest quality.
— SCORE BREAKDOWN —
REM App highlights the most relevant data of your sleep:
• Time Asleep
• Sleep Details » The total minutes of your deep and REM phases, the most restorative phase of your sleep
• Heart Rate » Your heart rate analysis is key for measuring your shut eye quality. You can view your sleeping heart rate graph, your average sleeping heart rate, and the dip percentage of your heart rate during sleep
• Disruption
• Regularity » REM app records your sleep rhythm automatically and will demonstrate your sleep consistency in a user-friendly diagram.
• Time To Sleep
• Respiratory Rate » The number of times you breathe in a minute during sleep
• Blood Oxygen » The level of blood oxygen during sleep
— TRENDS —
Follow the impact of your routines on your sleep quality with help of trend diagrams.
— SLEEP HISTORY —
Monitor your previous sleep diagrams and compare them to your latest data.
— NAP DETECTION —
REM is an auto nap tracker and will show the nap sessions in a separate field.
— SLEEP ASSESSMENT —
Learn more about healthy sleep practices by taking the assessment and set yourself up for better sleep.
— SMART ALARM —
Wake up refreshed and ready for the day. Our smart alarm clock gently eases you out of deep sleep. To use this feature, watchOS 6 or higher is required.
— LOW BATTERY USAGE —
Don’t worry about draining your battery because it’s low battery usage, even less than your usual usage of Watch.
Charge your watch during the day or before sleep. Make sure it has at least a %30 charge.
Rem is for anybody who struggles with insomnia or sleep apnea. With the power of its sleep tracking algorithm, you can find accurate and valuable insight about your sleep. Set the smart alarm before bed time and rise refreshed and on-time. It’s a simple-to-use sleep recorder, no need to put it under your pillow.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://bettersleeapapp.com/rem/terms.html

Key Features
• Magnetic Field Detection: Uses your iPhone’s magnetometer to find electronic devices and hidden metal objects.
• Infrared Glint Finder: A specialized camera filter to help you spot the reflective lenses of hidden pinhole cameras.

• Privacy Safety Guide: Expert tips on where to check for hidden devices in hotels, bathrooms, and changing rooms.
• Bluetooth Scanner: Detect nearby low-energy Bluetooth (BLE) signals from unauthorized tracking devices.

Designed for travelers and privacy-conscious users, our interface is intuitive and provides real-time feedback. Note: This app is a helpful tool but does not replace professional security equipment.

bluejetty:00122535:ios.description:
Experience full multichain control with the leading self-custody crypto wallet.
BitPay Wallet lets you manage Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USDT, memecoins and thousands of tokens across top blockchains, networks, and layer 2s all in one app. Whether you’re buying crypto, swapping tokens, exploring dApps, or building your portfolio, BitPay puts you in full control of your digital assets.
BitPay is now fully integrated with the Solana network. Enjoy the perks of Solana blockchain technology in the BitPay Wallet as you buy, store, swap, sell, and pay with SOL and SPL tokens.
Join millions who trust BitPay to power their crypto journey.
BITPAY APP FEATURES:
STORE AND MANAGE ACROSS CHAINS WITH SELF-CUSTODY
- With BitPay, your assets stay on your device and under your control. 
- BitPay never holds or controls your assets. Send and receive crypto across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Litecoin, and more. 
- Import wallets from apps like MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Phantom, Exodus, Blockchain.com, and others.
MULTICHAIN WALLET WITH THOUSANDS OF TOKENS SUPPORTED
- Manage a diversified crypto portfolio in one place. 
- BitPay supports leading tokens including BTC, ETH, LTC, XRP, POL, SHIB, BCH, DAI, PYUSD, USDC, Solana, and USDT, along with thousands of ERC-20 tokens and memecoins. 
- Handle stablecoins, L2 assets, and custom tokens with ease.
BUY BITCOIN AND CRYPTO IN MINUTES
- Buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Doge, SOL and other top cryptos quickly and at great rates. 
- BitPay finds competitive offers from trusted providers so you don’t have to.
- Pay with Apple Pay, PayPal, credit or debit cards, Venmo, CashApp, or your bank account.
EASY FOR BEGINNERS, POWERFUL FOR PROS
- Start with a Bitcoin wallet, then unlock advanced tools like Ethereum wallets (EVM accounts), multi-signature security, custom token support, and cross-chain portfolio management.
SPEND CRYPTO LIKE CASH
- Use crypto for everyday purchases in just a few taps. 
- Shop with BitPay-enabled merchants or buy gift cards from over 250 top retailers all from your wallet. 
- Pay bills like credit cards, car loans, and student loans (US only).
SWAP, EXCHANGE, AND TRADE CRYPTO
- Swap thousands of tokens across supported networks with competitive rates and smooth conversions.
SELL CRYPTO AND CONVERT TO CASH
- Sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and other coins directly from your wallet and withdraw to your bank, debit card, or PayPal account. Converting crypto to cash is quick and seamless.
CONNECT TO WEB3 AND DAPPS
- Explore Web3 and connect to decentralized applications. 
- Connect to your favorite dApps, NFT platforms, and DeFi protocols using WalletConnect.
OPEN SOURCE AND PRIVACY-FIRST
- BitPay Wallet is fully open source, allowing anyone to inspect or contribute to the code. 
- No email signup is required. Your wallet, your data, your control.
Download the BitPay crypto wallet today and join millions who choose self-custody, multichain access, and full crypto freedom.
Privacy: https://www.bitpay.com/about/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.bitpay.com/legal/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00043327:ios.description:
How to learn or improve Spanish?
Wannalisn is a free app to learn Spanish that helps you train your listening and pronunciation skills with listening activities and mini video clips from popular movies, series, and songs.
Wannalisn is also the best Spanish learning app to learn the most used Spanish words, idioms, and proverbs.
Become an effective listener
Our entertaining learning method will allow you to understand the fast natural Spanish of native speakers and learn how to speak Spanish fluently. 
With Wannalisn you can now learn real Spanish online and understand Spanish, Mexican, Argentinian accents from a wide range of real-life contexts including business Spanish. 
How to speak Spanish well and fast
Wannalisn's approach helps you to learn Spanish fast and is based on the ‘edutainment’ concept coined by Walt Disney. 
The combination of education and entertainment go hand in hand to make your learning experience painless and, at the same time, mentally challenging. 
With Wannalisn you will learn Spanish quickly and effortlessly! 
How can I improve my listening skills in Spanish?
Wannalisn focuses on the 50 most used words in Spanish that make up 50% of spoken Spanish. These word combinations tend to be pronounced very quickly by native Spanish speakers and are very difficult to decode. 
With the listening lessons and exercises in this incredible app, you can improve your listening skills and immerse yourself in the world of clusters.
Learn Spanish through movies
Do you still watch movies with subtitles? With Wannalisn you won’t need them anymore because real life doesn’t have subtitles. 
Learn to speak natural Spanish by learning the most common phrases and expressions while enjoying a 100% audiovisual experience.
Create emotional connections with favorite scenes and actors. Hear how things are said in the real world and learn all the tips to learn effective Spanish communication and listening skills. 
Learn Spanish by listening and you’ll never forget the most common Spanish words and expressions used in daily life. 
Wannalisn is easy, fun, simple, and fast. 
Learn Spanish now for free with our great new app.
Developer: Wannalisn SL
Website: www.wannalisn.com
Contact: dev@wannalisn.com

CaloPal - AI Partner in Calorie Counter and Nutrition Tracking
Start your health journey with CaloPal, the innovative health app that makes tracking calories and managing nutrition a breeze. Whether you're aiming for weight loss, maintaining a balanced diet, or managing chronic diseases, CaloPal is your dedicated partner to achieving your health goals with precision and ease.
Why Choose CaloPal?
Leverage advanced AI technology with CaloPal that transforms how you monitor your diet by recognizing food calorie content and nutrients through simple photos. Say goodbye to tedious manual input and embrace an intuitive approach to calorie counting and diet tracking.
User Benefits:
• Effortless Calorie Tracking: Capture a photo of your meal and let CaloPal handle the rest. Our advanced Calorie AI instantly identifies the food, calculates calories and key nutrients, and provides you with an immediate, detailed nutritional profile, acting as your expert calorie counter.
• Tailored for Your Success: Unlock personalized health programs tailored just for you. Whether embarking on a fasting journey, seeking a balanced diet plan, or ready to embrace gentle carb cycling, CaloPal offers comprehensive guidance and support, enabling users to cultivate lifelong healthy habits and sustainable, self-determined lifestyles.
• Upcoming Fitness Data Integration: In the next version, CaloPal will also sync with fitness apps to provide a comprehensive view of your diet and workout, ensuring accurate tracking of calorie consumption.
Core Features:
• Customized health plans to suit your personal goals.
• Accurate calorie and nutrient analysis by simply snapping a photo.
• AI-driven food calorie tracker for convenient and precise monitoring of your daily calorie, carb, protein, and fat intake.
• Personal calorie calculator to determine optimal calorie intake and manage your calorie deficit.
• Tailored weight loss tracker to visualize progress and maintain motivation.
How to Use CaloPal for calorie tracker and weight loss:
1. Answer a few simple questions to customize your plan.
2. Capture a photo of your meal.
3. Let AI quickly analyze the calories and nutritional content.
4. Track daily calorie intake effortlessly, managing your calorie deficit with ease.
Subscription Options:
CaloPal provides complimentary basic features to users starting their health journey. For a more enriched experience that includes exclusive diet plans and AI insights, consider upgrading to our premium subscription. Enjoy seamless support with automatic renewals, all manageable through your account settings.
Redefine your diet management today with CaloPal. Download now and confidently step towards a healthier, happier you, revolutionizing calorie tracking and nutrition management along the way.
NOTE:
We do not provide medical advice. All recommendations are for informational purposes only and should be considered as suggestions. Before starting any new calorie or nutrient plan, consult with a healthcare professional and conduct your own research.

bluejetty:00120629:ios.name: Sweet Home: Games for kids 3-7
bluejetty:00120629:ios.summary: Wake up and get ready! There are lots of things to do in Sweet Home Stories! A fun and safe educational doll house game for kids, about daily life in a household, where everyone is welcomed and the only rule is to use your imagination to cr
bluejetty:00120629:ios.description:
Wake up and get ready! There are lots of things to do in Sweet Home Stories! A fun and safe educational doll house game for kids, about daily life in a household, where everyone is welcomed and the only rule is to use your imagination to create amazing stories.
On this cozy house, you are in charge of everything: hanging laundry, mopping floors, or making breakfast with this adorable family. With 7 different rooms, including dozens of different activities and hundreds of items available to explore and play, there's no time to be bored.
Designed for children aged 2-8, Sweet Home Stories will foster their imagination and creativity while learning and reinforcing daily routines and improving their language skills through story creation.
CREATE YOUR OWN FAMILY STORIES!
Join a family of 6 lovely characters in their day to day life and create your own home stories. Play, explore and have fun doing funny chores in this cozy house: Make tasty meals, diaper the little baby, dress the kids, brush their teeth in the morning, or read to them before sleeping at night.
DISCOVER AND PLAY FREELY!
There is a whole new adventure every time you play. With tons of toys, different equipment and thousands of possible interactions in 7 different rooms, full of surprises and chores to do. Remember, there are no rules, so don't be afraid to interact with everything you see!
REINFORCE DAILY ROUTINES
Parents can play Sweet Home Stories together with kids, to have some fun and healthy laughter with them or helping them to learn new routines and vocabulary. Do you want to encourage them to tidy up their rooms? Suggest them to it in the game, and then apply it to their daily life. Brushing their teeth every day? Remind them to it in the game when the characters wake up. While playing, kids can learn basic home rules and explore daily routines without noticing.
KEY FEATURES:
+ 7 rooms, representing different areas of a household: A living room, a kitchen, the children's room, the parents' room, a bathroom, the front yard and the backyard.
+ Every room is filled with items you'd expect to find in a real house.
+ A happy family with 6 different characters: A mom, a dad, two kids, a little baby, and their lovely cat.
+ Hundreds of items available for explore and play.
+ Dozens every day chores: Preparing meals, putting kids to sleep, clothing, growing veggies in the garden, possibilities are truly unlimited.
+ Without rules and goals, just fun to create your own stories.
+ Set the time of the day at any moment to represent different routines, from waking up to bedtime.
+ Kid safe environment for children aged 2 to 8, no third-party ads, pay once play forever.
Specifically designed to be played by children from 2 years of age, but detailed enough to captivate and amuse children up to 8 years. Sweet Home Stories will foster their imagination and creativity and will keep them fascinated for hours for less than the price of a cup of coffee.
The free trial includes 3 rooms so you can test the endless possibilities of this game. Once you are sure, you can buy the full version through a single purchase within the application, which will unlock the 7 rooms forever.
About PlayToddlers
PlayToddlers’ games encompass different areas of toddler’s personal growth and have been specifically designed to be used by babies and kids, with a simple and attractive interface that allows them to use the application by themselves, improving their development and self-esteem.

bluejetty:00179820:ios.description:
BahnBonus App: Punkte, Prämien, Vorteile.
Mit der BahnBonus App können Sie bequem am Vorteilsprogramm der Bahn teilnehmen. Gleichzeitig haben Sie Ihren BahnBonus Punktestand und Ihre Statusvorteile immer im Blick und werden über das Verfallsdatum (Ihrer Status- und Prämienpunkte) Ihrer Punkte rechtzeitig informiert.
Stöbern Sie jederzeit von unterwegs durch unsere vielseitigen Vorteile, Prämien und Partner. Außerdem können Sie mit der App bequem und einfach Ihre gesammelten Prämienpunkte gegen attraktive Sachprämien einlösen oder eine soziale Einrichtung, wie die Bahnhofsmission, unterstützen. Sie erhalten regelmäßig Informationen rund um exklusive Prämien- und Ticketaktionen sowie spannende Vorteilsaktionen unserer Partner.
Und ganz exklusiv: nur über die BahnBonus App können alle Statusvorteile genutzt werden. Das Statuslevel Silber kann bereits ab 1.500 Statuspunkten erreicht werden. Als Statuskunde können Sie Ihre Vorteile über die App einlösen und erhalten so zum Beispiel Freigetränke im Zug, Zugänge zu den DB Lounges und Freiminuten bei Call a Bike.
Mit der digitalen Karte haben Sie zudem auch Ihre BahnBonus Nummer immer griffbereit zum Sammeln bei jeder Fahrt und vielen Partnern sowie als Statusnachweis.
Nach Download einfach loslegen. Der Login in die App funktioniert mit Ihrem bahn.de Account, Sie benötigen keinen neuen Zugang.
Ihre Vorteile auf einen Blick:
- Immer und überall den aktuellen Prämien- und Statuspunktestand einsehen
- Bequem und einfach Punkte gegen attraktive Prämien eintauschen
- Jederzeit über exklusive Prämien- und Ticketaktionen oder Vorteile bei Partnern informiert
- Als Statuskunde auf Vorteile zugreifen und diese direkt einlösen
- Mit der digitalen Karte ist die BahnBonus Nummer immer griffbereit - und zugleich auch Ihr Statusnachweis

bluejetty:00124009:ios.description:
Following the epic storylines of Jurassic Park, The Lost World: Jurassic Park and Jurassic Park III, as well as the global smash hit Jurassic World, LEGO Jurassic World™ is the first videogame where you can relive and experience all four colossal films. Reimagined in LEGO form and told in TT Games’ signature classic LEGO humor, this thrilling adventure recreates unforgettable scenes and action sequences from the films, allowing fans worldwide to play through key moments and giving them the opportunity to fully explore the expansive grounds of Isla Nublar and Isla Sorna.
FEATURES
-Relive key moments from all four Jurassic films: An adventure 65 million years in the making - now in classic LEGO brick fun!
-Wreak havoc as LEGO dinosaurs: Choose from 16 dinosaurs, including the friendly Triceratops, deadly Raptor, vicious Compy and even the mighty T. rex.
-Customize your own dinosaur collection: Collect LEGO amber and experiment with DNA to create completely original dinosaurs, like the Dilophosaurus rex.
-Populate and explore Isla Nublar and Isla Sorna: Put your unique dinosaur creations in to paddocks as you complete special Free Play missions.

bluejetty:00170752:ios.description:
Do you often find your iPhone running out of storage?
AI Cleaner offers AI-powered cleaning unlike any other. With powerful cleaning functions, it helps you optimize your phone's performance by removing unnecessary files.
→ Reclaim space and enjoy a faster, more efficient device with optimized performance.
■ KEY FEATURES
» AI Smart Storage Cleaner
» Remove Duplicate Photos & Videos
» Swipe to Clean Your Gallery
» Clean Email Inbox & Unsubscribe
» Compress Photos & Videos
» Protect Private Files
» Contact Cleanup
» Event Remover
SMART STORAGE CLEANER
Experience the power of AI with AI Cleaner, designed to deliver the quickest and most effective cleanup for your iPhone.
If you want a thorough clean, our comprehensive cleaning feature uses all the app functions simultaneously, ensuring maximum storage recovery in minimal time.
DELETE DUPLICATE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
AI Cleaner app scans your gallery for duplicate photos and videos, allowing you to delete them with a single tap. Free up space without losing your memories.
SWIPE TO KEEP OR DELETE
Scroll through your photos and videos one by one, and decide what to keep or delete with a simple swipe. Swipe right to keep and left to delete — it’s that easy, and you have all the control. Clean the clutter in your gallery, free up space, and keep only the memories that matter.
EMAIL CLEANER
Keep your inbox tidy and organized by removing unwanted emails and unsubscribing from spam and telemarketing lists.
COMPRESS PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Regain precious space on your phone with just a few clicks by compressing your photos and videos! Select from a variety of compression levels—high, medium, or low—to suit your storage preferences and free up space seamlessly.
PROTECT PRIVATE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Effortlessly safeguard your memories and sensitive information by protecting and concealing your photos, videos, and contacts within a private storage space, ensuring an extra layer of security and privacy. Relax, knowing your memories are secured from unwanted access.
CONTACT CLEANUP
Forget about incomplete and duplicate contacts cluttering your address book. AI Cleaner identifies and helps you clean up your contact list to keep it organized and relevant.
REMOVE PAST EVENTS
Is your calendar crowded with obsolete past events? AI Cleaner quickly detects and removes old events, freeing up space on your schedule.
■ EFFORTLESS STORAGE MANAGEMENT
» Easy to use: With our intuitive interface, you can easily free up space manually or with AI assistance.
» AI-Powered cleaning: AI Cleaner efficiently scans your device to identify duplicate and unwanted items.
» Data security: Your personal data is safe with us. AI Cleaner does not store your personal information.
» Performance optimization: Improve your iPhone's speed and responsiveness with AI Cleaner app. Our advanced AI technology frees up gigabytes of storage in seconds.
» Regular updates: We keep AI Cleaner up to date with the latest improvements and features to ensure the best experience.
■ CONTACT:

info@aicleaner.app

*Connect wit
bluejetty:00186806:ios.description:
Level up your entire college experience with CircleIn by connecting with classmates, managing your work-life balance, having fun while studying, earning points and thriving with the study motivation and tools to do your best! 
*Connect with classmates beyond the classroom with class channels, video and chats
We partner with your school to bring all your classes and classmates onto one platform so you can reach everyone from anywhere for the support and study help you need.
• Join class chats, DM study buddies or hop on a video call for a group study session any time, anywhere
• Collaborate on group projects and create group chats to sync up
*Have fun and earn rewards while you study & learn
Have a ton of concepts, formulas, or vocabulary to memorize but snoozing on your textbooks? It’s time to have FUN while studying and training your brain! 
• Create flashcards, quiz yourself and play a matching game to ace your quizzes and exams
• Earn points for studying and helping out your classmates
• Meet study goals to reach your greatest potential
• Learn anytime and anywhere
• Study on-the-go!
*Get your busy life organized with our task management tools•
Never miss a deadline again. Access all of your notes, flashcards, study materials, and group study sessions on CircleIn while getting real answers from your peers. With CircleIn, you never have to study alone, skip a lecture, or bomb an exam.
• Organize all of your tasks, schoolwork and projects Take and share notes, and post resources, and flashcards with classmates on a class feed
• Access all the tools you need to balance your thriving college life for all of your assigned courses
*Check out what students are saying about CircleIn:
“CircleIn has truly made my first year of college as an honor student and a psych major much easier and more successful! I look forward to continuing using the app for studying purposes as it has proven to be a game-changer.” - Psych major, Class of 2024
“My favourite feature on CircleIn is the flashcards! It is so handy to be able to make them super quick and then have them right there on my phone. That way I’m able to study them wherever I am, even if I only have a few minutes.”Engineering major, Class of 2023
*Advice from current college students on CircleIn:
“Use the video call function that's provided in CircleIn to form study groups in each of your classes!”
“Make flashcards for the best and most simple active recall strategy”
“Don't be afraid to ask a question about the current topics you are learning”
Missed a lecture? Not the best at studying? Forgot the answer to a question? CircleIn provides you with a community of your classmates in one app available for free help at any time, anywhere.

bluejetty:00174572:ios.summary:
Using Your Smartphone For The Track Is Easier Than Ever!
• Road Course, Autocross, Rally, Drift, 4x4, and Drag Racing
• Race Timing + Data Logging + Analysis + Video
• Works Almost Anywhere! 1000+ Predefined Circuits, or Add Your Own
• GP
bluejetty:00174572:ios.description:
Using Your Smartphone For The Track Is Easier Than Ever!
• Road Course, Autocross, Rally, Drift, 4x4, and Drag Racing
• Race Timing + Data Logging + Analysis + Video
• Works Almost Anywhere! 1000+ Predefined Circuits, or Add Your Own
• GPS Lap Timer & Display with Predictive Timing (Circuit mode)
• Sector Split Timing & Theoretical Lap Time (Circuit mode)
• High-Definition Video Recording + Data Overlay
• Lap, GPS, G-Force, and OBD-II Data Logging
• Driving Line Analysis, Statistics, Data Graphs, and Run / Lap Comparison
• Optional Live Telemetry Streaming via Live.RaceRender.com (requires Pro upgrade)
• Also Supports External GPS and OBD-II Devices
• OBD-II Live Monitor, Code Scanning / Reset, and Data Logging
• Easily Exports Data and Video to RaceRender
TrackAddict, by HP Tuners, transforms your iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod touch® into a motorsports telemetry and video system. See your lap times instantly, capture video and telemetry data, compare circuit laps side-by-side, impress your friends with video+data overlays, and more! Quick and easy setup.
Free Edition provides most of the features at no cost, but is limited to storing three recordings, does not include live telemetry, and adds a logo to videos.
Pro Edition removes those limitations and gives you every feature currently available from this app. It is available either as a low-cost in-app purchase, or as a separate app.
Advisories and Disclaimers:
Always drive safely. Intended for responsible use in a motorsports environment. Use at your own risk.
Works on iPhone and compatible GPS-enabled iPad, iPad mini, and iPod touch devices. Devices which do not contain suitable GPS hardware may work when combined with a compatible external GPS device. Performance depends on good GPS reception conditions, and may vary. Features, capabilities, and pricing may differ between platforms and are subject to change at any time.
OBD functionality is optional, and would require a supported OBD-II interface device and a compatible OBD-II compliant vehicle. See website for details.
Features and capabilities can vary depending on your device and other circumstances.
Use of Live Streaming feature is optional and requires a premium upgrade. Services are provided as-is, and are subject to change or discontinuation at any time. This functionality does have privacy implications. Please see this app's online documentation and http://Live.RaceRender.com before enabling its use. Use of Live Streaming service requires an Internet connection, and is therefore subject to your wireless carrier and/or Internet provider's data rates.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00135606:ios.description:
Water Sort - A Refreshing and Addictive color sort puzzle Game! Are you ready for a unique and meditative gaming experience that will put your problem-solving skills to the test? Look no further than Water Sort! This exciting sort puzzle game challenges your logical thinking and brings a refreshing twist to your gaming routine. 
In Water Sort, each tube contains a mixture of different colored water. Your task is to separate and sort the colored waters in every tube. It's up to you to carefully pour and rearrange the water so that it ends up being the same color in each tube. Sounds simple? Think again! 
With hundreds of mind-bending levels, Water Sort will keep you engaged for hours on end. As you progress through the game, the complexity increases, presenting you with new color combinations and additional tubes to sort. You'll need to plan your pouring strategy meticulously, considering the consequences of each move, to successfully complete each level. 
The soothing soundscapes in Water Sort create a calming and immersive atmosphere, allowing you to truly relax while tackling the intricate puzzles. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or stimulate your brain during a break, Water Sort offers the perfect balance of challenge and tranquility. 
Not only is Water Sort incredibly addictive, but it's also a great game to share with friends and family! Challenge them to beat your high score or work together to solve the trickiest puzzles. With its easy-to-learn gameplay and appealing visuals, Water Sort is suitable for players of all ages. 
Download Water Sort now and dive into an immersive and refreshing gaming experience. Can you conquer all the levels and become the ultimate Water Sort master? Find out today!
Please feel free to send us your valuable feedback and suggestions. Our email address: feedback@kiwifungames.com

bluejetty:00036099:ios.description:
Stop guessing your workout. Start seeing results. 
Whether you’re at home or in the gym, Planfit’s personalized workout plan helps you exercise smarter, achieve your fitness goals, and stay consistent!
"I've seen more progress in three weeks using Planfit at the gym than I did in three months trying to do it alone. It's like having my own ai workout planner"
Are you tired of showing up to the gym and wondering, "What should I do today?" You know your way around the machines, but your progress has plateaued. You’re not a complete gym beginner, but you're not a pro bodybuilder either. You just want a gym workout plan that actually works for your body and your schedule.
Meet Planfit, your personal AI gym workout planner designed to take the cognitive load off your training. Powered by 80 million+ gym workout data points, our AI planner creates a personalized workout plan tailored to your strength, goals, and even the equipment available at your gym.
Free features for a lifetime:
■ Personal fitness trainer & planner with the right reps & weights for your goals
■ Machine / Equipment Guide
■ Workout log & tracker
■ Fitness community 
Premium features with a 7-day free trial:
■ Real-time AI Coach (countdown reps, rest times, and detailed workout guides)
■ Muscle Recovery Tracking & Analysis
■ Exercise Performance Tracking & Analysis
■ Apple watch Integration
◆ The Smartest AI Gym Planner
- Personalized Gym Workout Planner: No more random exercises. Get a structured workout plan for weight loss or muscle gain that adapts to your schedule and progress, powered by AI
- Optimized Sets & Reps: Our AI calculates the precise weight and repetitions you need to push past plateaus safely.
- Long-term workout plan: Don't just train for today. Planfit AI provides a long term plan so you can visualize your growth.
◆ Seamless Gym Experience
- Get alternative plan: Is a machine busy? Don't break your plan by yourself. Our AI workout planner suggests the best alternative exercise instantly.
- Intuitive Workout Planner & Tracker: Log your sets with a single tap. We focus on "Hands-free" efficiency powered by AI planner, so you can focus on the lift.
- Rest Time Control: Automated timers based on your workout intensity to maximize recovery and efficiency. And AI adapts to your tempo.
◆ Your Personal Fitness Trainer in Your Pocket
- Form Guidance: 1,100+ exercise videos to ensure your form is spot-on, reducing injury risk. 
- Muscle Recovery Tracking: See which muscles are ready to go and which need more rest with personalized plan at the gym.
- Apple Watch Integration: Track your workout seamlessly from your wrist.
We require access to the following:
- HealthKit : Sync your Planfit Data with Apple Health
- Camera and Photo 
Planfit offers both a free version and a subscription version with premium features. 
- You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. 
- Upon confirmation of purchase or end of free trial, payments will be charged to your Apple account. 
- Free trials are provided only once per Apple account. 
- You can cancel your subscription up to 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. If you cancel, your subscription will automatically be discontinued after the end of your subscription.
 - After purchase, manage subscriptions at 'Settings - Apple ID - Subscriptions'. 
- For minors, we confirm that the legal guardian/parental consent to the subscription and payment has been obtained by purchasing a subscription.

Lumora is your personal AI beauty studio. Take one selfie and unlock a full Beauty DNA Report — your skin score, hair match, makeup palette, and style persona — backed by AI analysis you can actually act on.

Five nostalgic looks, processed entirely on your device:

• Y2K — saturated cool tone, fine grain, slight chromatic edge
• Sugar — high-key brightness with airy soft focus
• Aqua — cool blue tint with sparkle highlights
• Retro — sepia warmth with heavy grain and vignette
One Light-tier charge, unlimited variant exports per session. Save to Photos, share to LINE, Instagram Stories, TikTok, and more.
[ BEAUTY DNA — Your Personal AI Report ]
• Skin Intelligence — hydration, elasticity, pigmentation, pores, brightness scored 0–100
• Hair Match — face-shape-aware best styles plus 30+ recommended colors
• Makeup Palette — tone-aware lip, eye, and blush picks
• Style Persona — silhouette and outfit recommendations matched to your features
• Personal Color Diagnosis — Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter classification (Yebe / Bulbe sub-typed)
• PDF Export — share a full 5-page A4 beauty report
[ JP-DESIGNED PHOTO MODES ]
• Recruit Photo — polish your photo for application use, exported in 履歴書 standard sizes (30×40mm + 24×30mm + 600×800)
• Matching Photo — natural-glow preset with 3 aspect crops (Pairs 1:1, Tapple 4:5, with 3:4)
Photo enhancement is always identity-preserving. Recruit Photo is for application use — not a hiring or ATS claim.
[ 7 AI PHOTO TRANSFORMATIONS ]
• Age Transform — see yourself at any age, 10 to 70
• Gender Swap — AI-reconstructed facial geometry
• Cartoon Style — anime, illustration, cartoon variants
• Photo Restore — bring old or damaged photos back to HD
• Virtual Outfit Try-On — preview any outfit before you buy
• Smile Generator — turn a neutral photo into a warm, natural smile
• Beauty Filter — auto-tuned skin, eye, and makeup retouching
[ SHARE TO LINE · INSTAGRAM · TIKTOK · MORE ]
LINE story canvas (1080×1920) is built into every share sheet — perfect for LINE VOOM and one-tap chat sharing. Instagram Stories deep-link, TikTok-ready exports, and a branded card with the Lumora wordmark on every share.
[ BEAUTYCOIN ECONOMY ]
Earn daily login coins, complete missions, and unlock premium AI features. New users get a generous welcome bonus. Pro subscribers skip every coin gate.
[ SUBSCRIPTION TIERS ]
• Free — daily coins, light AI access
• Weekly — 3-day free trial, then auto-renew
• Monthly — more daily coins, ad-free, standard AI
• Yearly (best value) — top daily coins, all premium AI, all features unlocked
[ PRIVACY & SECURITY ]
Photos are processed on encrypted servers and never used for advertising or AI training. The Y2K Filter Pack runs entirely on-device — no upload. Sign in securely with Apple ID.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel anytime via Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

bluejetty:00161072:ios.name: Cubbily Shared Family Calendar
bluejetty:00161072:ios.summary: Cubbily is the shared family calendar that keeps every family schedule in one place. With an easy-to-read family calendar, color-coded events, and a shift calendar built for complex work schedules, busy parents, couples, and shift-worker fa
bluejetty:00161072:ios.description:
Cubbily is the shared family calendar that keeps every family schedule in one place. With an easy-to-read family calendar, color-coded events, and a shift calendar built for complex work schedules, busy parents, couples, and shift-worker families always know who needs to be where, and when.
Beyond the shared family calendar, Cubbily helps you manage everyday life with a shared grocery list, family to-dos, chores, and reminders—all synced across devices. See family schedules, work schedules, kids’ activities, and home tasks together in one organized view, so your family can stay on track.
SHARED CALENDAR THAT’S EASY & CLEAR
 • See everyone’s plans at a glance with color-coded day, week, month, and task views
 • Create events in seconds with powerful repeats and reminders that reach the right people
 • Add events faster with AI—use your voice or a photo of a schedule
 • Avoid conflicts by sharing work shifts, school events, practices, and appointments in one place
 • Subscribe & sync with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and others to keep everything up to date
MADE FOR SHIFT WORK & ODD HOURS
 • Add rotating or night shifts in a few taps and view them alongside family plans
 • Perfect for firefighters, nurses, EMTs, police, and other shift workers
 • Keep your partner and kids in the loop, so everyone knows when you’re on or off
LISTS & TASKS TOGETHER
 • Shared to-dos, shopping & grocery lists, wish lists, chores, and packing lists
 • Assign items and get notified when things get done—right inside your family calendar
 • A built-in task manager so plans and tasks live in one place
“BIG DAYS” & FAMILY MILESTONES
 • Track birthdays, first day of school, move-in dates, and more with countdowns and reminders
 • Show important dates directly on the calendar so nobody misses them
“LITTLE THINGS” CARE NOTES
 • Save tiny but meaningful details (allergies, shoe sizes, favorite snacks)
 • Help caregivers and family members show up with the right info on hand
MULTIPLE FAMILIES, ONE ACCOUNT
 • Manage multiple family calendars with one account and switch in a tap—great for extended families or separate groups
ALWAYS IN SYNC, ACROSS DEVICES
 • Everyone sees the same up-to-date schedule with automatic sync and reminders
 • Works seamlessly with Apple & Google calendars; advanced controls available with Pro
WHO IT’S PERFECT FOR
 • Busy parents juggling school, pickups, sports, and appointments
 • Couples who want a clear view of each other’s plans
 • Homes with multiple kids (or homeschool) that need conflict-free planning
 • Shift-work families matching work hours to family life
CUBBILY PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Unlock extra power for bigger or busier families:
 • AI Schedule Creation: turn photos and voice into calendar events
 • Multi-View: four calendar views to fit how you plan
 • Ad-Free: family scheduling without distractions
 • Widgets & Multiple Reminders to surface what matters, when it matters
 • More colors and theme customization
 • Default View + Search (even for those inside-joke event names)
 • Make events visible only to selected members for added privacy
 • No limits on Big Days, Little Things, Family Questions, and Family Lists
 • Enhanced Google Calendar sync controls for a more tailored schedule
One subscription covers the whole family. Start with a 7-day free trial.
SUBSCRIPTION & RENEWAL
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscription auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings after purchase.
PRIVACY & TERMS
Cubbily is a private family organizer, not a social media platform. No public profiles, feeds, or follower features.
Privacy Policy: https://www.cubbily.com/h5/client/calendarpage/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.cubbily.com/h5/client/calendarpage/terms

Prayer Times: Athan helps muslims get accurate prayer times all around the world.
Prayer Times - Azan Alarm requires zero-configuration and works for everyone out of the box, without ever needing to configure anything. It's the best tool to get local accurate prayer timings no matter where you are in the world, along with Quran versus about offering prayer. 
This ultimate utility calculates prayer timings based on your current location and automatically selects the best algorithm for calculating accurate timings.

• Accurate Prayer times based on your current location.
• Athan Notifications at every prayer time.
• Notifications with Quran verses about offering prayers.
• Share Quran verses on social media.
• No configuration required, works out of the box.
• Sound and Vibration Alerts.
• Shows Prayer times for: Fajr, Ishraaq, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha.
• Shows Islamic date and gregorian date.
Because app uses your device's location settings to give you prayer times, please kindly be aware your location settings are open and up to date.

bluejetty:00120595:ios.description:
WHAT DOES SPEECH BLUBS OFFER?
Speech Blubs is a voice-controlled speech therapy app designed to help your child learn new sounds and words, and to practice speaking in a stimulating, educational environment. 
**FEATURED IN** Autism Parenting Magazine, Brisbane Kids, Speech Chick Therapy, Beautiful Speech Life, and The Speech Teacher. Awarded the Social Impact Award and supported by the Facebook Start Program, and winner of the “Safe for Children” certificate, the Mom’s Choice Award, the Parent’s Picks 2020 Award Winner, and techozens.com’s “Best and Trusted Speech Therapy App for Kids.
WHY LEARN WITH SPEECH BLUBS?
Our app was created with speech therapists, teachers, & parents, and uses video modeling for effective speech development. Our apps have zero ads and no flashy features, thus providing a safe and non-intrusive learning experience. We use ABA therapy-inspired positive reinforcement that rewards kids with fun games and stickers for trying. Having the app at your fingertips makes it easy to practice in a routine that suits you, and helps avoid stressful disruptions that can upset your child.
Our apps use multiple child and platform support, so with one sign-in ALL of your kids can use the app, no matter if it's on your device, a partner’s, or grandparents’.
Speech Blubs is available in English (both American and British), German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Czech, Swedish, Polish, Hebrew, Hungarian, Lithuanian, and Romanian. You can switch the language from the menu inside the app.
KEY FEATURES:
Parents’ Academy:
A newly-added parent section provides access to an ever-growing content library of 350+ articles on parenting, homeschooling, education, speech therapy, and more. All written by 20+ speech and teaching professionals. Also, check out our practical video tips!
Kids’ area:
There are over 1500+ exercises, activities, videos, mini-games, and dozens of NEW face filters. We have lions, firefighters, monkeys, giraffes, hats, glasses, and more. Also, the app’s look and feel is even more child-friendly and engaging. There are some new animal characters to guide and motivate kids through exercises to achieve learning goals and make learning fun!
Choose from 28 fun sections: Early Sounds, When I Grow Up, Get into Shapes, Living Colors, Yummy Time, This Is My Body, Mouth Gym, Animal Kingdom, Ride Your Wheels, Sing-Along, and many more!
SCIENTIFICALLY-PROVEN LEARNING TECHNIQUES
Speech Blubs uses video modeling for immersive learning, where children observe their peers as “teachers'' on video. When children watch their peers in real-time, their MIRROR NEURONS fire up! This scientifically proven and effective approach was confirmed in a UCLA study published by the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association and showed that kids learn faster and better when learning from other kids.
SUBSCRIPTION, PRICING, & TERMS
With Speech Blubs membership you get a free personalized report with tips & tricks, plus unlimited access to all the activities to try our app. Your subscription automatically renews unless the auto-renew feature is turned off at least 24 hrs. before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hrs. before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
WE HELP CHILDREN LEARN TO SPEAK & READ!
Read our full Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy here: https://speechblubs.com/legal

Cofenplay+ marca uma nova fase da plataforma digital desenvolvida pelo Sistema Cofen/Conselhos Regionais de Enfermagem. Buscando fortalecer a atuação da Enfermagem em todo o país, ela integra a tecnologia, o conhecimento e os serviços em um único ambiente. 
Com acesso gratuito e navegação intuitiva, o Cofenplay+ conecta você a livros, jornais, revistas, audiolivros, podcasts, vídeos e videocasts, documentários, revistas científicas, cursos, idiomas, conteúdos exclusivos e ferramentas inovadoras, que facilitam o dia a dia do cuidado — sendo uma delas a inteligência artificial ANNA, pensada especialmente para apoiar a prática profissional.

 • Editais do mestrado CAPES-Cofen
 • Programa Nacional da Qualidade (PNQ)
 • Programa Proficiência

O Cofenplay+ oferece acesso ao Clube de Benefícios com ofertas e descontos especiais em alimentação, lazer, bem-estar, saúde, produtos e serviços. Assim como à área Kids, que conta com livros, áudios e atividades de imprimir para crianças. 
Como instalar 
1º Passo: Baixe o aplicativo e aguarde a instalação.
2º Passo: Abra o aplicativo e digite seu CPF.
3º Passo: Confirme seu e-mail e telefone para receber sua senha de acesso.
4º Passo: Informe a senha que você recebeu por SMS e e-mail.
5º Passo: Clique em Confirmar. Pronto, você já pode aproveitar o Cofenplay+.

bluejetty:00089153:ios.description:
Stay close with Link Messenger. Bring everyday conversations, voice and video calls, stories and short videos together in one app.
MESSAGES THAT KEEP YOU CONNECTED
Chat one-to-one or bring people together in a group. Share photos, videos, voice messages and files, from a quick update to the moments you want to keep.
VOICE AND VIDEO CALLS
Hear a familiar voice or talk face-to-face. Make voice and video calls over your internet connection and stay in touch wherever life takes you.
STORIES FOR YOUR DAY
Share a photo, video or text story that disappears after 24 hours. Choose who can see it, react to friends' stories and keep the conversation going.
SHORT VIDEOS AND POSTS
Watch and share short videos, publish photos and posts, and discover something new. Follow the people you care about and connect through likes and comments.
PRIVATE CONVERSATIONS
Private chats and calls use end-to-end encryption. Control your privacy settings and use disappearing messages when a conversation does not need to stay. Posts, stories and other social content are separate from end-to-end encrypted conversations.
MAKE LINK YOURS
Choose a light or dark theme and manage your notifications. Use Link on your phone and explore our desktop apps for Windows and Mac.
Core messaging and calling features are free. Optional Premium features and other in-app purchases are available. Ads may be shown to users without Premium. An internet connection is required; mobile data charges may apply.
Learn more: https://linkmessenger.me
Help: https://linkmessenger.me/helpCenter
Privacy: https://linkmessenger.me/privacy

apple-macos:6742322421.description:
GO AI Chat – Every Top AI Model, Plus a Full Creative Studio
Chat with GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi and DeepSeek in one app — then turn any idea into images and video without leaving the conversation. Type it, speak it, put every model head to head, or call in a panel of AI experts.
CHAT WITH EVERY TOP MODEL
• Switch between the world's leading AI models and see which suits you.
• Answers stream in live — stop, copy, share or have any reply read aloud.
• Attach up to five photos or shoot one on the spot; dictate instead of typing.
• Ask for a picture mid-chat and generate it right there in the thread.
• Leave the app while it thinks — answers finish in the background and wait for you.
• Export a whole conversation as a formatted PDF.
• Search your history, and sign in with Apple or Google to sync every chat across your devices.
TALK, DON'T TYPE
Voice Chat is a real, hands-free conversation. Just speak and it answers out loud in one of four voices — and you can interrupt it mid-sentence, like you would a friend. Every word is transcribed and saved as a normal chat.
ONE QUESTION, EVERY ANSWER
Multi-Model Chat sends your question to every model at once and lays the answers out side by side, then writes an instant summary of where they agree and where they disagree.
A PANEL OF EXPERTS
Experts Group puts 2–3 AI experts in one room. They answer in turn, build on each other and respectfully disagree. Pick your panel yourself, or let AI assemble the right one for your question.
AI EXPERTS, ON CALL
Doctor, Lawyer, Therapist, Nutrition Coach, Fitness Coach, Finance Advisor, Chef, Tutor, Travel Planner, Tech Support, Car Mechanic, Handyman, Gardener, Fashion Stylist, Dating Coach, Pet Behaviorist, Game Master, Actor, Scientist, Spiritual Guide, AI Specialist — and more arriving all the time. Each has its own expertise and starter prompts. Missing one? Request it.
IMAGE CREATOR & TRANSFORMER
• 40+ creative styles — Photoreal, Cinematic, Anime, Oil Painting, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Ukiyo-e, Art Deco, Synthwave and more.
• 40+ one-tap edits — remove backgrounds and objects, erase watermarks, restore and colorize old photos, upscale, replace skies, retouch skin, make studio headshots and passport photos.
• Brush over any part of a photo and change only that area.
• Aspect ratios sized for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, plus three quality tiers up to 2560px.
VIDEO GENERATOR & STUDIO
• Turn text into video, or bring any still photo to life.
• 4, 8 or 12 second clips, ratios for every platform, up to crisp 1080p.
• Edit existing video with a prompt — no timeline, no editing skills.
COLOR ADJUST — PRO GRADING, NO PRO SOFTWARE
• 40+ cinematic looks: Teal & Orange, Bleach Bypass, Cross Process, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Anamorphic, Noir, Neon and more.
• Or grade it yourself with 23 professional controls across Light, Color, Detail, Effects and Color Grading.
• Everything renders instantly as you drag; press and hold to compare with the original.
• Works on photos and video alike.
SUMMARISER
Drop in a YouTube link, a video, a PDF or an e-book, get the gist in seconds, then ask follow-up questions.
PROMPT LIBRARY
400+ ready-made prompts for images, video and color, searchable by category — and room to save your own.
YOUR GALLERY
Every image and video you make is saved automatically, filterable by type and date, ready to share, save to Photos, or send back into the Studio.
BUILT FOR iOS
Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight search, home-screen quick actions and Handoff between iPhone, iPad and Mac. Available in 40+ languages.
Download GO AI Chat and see what happens when every top AI model — and a full creative studio — fits in one app.

apple-itunes:6446083323.name: Document & pdf scanner app
apple-itunes:6446083323.description:
Looking for a scanner app that can turn your mobile into a portable scanner? Well, this document scanner is one of the popular utilities for this purpose. Our App is capable of scanning hard-copy documents and images for extracting all sorts of visible text from them.
Our scanner app is cost-effective and is ideal for converting text on hard copies to digital formats like .txt, .docx, and many others. It can take a lot of time and effort if you manually type down text from an image or physical document into Word or Notepad. This is why you must try doc scanner app tools.
The doc scanner is an easy solution for extracting text from physical documents, business cards, licenses, and even images. My PDF scanner uses the default camera of your mobile or tablet for capturing the image or document having textual information on it.
After scanning the document/image the scanner app is going to analyze visible text and starts extracting it. Our PDF scanner app uses artificial intelligence and optical character recognition algorithms.
Features of PDF Scanner App!
Modern scanners advanced algorithms to scan your documents in high quality.
• You can import & scan documents directly using your mobile camera scanner.
• Multiple document scanning options such as ID cards, business cards, licenses, docs, passports, etc.
• Save the scanned copy of documents in PDF, DOC, & JPEG
• Accurate scanning from blurry docs.
• Photo scanner provides high-quality scanning for your different types of documents.
Who Should Consider Using this Document Scanner App?
Below are a few benefits of the PDF scan app:
Students
Students can use a scanner to scan their handwritten notes and other papers to save them digitally. Saving notes in form of scanned copies would also optimize the device storage space. The docs scanned by the PDF scan can’t be shared with any third parties so, don’t worry.
Business Managers
Business managers can also use our App. In the past businesses used to maintain and organize their documentation on registers. Today it is impossible to manage data on paper because it is no longer a secure way. So use the free app for scanning confidential printed documents. The photo scanner would help convert all visible text into digital formats. Not only documents but you can also make a scan to pdf for your license, ID cards, etc also.
Detail of Key Features of Our PDF Scanner App
High-Quality Scanning
The photo scanner offers high-quality document scanning and converts your physical documents to digital ones. Import or scan documents using your mobile camera to scan the documents in high quality. The doc scanner provides the most accurate conversions in PDF, PNG, & JPEG formats.
No doubt, It is hard to get clear images of old documents. Not to worry try this application using advanced scanning algorithms which can easily optimize the quality of the scanned file/image to make the text more visible.
Multiple Documents Scanning
PDF scanner camera is a one-stop for all types of document scanning, as this app offers multiple doc scanning. It includes your physical paper documents, ID card, Business cards, passports, and Licenses.
The document scanner app and photo scanner can help you convert docs to PDF & other formats.
With the scanner app, you can rename scanned documents that are saved with a default name. If you have any suggestions regarding our free app for iPhone or iPad we would urge you to email us your query or give us a detailed review!

firefox-addons:3111619.name: David — Ad Blocker & AI Blocker
firefox-addons:3111619.summary: Ad blocker and AI blocker in one: skips YouTube video ads and Facebook, Instagram & TikTok ads, hides AI Overviews and AI videos.
firefox-addons:3111619.description:
David is an ad blocker and AI blocker in one. It skips video ads, removes sponsored posts from your social feeds without interrupting your scroll, and takes AI-generated content off your screen. Every feature has its own on/off switch.
ADS
• YouTube: skips the ads that play before and during videos, hides banner ads over the player, and removes ad tiles from the feed and Shorts
• Facebook and Instagram: hides sponsored posts and skips ads in Reels
• TikTok: skips ads in the For You feed
• Other websites: blocks common ad networks and hides the empty ad boxes they leave behind
• Optional: treat influencer "paid partnership" posts as ads
AI BLOCKING
• Search: hides AI-generated answer boxes in search results, and can load Google's plain Web results
• Removes AI image and AI content-farm sites from search results
• AI videos: hides or skips videos labeled as AI-generated, and spots unlabeled ones by their titles and hashtags
• In short-video feeds, AI videos are skipped automatically, or shown behind a card with Skip and Watch buttons
• Hides AI assistant buttons and AI summaries built into social, shopping and work sites
• Optional: block AI chatbot and image-generator websites, each one switchable
ANNOYANCES
• Hides cookie-consent banners and lets the page scroll again
• Hides newsletter sign-up pop-ups
• Hides "open in the app" banners
• Optional: hides chat bubbles
COMMUNITY VOTES
• Mark a video as AI or as an ad from the toolbar popup once you've watched it
• Optional: share your votes anonymously, so videos many people agree on are handled for everyone
COUNTS
• See how many ads and AI items David blocked, in this tab and all time
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no analytics. Settings and counts stay in your browser.
• Network requests: daily filter-list downloads, the community vote list, and, only if you turn on sharing, the votes you cast.
Community filter lists by Stevoisiak and laylavish.
SUPPORT DAVID
David is free, has no ads and sells no data. If it makes your browsing better, you can buy me a coffee: https://ko-fi.com/davidblocker

apple-itunes:6464449036.name: ODMS Cloud
apple-itunes:6464449036.description:
OM Dictation Management System in the Cloud (ODMS Cloud) is a cloud-based dictation workflow system that allows you to share dictation files between authors and Transcriptionists anytime, anywhere. Your files are now stored on the cloud, which means a dedicated server is no longer required, and setup is easy to get started.
Designing your dictation workflow can be done through a simple interface which allows you to realize an efficient workflow.
This is software for performing dictation using a smartphone. Supports file editing functions necessary for dictation, such as additional recording, overwriting recording, and insert recording. Furthermore, basic information necessary for workflow design such as Author ID and Worktype ID can be received from the ODMS Cloud server and added to the Dictation file. The created Dictation file can be uploaded directly to the ODMS Cloud server from this app.
